_G.Spooky = _G.Spooky or {}
local Spooky = _G.Spooky

Spooky.Diagnostics = {errors={}, statuses={}, lastNotice={}}
function Spooky.ReportIssue(feature, err)
    local d=Spooky.Diagnostics
    local text=tostring(err)
    local item=d.errors[feature]
    d.errors[feature]={message=text,count=(item and item.count or 0)+1,time=os.clock()}
    if not d.lastNotice[feature] or os.clock()-d.lastNotice[feature]>15 then
        d.lastNotice[feature]=os.clock()
        warn("[Spooky / " .. feature .. "] " .. text)
        if _G.Spooky_Log then pcall(_G.Spooky_Log,feature .. ": " .. text) end
        if not d.lastToast or os.clock()-d.lastToast>20 then
            d.lastToast=os.clock()
            pcall(function()
                game:GetService("StarterGui"):SetCore("SendNotification",{
                    Title="Spooky · " .. feature,
                    Text="Error detectado. Revisa la consola de errores.",Duration=5,
                })
            end)
        end
    end
end

_G.PlayerBlacklist = _G.PlayerBlacklist or {}
Spooky.Blacklist = _G.PlayerBlacklist
function Spooky.ExportPlayerBlacklist()
    local result = {}
    for key, value in pairs(_G.PlayerBlacklist or {}) do
        if value == true and (type(key) == "string" or type(key) == "number") then result[tostring(key)] = true end
    end
    return result
end
function Spooky.RestorePlayerBlacklist(data)
    if type(data) ~= "table" then return end
    local result = {}
    for key, value in pairs(data) do
        if value == true and (type(key) == "string" or type(key) == "number") then
            result[tostring(key)] = true
            if tonumber(key) then result[tonumber(key)] = true end
        end
    end
    _G.PlayerBlacklist, Spooky.Blacklist = result, result
    if Spooky.RefreshPlayerList then task.defer(Spooky.RefreshPlayerList) end
end

task.spawn(function()
    pcall(function()
        if not game:IsLoaded() then
            pcall(function() game.Loaded:Wait() end)
        end
        local chosenTeam = nil
        if isfile and isfile("Spooky_AutoTeam.txt") and readfile then
            local raw = readfile("Spooky_AutoTeam.txt")
            if raw then
                local t = string.match(raw, "%a+")
                if t == "Marines" or t == "Pirates" then
                    chosenTeam = t
                end
            end
        end
        if chosenTeam then
            local rem = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes", 10) or ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
            local comm = rem and (rem:WaitForChild("CommF_", 10) or rem:FindFirstChild("CommF_"))
            if comm then
                comm:InvokeServer("SetTeam", chosenTeam)
            elseif ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Remotes") and ReplicatedStorage.Remotes:FindFirstChild("CommF_") then
                ReplicatedStorage.Remotes.CommF_:InvokeServer("SetTeam", chosenTeam)
            end
        end
    end)
end)
local function getSafeParent()
    if gethui then
        local ok, h = pcall(gethui)
        if ok and h then return h end
    end
    if syn and syn.protect_gui then
        pcall(syn.protect_gui, PlayerGui)
        return PlayerGui
    end
    return PlayerGui
end
local TargetParent = getSafeParent()
local function safeParent(gui)
    if not gui then return end
    local ok = pcall(function() gui.Parent = TargetParent end)
    if (not ok or not gui.Parent) and LocalPlayer then
        pcall(function()
            gui.Parent = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui") or LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui", 3)
        end)
    end
end

end
local SCRIPT_SESSION = tick()

local function isCurrentSession()
    return _G.Spooky_Session == SCRIPT_SESSION
end
local ActiveScriptConnections = {}
local function registerConnection(conn)
    if conn then
        table.insert(ActiveScriptConnections, conn)
    end
    return conn
end

        "SpookyMacroEditorWindow",
        "SpookyIslandTeleport",
        "SpookyIslandTeleportGui",
        "IslandTeleportGui",
        "SpookyShipCustomGui",
        "SpookyShipModWindow",
        "ShipCustomGui",
        "SpookyKeybindsGui",
        "Spooky_Notification_Gui",
        "SpookyCombatHUDWidget",
        "Spooky_Float_FloatHUD_Aimbot",
        "Spooky_Float_FloatHUD_BusoKen",
        "Spooky_Float_FloatHUD_V4",
        "Spooky_Float_FloatHUD_Soru",
        "Spooky_Float_FloatHUD_MagnetHealth"
    }
    for _, name in ipairs(guiNames) do
        local g = parent:FindFirstChild(name)
        if g then pcall(function() g:Destroy() end) end
    end
    for _, ch in ipairs(parent:GetChildren()) do
        if ch:IsA("ScreenGui") and string.find(ch.Name, "Spooky_Float_") then
            pcall(function() ch:Destroy() end)
        end
    end
end

    local currentPct = 15
    local targetPct = 15
    local function setProgress(pct, duration, statusText, phaseText)
        targetPct = math.clamp(pct, 0, 100)
        if statusText then status.Text = statusText end
        if phaseText then footer.Text = phaseText end
        TweenService:Create(fill, TweenInfo.new(duration or 0.35, Enum.EasingStyle.Cubic, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
            Size = UDim2.fromScale(targetPct / 100, 1)
        }):Play()

        local startP = currentPct
        local startTime = os.clock()
        local animDur = duration or 0.35
        task.spawn(function()
            while os.clock() - startTime < animDur do
                local alpha = (os.clock() - startTime) / animDur
                local val = math.floor(startP + (targetPct - startP) * alpha)
                pctLbl.Text = tostring(val) .. "%"
                task.wait(0.03)
            end
            currentPct = targetPct
            pctLbl.Text = tostring(targetPct) .. "%"
        end)
    end

    local finished = false
    local function finish()
        if finished then return end
        finished = true
        pulsing = false
        setProgress(100, 0.22, es and "Tu espacio esta listo!" or "Your workspace is ready!", "SPOOKY / READY")
        pctLbl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(120, 255, 180)
        TweenService:Create(spark, TweenInfo.new(0.2), { BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(120, 255, 180) }):Play()

        task.delay(0.26, function()
            if not isCurrentSession() then
                pcall(function() blur:Destroy() end)
                gui:Destroy()
                return
            end
            TweenService:Create(blur, TweenInfo.new(0.28, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { Size = 0 }):Play()
            TweenService:Create(shade, TweenInfo.new(0.28, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }):Play()

                GroupTransparency = 1,
                Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, -20)
            }):Play()
            TweenService:Create(scale, TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.In), {
                Scale = 0.85
            }):Play()

            task.delay(0.32, function()
                _G.SpookyStartupLoaderFinished = true
                local reveal = _G.SpookyOnStartupLoaderFinished
                _G.SpookyOnStartupLoaderFinished = nil
                if reveal then pcall(reveal) end
                pcall(function() blur:Destroy() end)
                pcall(function() gui:Destroy() end)
            end)
        end)
    end

    _G.SpookyStartupStage = function(stage)
        if finished or not isCurrentSession() then return end
        local stages = {
            controls = { 55, "FASE 02 / CONTROLES", es and "Organizando controles y atajos..." or "Organizing controls & keybinds..." },
            combat   = { 88, "FASE 03 / SISTEMAS",  es and "Calibrando funciones de combate..." or "Calibrating combat systems..." },
        }
        local data = stages[stage]
        if data then
            setProgress(data[1], 0.32, data[3], data[2])
        end
    end

    local began = os.clock()
    _G.SpookyFinishStartup = function()
        task.delay(math.max(0, 0.65 - (os.clock() - began)), finish)
    end

    skip.Activated:Connect(finish)

    task.delay(10, function()
        if not finished and isCurrentSession() then
            finish()
        end
    end)
end

local function performFullScriptShutdown()
    print("[Project Spooky] Full Shutdown: Deactivating ALL features and cleaning up...")

    local fCallbacks = _G.FeatureCallbacks
    local fStates = _G.FeatureStates
    if fCallbacks and fStates then
        for featName, cb in pairs(fCallbacks) do
            if fStates[featName] == true then
                pcall(function() cb(false) end)
            end
        end
    end
    local fStates = _G.FeatureStates
    if fStates then
        for featName, _ in pairs(fStates) do
            fStates[featName] = false
        end
    end

    if _G.SpookyStopMacro then pcall(_G.SpookyStopMacro) end
    if _G.SpookyRestoreGunAim then pcall(_G.SpookyRestoreGunAim); _G.SpookyRestoreGunAim = nil end
    if _G.SpookyRestoreMouseAim then pcall(_G.SpookyRestoreMouseAim) end
    if Spooky.CleanupCombatVisuals then pcall(Spooky.CleanupCombatVisuals) end
    pcall(function() RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep("SpookyCamLockExecution") end)

    _G.Spooky_Session = nil
    _G.Spooky_Loaded = false

    getgenv().SpookyAutoBountyRunning = false
    getgenv().AutoBountyActive = false
    _G.AutoFarmOvercharged = false
    _G.GunAuraActive = false
    _G.MagnetM1Active = false
    _G.G_DragonGunM1 = false
    _G.lockedAim1Char = nil
    _G.aimbot1TargetPos = nil
    _G.lockedAim2Char = nil
    _G.G_SilentAimTargetPos = nil
    _G.centuTargetChar = nil
    _G.centuAimPosition = nil
    local fnAutoBounty = _G.stopSpookyAutoBountyExact or (type(stopSpookyAutoBountyExact) == "function" and stopSpookyAutoBountyExact)
    if fnAutoBounty then pcall(fnAutoBounty) end
    local fnIslandTween = _G.stopIslandTween or (type(stopIslandTween) == "function" and stopIslandTween)
    if fnIslandTween then pcall(fnIslandTween) end

    local fnCleanESPs = _G.Spooky_CleanAllESPs or _G.cleanAllESPs or (type(cleanAllESPs) == "function" and cleanAllESPs)
    if fnCleanESPs then pcall(fnCleanESPs) end
    local fnCleanVFX = getgenv().SpookyColorVFX_Cleanup or _G.SpookyColorVFX_Cleanup or _G.cleanupVFX or (type(cleanupVFX) == "function" and cleanupVFX)
    if fnCleanVFX then pcall(fnCleanVFX) end
    local fnFruitScales = _G.Spooky_RestoreFruitScales or _G.restoreAllFruitScales or (type(restoreAllFruitScales) == "function" and restoreAllFruitScales)
    if fnFruitScales then pcall(fnFruitScales) end
    local fnHud = _G.Spooky_CleanupHudOverlays or _G.cleanupHudOverlays or (type(cleanupHudOverlays) == "function" and cleanupHudOverlays)
    if fnHud then pcall(fnHud) end

    pcall(function()
        local char = LocalPlayer.Character
        if char then
            local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if hum then
                hum.PlatformStand = false
                hum.Sit = false
            end
            local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if hrp then
                for _, ch in ipairs(hrp:GetChildren()) do
                    if ch:IsA("BodyVelocity") or ch:IsA("BodyGyro") then
                        pcall(function() ch:Destroy() end)
                    end
                end
            end
            for _, p in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
                if p:IsA("BasePart") then p.CanTouch = true end
            end
        end
    end)

    pcall(function()
        local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
        if cam then
            local char = LocalPlayer.Character
            local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if hum then cam.CameraSubject = hum end
            cam.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
            cam.FieldOfView = 70
            LocalPlayer.CameraMaxZoomDistance = 128
            LocalPlayer.CameraMinZoomDistance = 0.5
        end
    end)

    for _, conn in ipairs(ActiveScriptConnections) do
        if conn and conn.Disconnect then
            pcall(function() conn:Disconnect() end)
        end
    end
    table.clear(ActiveScriptConnections)

    pcall(function()
        for _, obj in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
            if obj.Name == "SpookyWaterPlatform" or obj.Name == "WaterPlatform" or obj.Name == "SpookyTracerAnchor" then
                pcall(function() obj:Destroy() end)
            end
        end
        local waterPlane = workspace:FindFirstChild("Map") and workspace.Map:FindFirstChild("WaterBase-Plane")
        if waterPlane then
            waterPlane.CanCollide = false
            waterPlane.Size = Vector3.new(1000, 80, 1000)
        end
        for _, obj in ipairs(Lighting:GetChildren()) do
            if obj.Name:find("Spooky") or obj.Name:find("Shaders") then
                pcall(function() obj:Destroy() end)
            end
        end
    end)

    cleanOldGuis(TargetParent)
    if PlayerGui and PlayerGui ~= TargetParent then cleanOldGuis(PlayerGui) end
    pcall(function()
        local pGui = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui") or game:GetService("CoreGui")
        local guiList = {
            "Spooky_GUI", "Spooky_LoginGui", "Spooky_MobileToggle", "SpookyCamLockWidget", "SpookyTrackerWidget",
            "SuperJumpWidget", "SpookySuperJumpWidget", "Spooky_HUDOverlay",
            "Spooky_Macro_Floating_Combo", "Spooky_ImportModal", "SpookyIslandTeleport",
            "SpookyIslandTeleportGui", "IslandTeleportGui", "SpookyShipCustomGui", "SpookyShipModWindow"
        }
        for _, gName in ipairs(guiList) do
            local found = pGui:FindFirstChild(gName, true)
            if found then pcall(function() found:Destroy() end) end
        end
    end)

    pcall(function()
        if Spooky.UI.screen and Spooky.UI.screen.Parent then
            Spooky.UI.screen:Destroy()
        end
    end)
    print("[Project Spooky] All features successfully deactivated and script closed.")
end

task.spawn(function()
    local savedTeam = "Pirates"
    pcall(function()
        if isfile and isfile("Spooky_AutoTeam.txt") and readfile then
            local raw = readfile("Spooky_AutoTeam.txt")
            if raw then
                local t = string.match(raw, "%a+")
                if t == "Marines" or t == "Pirates" or t == "None" then
                    savedTeam = t
                end
            end
        else
            if writefile then writefile("Spooky_AutoTeam.txt", "Pirates") end
        end
    end)
    if savedTeam ~= "None" then
        repeat task.wait(0.2) until game:IsLoaded() and game.Players.LocalPlayer
        local lp = game.Players.LocalPlayer
        local rem = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("Remotes", 10)
        local commF = rem and rem:WaitForChild("CommF_", 10)
        local tries = 0
        while (not lp.Team or lp.Team.Name ~= savedTeam) and tries < 10 do
            if commF then
                pcall(function() commF:InvokeServer("SetTeam", savedTeam) end)
            end
            task.wait(1.0)
            tries = tries + 1
        end
    end
end)

function Spooky.TakeAttackBudget(channel, delay)
    local now = os.clock()
    if now < (Spooky.AttackBudget[channel] or 0) then return false end
    Spooky.AttackBudget[channel] = now + math.clamp(tonumber(delay) or 0.15, 0.12, 1)
    return true
end

function Spooky.ResolveFeature(name)
    return ({FruitsM1="OneShotKitsune",InfiniteSoru="InfinitySoru",SpeedHack="WalkSpeed"})[name] or name
end
function Spooky.RegisterControl(btn, feature, en, es, run)
    local page = btn:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("ScrollingFrame")
    local group = btn.Parent and btn.Parent:GetAttribute("SpookyControlGroup") or ""
    local pageName = page and page.Name or "UI"
    local id = feature and ("Toggle:" .. feature) or ("Action:" .. pageName .. ":" .. group .. ":" .. en)
    if en == "+ Add Control" then return end
    Spooky.ControlCatalog[id] = {feature=feature,en=en,es=es,run=run,isToggle=feature~=nil,page=pageName:gsub("_Page$","")}
end

local function setFeatureState(name, active, skipCallback)
    name = Spooky.ResolveFeature(name)
    if Spooky.RetiredFeatures[name] then FeatureStates[name] = false; return end
    if name == "KitsuneAutoBounty" or name == "OneShotKitsune2" or name == "AutoV4Kit" then
        FeatureStates[name] = false
        return
    end
    active = active == true
    Spooky.FeatureVersions[name] = (Spooky.FeatureVersions[name] or 0) + 1
    local version = Spooky.FeatureVersions[name]
    FeatureStates[name] = active
    local visualOK, visualError = pcall(updateToggleVisual, name, active)
    if not visualOK then Spooky.ReportIssue("Toggle visual", visualError) end
    if _G.SpookyUpdateFloatingWidget then
        if name == "AimbotPlayer2" or name == "AimbotPlayer1" or name == "AimbotPlayer3" then
            _G.SpookyUpdateFloatingWidget("FloatHUD_Aimbot", active)
        elseif name == "AutoBuso" or name == "AutoKen" then
            local both = (FeatureStates["AutoBuso"] == true and FeatureStates["AutoKen"] == true)
            _G.SpookyUpdateFloatingWidget("FloatHUD_BusoKen", both)
        elseif name == "AutoV4" then
            _G.SpookyUpdateFloatingWidget("FloatHUD_V4", active)

        elseif name == "CombatHUD" then
            _G.SpookyUpdateFloatingWidget("CombatHUD", active)
        end
    end
    if _G.SpookySyncCustomControl then
        local ok, err = pcall(_G.SpookySyncCustomControl, name)
        if not ok then Spooky.ReportIssue("Custom control", err) end
    end
    if not skipCallback and FeatureCallbacks[name] then
        local callback = FeatureCallbacks[name]
        task.spawn(function()
            if not isCurrentSession() or Spooky.FeatureVersions[name] ~= version then return end
            local ok, err = pcall(callback, active)
            if ok then Spooky.AppliedFeatures[name] = callback
            else Spooky.ReportIssue(name,err) end
        end)
    end
end
local function notifyToggle(name, state)
    local status = state and (CurrentLang == "EN" and "ENABLED" or "ACTIVADO") or (CurrentLang == "EN" and "DISABLED" or "DESACTIVADO")
    print(string.format("[Project Spooky] %s: %s", name, status))
    if _G.Spooky_Log then
        pcall(_G.Spooky_Log, (state and "[+] " or "[-] ") .. tostring(name))
    end
end
local function toggleFeature(name)
    name = Spooky.ResolveFeature(name)
    local newState = not (FeatureStates[name] or false)
    setFeatureState(name, newState)
    local data = ToggleButtons[name]
    local labelText = data and data.text or name
    notifyToggle(labelText, newState)
    return newState
end
_G.toggleFeature = toggleFeature
_G.setFeatureState = setFeatureState
local function universalCopy(text)
    local copied = false
    pcall(function()
        if setclipboard then setclipboard(text); copied = true
        elseif toclipboard then toclipboard(text); copied = true
        elseif syn and syn.write_clipboard then syn.write_clipboard(text); copied = true
        elseif write_clipboard then write_clipboard(text); copied = true end
    end)
    return copied
end
local function universalPaste()
    local text = ""
    pcall(function()
        if getclipboard then text = getclipboard()
        elseif syn and syn.read_clipboard then text = syn.read_clipboard() end
    end)
    return text
end

local function computeScale()
    local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not camera then return 0.85 end
    local vp = camera.ViewportSize
    local scaleX = (vp.X * 0.92) / 650
    local scaleY = (vp.Y * 0.90) / 369
    local minScale = math.min(scaleX, scaleY, 1)
    return math.clamp(minScale * 0.95, 0.35, 1.0)
end

    local function makeDraggable(dragBars, targetFrame)
        local bars = (typeof(dragBars) == "table") and dragBars or { dragBars }
        local dragging, dragInput, dragStart, startPos = false, nil, nil, nil
        local function update(input)
            if _G.isEditModeActive then return end
            if not dragging or not dragStart or not startPos then return end
            local s = (UIScale and UIScale.Scale > 0.1) and UIScale.Scale or 1
            local delta = (input.Position - dragStart) / s
            local newX = startPos.X.Offset + delta.X
            local newY = startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y

            local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
            if cam and cam.ViewportSize then
                local vp = cam.ViewportSize
                newX = math.clamp(newX, -vp.X / 2 + 100, vp.X / 2 - 100)
                newY = math.clamp(newY, -vp.Y / 2 + 60, vp.Y / 2 - 60)
            end
            targetFrame.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, newX, startPos.Y.Scale, newY)
        end
        for _, b in ipairs(bars) do
            if b then
                b.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
                    if _G.isEditModeActive then return end
                    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                        dragging = true
                        dragStart = input.Position
                        startPos = targetFrame.Position
                        input.Changed:Connect(function()
                            if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                                if dragging then
                                    dragging = false
                                    lastUIPos = targetFrame.Position
                                end
                            end
                        end)
                    end
                end)
                b.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
                    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                        dragInput = input
                    end
                end)
            end
        end
        UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
            if input == dragInput and dragging then
                if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
                    local isDown = false
                    pcall(function()
                        isDown = UserInputService:IsMouseButtonPressed(Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1)
                    end)
                    if not isDown then
                        dragging = false
                        lastUIPos = targetFrame.Position
                        return
                    end
                end
                update(input)
                lastUIPos = targetFrame.Position
            end
        end)
        UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                if dragging then
                    dragging = false
                    lastUIPos = targetFrame.Position
                end
            end
        end)
    end

    local topDragHandle = Instance.new("Frame", MAINUIframe)
    topDragHandle.Name = "TopDragHandle"
    topDragHandle.Size = UDim2.new(1, -120, 0, 42)
    topDragHandle.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
    topDragHandle.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    topDragHandle.ZIndex = 2
    makeDraggable({ topDragHandle, MAINUIframe }, MAINUIframe)

    local leftSideImg = Instance.new("Frame", MAINUIframe)
    _G.SpookyThemedElements.leftSideImg = leftSideImg
    leftSideImg.Name = "left side image"
    makeDraggable(leftSideImg, MAINUIframe)

    pcall(function()
        local function updateHomeStats()
            local leaderstats = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
            if leaderstats then
                local b = leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Bounty/Honor") or leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Bounty") or leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Honor")
                if b then
                    local num = tonumber(b.Value) or 0
                    if num >= 1000000 then
                        playerBountyLbl.Text = string.format("%.2fM", num / 1000000)
                    elseif num >= 1000 then
                        playerBountyLbl.Text = string.format("%.1fK", num / 1000)
                    else
                        playerBountyLbl.Text = tostring(num)
                    end
                end
                local lvl = leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Level")
                if lvl then
                    playerLevelLbl.Text = "Level " .. tostring(lvl.Value)
                end
            end
            if LocalPlayer.Team then teamLbl.Text = tostring(LocalPlayer.Team.Name) end
            playerNameLbl.Text = LocalPlayer.DisplayName or LocalPlayer.Name
        end
        updateHomeStats()
        local ls = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
        if ls then
            for _, stat in ipairs(ls:GetChildren()) do
                stat.Changed:Connect(updateHomeStats)
            end
        end
        LocalPlayer:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Team"):Connect(updateHomeStats)
    end)

    local function resolveCanonicalTabId(name)
        if not name then return "Home" end
        local s = tostring(name)
        local norm = string.lower(string.gsub(s, "[%s_]+", ""))

        if norm == "home" or norm == "inicio" or norm == "dashboard" then
            return "Home"
        elseif norm == "combat" or norm == "combate" or norm == "pvp" then
            return "Combat"

    local function updateSidebarVisual(selectedId)
        local canonSel = resolveCanonicalTabId(selectedId or currentActiveTab or "Home")
        local curAccent = _G.CurrentAccentColor or Color3.fromRGB(140, 115, 235)
        local curBright = _G.CurrentAccentColorBright or Color3.fromRGB(175, 145, 255)
        for id, btnData in pairs(NavButtons) do
            local isSel = (id == canonSel)
            local btn = btnData.btn or btnData
            local st = btnData.st or (btn and btn:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke"))
            local ind = btnData.ind
            local lbl = btnData.lbl

            if btn then
                TweenService:Create(btn, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {
                    BackgroundColor3 = isSel and Color3.fromRGB(24, 22, 38) or Color3.fromRGB(12, 12, 17)
                }):Play()
            end
            if st then
                TweenService:Create(st, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {
                    Color = isSel and curAccent or Color3.fromRGB(30, 28, 40),
                    Thickness = isSel and 1.2 or 1
                }):Play()
            end
            if ind then
                TweenService:Create(ind, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {
                    Size = isSel and UDim2.new(0, 3, 0, 14) or UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 14),
                    BackgroundColor3 = curBright,
                    BackgroundTransparency = isSel and 0 or 1
                }):Play()
            end
            if lbl then
                TweenService:Create(lbl, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {
                    TextColor3 = isSel and curBright or Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 170)
                }):Play()
            end
        end
    end
    _G.UpdateSidebarVisual = updateSidebarVisual

    showTab = function(tabName)
        local canonId = resolveCanonicalTabId(tabName)
        currentActiveTab = canonId
        _G.CurrentActiveTab = canonId
        local isHome = (canonId == "Home")
        if titleBanner then titleBanner.Visible = isHome end
        if profileContainer then profileContainer.Visible = isHome end
        if playerProfile then playerProfile.Visible = isHome end
        if welcomeLbl then welcomeLbl.Visible = isHome end
        if HomeStatsContainer then HomeStatsContainer.Visible = isHome end
        creditsLbl.Visible = isHome
        creditsPersonLbl.Visible = isHome
        if creditsBadge then creditsBadge.Visible = isHome end
        if topImg then topImg.Visible = false end
        if midImg then midImg.Visible = false end
        if botImg then botImg.Visible = false end

        if _G.SpookyThemedElements and _G.SpookyThemedElements.centerPagesBg then
            _G.SpookyThemedElements.centerPagesBg.Visible = true
        end

        for _, page in pairs(PagesFolder:GetChildren()) do
            if page:IsA("GuiObject") then
                local isTarget = false
                if not isHome then
                    if canonId == "Combat" and page.Name == "Combat_Page" then
                        isTarget = true
                    elseif canonId == "SpookyBounty" and page.Name == "AutoBounty_Page" then
                        isTarget = true
                    elseif canonId == "KitsuneBounty" and page.Name == "KitsuneBounty_Page" then
                        isTarget = true
                    elseif canonId == "ControlPeople" and page.Name == "ControlPeople_Page" then
                        isTarget = true
                        if _G.SpookyRefreshPlayerList then
                            task.defer(function() pcall(_G.SpookyRefreshPlayerList) end)
                        end
                    elseif canonId == "Cheats" and (page.Name == "Glitches_Page" or page.Name == "Cheats_Page") then
                        isTarget = true
                    elseif canonId == "FFlags" and page.Name == "FFlags_Page" then
                        isTarget = true
                    elseif canonId == "Macro" and page.Name == "Macro_Page" then
                        isTarget = true
                    elseif canonId == "Keybinds" and page.Name == "Keybinds_Page" then
                        isTarget = true
                    elseif canonId == "Color" and (page.Name == "SacredVFX_Page" or page.Name == "Color_Page") then
                        isTarget = true
                    elseif canonId == "Visual" and (page.Name == "Visual_Page" or page.Name == "Visuals_Page") then
                        isTarget = true
                    elseif canonId == "HUD" and page.Name == "HUD_Page" then
                        isTarget = true
                    elseif canonId == "Dungeons" and page.Name == "Dungeons_Page" then
                        isTarget = true
                    elseif canonId == "TPIslands" and page.Name == "TPIslands_Page" then
                        isTarget = true
                    elseif canonId == "UI" and page.Name == "UI_Page" then
                        isTarget = true
                    elseif canonId == "Misc" and page.Name == "Misc_Page" then
                        isTarget = true
                    elseif canonId == "Configs" and page.Name == "Configs_Page" then
                        isTarget = true
                    elseif canonId == "Report" and page.Name == "Report_Page" then
                        isTarget = true
                    elseif canonId == "Functions" and page.Name == "Functions_Page" then
                        isTarget = true
                    end
                end
                page.Visible = isTarget
            end
        end
        PagesFolder.Visible = true
        updateSidebarVisual(canonId)
        addLog("[TAB] " .. tostring(canonId))
    end
    globalShowTab = showTab
    _G.SpookyShowTab = showTab

    for idx, tdef in ipairs(tabDefinitions) do

        st.Thickness = isDefault and 1.2 or 1

        local ind = Instance.new("Frame", btn)

        lbl.TextSize = (tdef.isSoon and 8.5 or 10.5)

        btn.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
            if btn.BackgroundColor3 ~= Color3.fromRGB(24, 22, 38) then
                TweenService:Create(btn, TweenInfo.new(0.12), { BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(18, 18, 26) }):Play()
                local curAccent = _G.CurrentAccentColor or Color3.fromRGB(65, 145, 255)
            TweenService:Create(st, TweenInfo.new(0.12), { Color = curAccent }):Play()
                TweenService:Create(lbl, TweenInfo.new(0.12), { TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 220, 235) }):Play()
            end
        end)
        btn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
            if btn.BackgroundColor3 ~= Color3.fromRGB(24, 22, 38) then
                TweenService:Create(btn, TweenInfo.new(0.12), { BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(12, 12, 17) }):Play()
                TweenService:Create(st, TweenInfo.new(0.12), { Color = Color3.fromRGB(30, 28, 40) }):Play()
                TweenService:Create(lbl, TweenInfo.new(0.12), { TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 170) }):Play()
            end
        end)

        if tdef.isSoon then
            local badge = Instance.new("Frame", btn)
            badge.Name = "SoonBadge"
            badge.Size = UDim2.new(0, 24, 0, 11)
            badge.Position = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0.5, -5.5)
            badge.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(36, 26, 46)
            badge.BorderSizePixel = 0
            badge.ZIndex = 11
            Instance.new("UICorner", badge).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)
            local bStk = Instance.new("UIStroke", badge)
            bStk.Color = Color3.fromRGB(110, 75, 150)
            bStk.Thickness = 0.8
            local bLbl = Instance.new("TextLabel", badge)
            bLbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
            bLbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            bLbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
            bLbl.Text = "Soon"
            bLbl.TextSize = 6.5
            bLbl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(215, 185, 255)
            bLbl.ZIndex = 12
        end

            btn = btn,
            st = st,
            ind = ind,
            icon = nil,
            lbl = lbl

            showTab(tdef.id)

        pcall(function() btn.Activated:Connect(onTabActivated) end)

    local MobileToggle = Instance.new("ImageButton", ScreenGui)
    _G.SpookyThemedElements.MobileToggle = MobileToggle
    if SpookyEditableElements then SpookyEditableElements["MobileToggle"] = MobileToggle end
    MobileToggle.Name = "Spooky_MobileToggle"
    MobileToggle.Size = UDim2.new(0, 52, 0, 52)
    MobileToggle.Position = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0, 80)
    MobileToggle.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(10, 10, 14)
    MobileToggle.BorderSizePixel = 0
    MobileToggle.Image = "rbxassetid://124747708335361"
    MobileToggle.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Stretch
    MobileToggle.ClipsDescendants = true
    MobileToggle.Visible = false
    MobileToggle.ZIndex = 9999
    MobileToggle.Active = true
    Instance.new("UICorner", MobileToggle).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
    local toggleStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", MobileToggle)
    toggleStroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
    toggleStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(180, 180, 200)
    toggleStroke.Thickness = 1.2

    local userMovedTogglePos = nil
    local toggleDragging, toggleDragStart, toggleStartPos, toggleMoved = false, nil, nil, false
    MobileToggle.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            toggleDragging = true
            toggleMoved = false
            toggleDragStart = input.Position
            toggleStartPos = MobileToggle.Position
        end
    end)
    UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if toggleDragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
            local delta = input.Position - toggleDragStart
            if delta.Magnitude > 8 then toggleMoved = true end
            if toggleStartPos then
                local newPos = UDim2.new(
                    toggleStartPos.X.Scale, toggleStartPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
                    toggleStartPos.Y.Scale, toggleStartPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
                )
                MobileToggle.Position = newPos
                userMovedTogglePos = newPos
            end
        end
    end)
    UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            toggleDragging = false
            if toggleMoved then task.delay(0.15, function() toggleMoved = false end) end
        end
    end)

    local isAnimatingUI = false
    local currentUIAnimation = "Pop"
    local uiAnimDuration = 0.28
    _G.SpookySetUIAnimation = function(name, dur)
        local allowed = {Pop=true, Bounce=true, SlideUp=true, SlideDown=true, ZoomSmooth=true, Fade=true}
        if allowed[name] then currentUIAnimation = name end
        local duration = tonumber(dur)
        if duration and duration == duration then uiAnimDuration = math.clamp(duration, 0.1, 0.6) end
        if _G.SpookyUpdateAnimButtonsVisual then
            _G.SpookyUpdateAnimButtonsVisual(currentUIAnimation)
        end
    end
    _G.SpookyGetUIAnimation = function()
        return currentUIAnimation, uiAnimDuration
    end

    local function showMobileBtn()
        MobileToggle.Position = userMovedTogglePos or UDim2.new(0, 20, 0, 80)
        MobileToggle.Size = UDim2.new(0, 52, 0, 52)
        MobileToggle.Visible = true
        isAnimatingUI = false
    end

    local uiAnimationToken = 0
    local uiMotionTweens = {}
    local uiRequestedVisible = nil
    local lastUIToggleInput = nil
    local fadeConnection, fadeValue = nil, nil
    local fadeOriginals = {}
    local function resetUIFade()
        if fadeConnection then fadeConnection:Disconnect(); fadeConnection = nil end
        if fadeValue then fadeValue:Destroy(); fadeValue = nil end
        for obj, properties in pairs(fadeOriginals) do
            if obj.Parent then
                for property, value in pairs(properties) do obj[property] = value end
            end
        end
        table.clear(fadeOriginals)
    end
    local function collectUIFade(obj)
        if obj:IsA("GuiObject") and not obj.Visible then return end
        local properties = {}
        if obj:IsA("GuiObject") then properties.BackgroundTransparency = obj.BackgroundTransparency end
        if obj:IsA("TextLabel") or obj:IsA("TextButton") or obj:IsA("TextBox") then
            properties.TextTransparency = obj.TextTransparency
            properties.TextStrokeTransparency = obj.TextStrokeTransparency
        elseif obj:IsA("ImageLabel") or obj:IsA("ImageButton") then
            properties.ImageTransparency = obj.ImageTransparency
        elseif obj:IsA("UIStroke") then
            properties.Transparency = obj.Transparency
        end
        if next(properties) then fadeOriginals[obj] = properties end
        for _, child in ipairs(obj:GetChildren()) do collectUIFade(child) end
    end
    local function setUIVisibility(visible)
        if not isCurrentSession() or (visible and not isKeyValidLocal) then return end
        visible = visible == true
        uiRequestedVisible = visible
        uiAnimationToken += 1
        local token = uiAnimationToken
        for _, tween in ipairs(uiMotionTweens) do tween:Cancel() end
        table.clear(uiMotionTweens)
        resetUIFade()
        isAnimatingUI = true
        local scale = tonumber(userCustomScale or currentBaseScale or _G.InitialUIScaleVal) or 0.85
        local base = lastUIPos or UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
        local duration = math.clamp(tonumber(uiAnimDuration) or 0.28, 0.1, 0.6)
        if not visible then duration *= 0.75 end
        if _G.SpookyFloatTween then pcall(function() _G.SpookyFloatTween:Pause() end) end
        MAINUIframe.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
        MobileToggle.Visible = true
        local mode = currentUIAnimation
        local offset = mode == "SlideDown" and -80 or (mode == "SlideUp" and 80 or 0)
        local startPosition = base + UDim2.fromOffset(0, offset)
        local factor = mode == "ZoomSmooth" and 0.72 or (mode == "Pop" and 0.88 or (mode == "Bounce" and 0.80 or 1))
        local compact = scale * factor
        local wasVisible = MAINUIframe.Visible
        MAINUIframe.Visible = true
        if visible and not wasVisible then
            MAINUIframe.Position = startPosition
            UIScale.Scale = compact
        end
        local style = visible and (mode == "Pop" and Enum.EasingStyle.Back or (mode == "Bounce" and Enum.EasingStyle.Bounce or Enum.EasingStyle.Quint)) or Enum.EasingStyle.Quad
        local info = TweenInfo.new(duration, style, visible and Enum.EasingDirection.Out or Enum.EasingDirection.In)
        local motion = TweenService:Create(MAINUIframe, info, {Position = visible and base or startPosition})
        local zoom = TweenService:Create(UIScale, info, {Scale = visible and scale or compact})
        table.insert(uiMotionTweens, motion); table.insert(uiMotionTweens, zoom)
        motion:Play(); zoom:Play()
        if mode == "Fade" then
            collectUIFade(MAINUIframe)
            fadeValue = Instance.new("NumberValue")
            fadeValue.Value = visible and 1 or 0
            local function applyFade(value)
                for obj, properties in pairs(fadeOriginals) do
                    if obj.Parent then
                        for property, original in pairs(properties) do obj[property] = original + (1 - original) * value end
                    end
                end
            end
            applyFade(fadeValue.Value)
            fadeConnection = fadeValue.Changed:Connect(applyFade)
            local fadeTween = TweenService:Create(fadeValue, info, {Value = visible and 0 or 1})
            table.insert(uiMotionTweens, fadeTween)
            fadeTween:Play()
        end
        task.delay(duration, function()
            if token ~= uiAnimationToken or not isCurrentSession() or not MAINUIframe.Parent then return end
            MAINUIframe.Visible = visible
            resetUIFade()
            MAINUIframe.Position = base
            UIScale.Scale = scale
            isAnimatingUI = false
            if visible and _G.SpookyFloatTween then pcall(function() _G.SpookyFloatTween:Play() end) end
            if not visible then showMobileBtn() end
        end)
    end
    _G.SpookyToggleUI = function(input)
        if not isCurrentSession() or not isKeyValidLocal then return end
        if input and input == lastUIToggleInput then return end
        lastUIToggleInput = input
        local visible = MAINUIframe.Visible
        if isAnimatingUI and uiRequestedVisible ~= nil then visible = uiRequestedVisible end
        setUIVisibility(not visible)
    end

    _G.SpookySetUIVisibility = setUIVisibility

    _G.SpookyPreviewAnimation = function()
        if isAnimatingUI then return end
        if not MAINUIframe.Visible then
            setUIVisibility(true)
        else
            setUIVisibility(false)
            local previewToken = uiAnimationToken
            task.delay(math.clamp(tonumber(uiAnimDuration) or 0.28, 0.1, 0.6) + 0.15, function()
                if previewToken ~= uiAnimationToken or not isCurrentSession() then return end
                setUIVisibility(true)
            end)
        end
    end

    local function onCloseScript()
        if isAnimatingUI then return end
        isAnimatingUI = true
        local tw = TweenService:Create(UIScale, TweenInfo.new(0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.In), { Scale = 0.02 })
        tw:Play()
        task.delay(0.22, function()
            performFullScriptShutdown()
        end)
    end
    CloseBtn.Activated:Connect(onCloseScript)

    local function handleToggleOpen()
        if toggleMoved or not isKeyValidLocal or not isCurrentSession() then return end
        _G.SpookyToggleUI()
    end
    MinimizeBtn.Activated:Connect(function() setUIVisibility(false) end)
    MobileToggle.Activated:Connect(handleToggleOpen)
    registerConnection(UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gpe)
        if gpe or not isKeyValidLocal or not isCurrentSession() or UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox() then return end
        if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.RightControl or input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Insert then
            _G.SpookyToggleUI(input)
        end
    end))

    _G.SpookyThemeAccents = ThemeAccents

    local function loadEarlyThemeConfig()
        pcall(function()
            if isfile and isfile("ProjectSpooky_UIConfig.json") and readfile and HttpService then
                local raw = readfile("ProjectSpooky_UIConfig.json")
                if raw and #raw > 5 then
                    local data = HttpService:JSONDecode(raw)
                    if data and type(data) == "table" and data.theme then
                        CurrentTheme = data.theme
                        _G.CurrentTheme = data.theme
                        local th = ThemeAccents[data.theme]
                        if th then
                            _G.CurrentAccentColor = th.accent
                            _G.CurrentAccentColorBright = th.bright
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end)
    end
    loadEarlyThemeConfig()

    launchProjectSpooky = function()
        MAINUIframe.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
        MAINUIframe.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
        MAINUIframe.Visible = false
        if MobileToggle then MobileToggle.Visible = false end
        updateMobileScaling()
        UIScale.Scale = currentBaseScale or 1.0

        local function revealSpookyUI()
            if not isCurrentSession() or not MAINUIframe.Parent then return end
            setUIVisibility(true)
            if MobileToggle then MobileToggle.Visible = true end
            if showTab then pcall(function() showTab("Home") end) end
            if showHomeSubView then pcall(function() showHomeSubView("Dashboard") end) end
        end

        if _G.SpookyStartupLoaderFinished then
            revealSpookyUI()
        else
            _G.SpookyOnStartupLoaderFinished = revealSpookyUI
        end
    end

    launchProjectSpooky()
end

local translateTerm = nil
local function makeCard(parent, titleEN, titleES, h, y)
    local card = Instance.new("Frame")
    card:SetAttribute("SpookyControlGroup", titleEN)
    card.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, h)
    card.Position = UDim2.new(0, 5, 0, y)
    card.BackgroundColor3 = _G.SpookyGlassModeActive and Color3.fromRGB(10, 10, 14) or Color3.fromRGB(11, 11, 16)
    card.BackgroundTransparency = _G.SpookyGlassModeActive and 0.30 or 0
    card.BorderSizePixel = 0
    card.Parent = parent
    card.ClipsDescendants = false
    Instance.new("UICorner", card).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)

    local cardGrad = Instance.new("UIGradient", card)
    cardGrad.Color = ColorSequence.new({
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(16, 16, 24)),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(10, 10, 15))
    })
    cardGrad.Rotation = 90

    local cStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", card)
    cStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(38, 36, 52)
    cStroke.Thickness = 1.1
    cStroke.Transparency = _G.SpookyGlassModeActive and 0.25 or 0
    table.insert(AllCardFrames, card)

    if isSpookyTransparentActive then
        card.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(5, 5, 10)
        card.BackgroundTransparency = _G.SpookyGlassAlpha
        if cStroke then cStroke.Transparency = 0.40 end
    end

    local cardTop = Instance.new("Frame", card)
    cardTop.Name = "CardHeader"
    cardTop.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 22)
    cardTop.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
    cardTop.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    cardTop.BorderSizePixel = 0

    local spookyHeaderIcon = Instance.new("ImageLabel", cardTop)
    spookyHeaderIcon.Name = "HeaderEmblem"
    spookyHeaderIcon.Size = UDim2.new(0, 13, 0, 13)
    spookyHeaderIcon.Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0.5, -6.5)
    spookyHeaderIcon.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    spookyHeaderIcon.Image = (CurrentTheme == "Red Spooky") and "rbxassetid://88089153116193" or "rbxassetid://124747708335361"
    spookyHeaderIcon.ImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 210, 235)
    spookyHeaderIcon.ZIndex = 3
    Instance.new("UICorner", spookyHeaderIcon).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
    if _G.SpookyThemedElements and _G.SpookyThemedElements.AllHeaderEmblems then
        table.insert(_G.SpookyThemedElements.AllHeaderEmblems, spookyHeaderIcon)
    end

    local hdr = Instance.new("TextLabel", cardTop)
    hdr.Name = "HeaderTitle"
    hdr.Size = UDim2.new(1, -26, 1, 0)
    hdr.Position = UDim2.new(0, 25, 0, 0)
    hdr.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    hdr.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    hdr.Text = translateTerm and translateTerm(titleEN, titleES, CurrentLang) or ((CurrentLang == "EN") and titleEN or titleES)
    hdr.TextSize = 11
    hdr.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 252)
    hdr.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    hdr.ZIndex = 3

    local hairline = Instance.new("Frame", card)
    hairline.Name = "HeaderHairline"
    hairline.Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 1)
    hairline.Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 22)
    hairline.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(32, 32, 42)
    hairline.BorderSizePixel = 0

    table.insert(TranslatableUI, {
        label = hdr,
        en = titleEN,
        es = titleES,
        isHeader = true
    })
    return card
end

local function createToggleButton(parent, name, textEN, textES, size, pos, isSub)
    local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    btn.Name = name
    btn.Size = size
    btn.Position = pos
    btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(16, 16, 18)
    btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    btn.Text = ""
    btn.AutoButtonColor = true
    btn.Parent = parent
    btn.ClipsDescendants = true
    Instance.new("UICorner", btn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 9)
    local btnStk = Instance.new("UIStroke", btn)
    btnStk.Color = Color3.fromRGB(36, 36, 42)
    btnStk.Thickness = 1.2

    local txtLbl = Instance.new("TextLabel", btn)
    txtLbl.Name = "TitleLabel"
    txtLbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, -38, 1, 0)
    txtLbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 0)
    txtLbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    txtLbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    txtLbl.Text = translateTerm and translateTerm(textEN, textES, CurrentLang) or ((CurrentLang == "EN") and textEN or textES)
    txtLbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    txtLbl.TextSize = isSub and 10.5 or 11.5
    txtLbl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 215)
    txtLbl.ClipsDescendants = true
    txtLbl.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
    txtLbl.ZIndex = 3
    txtLbl.Active = false

    local switchPill = Instance.new("Frame", btn)
    switchPill.Name = "SwitchPill"
    switchPill.Size = UDim2.new(0, 24, 0, 13)
    switchPill.Position = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0.5, -6.5)
    switchPill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(26, 26, 34)
    switchPill.BorderSizePixel = 0
    switchPill.ZIndex = 3
    switchPill.Active = false
    Instance.new("UICorner", switchPill).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
    local pillStk = Instance.new("UIStroke", switchPill)
    pillStk.Color = Color3.fromRGB(48, 48, 62)
    pillStk.Thickness = 1

    local switchKnob = Instance.new("Frame", switchPill)
    switchKnob.Name = "SwitchKnob"
    switchKnob.Size = UDim2.new(0, 9, 0, 9)
    switchKnob.Position = UDim2.new(0, 2, 0.5, -4.5)
    switchKnob.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(80, 80, 95)
    switchKnob.BorderSizePixel = 0
    switchKnob.ZIndex = 4
    switchKnob.Active = false
    Instance.new("UICorner", switchKnob).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

    ToggleButtons[name] = {
        btn = btn,
        txtLbl = txtLbl,
        spookyIcon = nil,
        iconStk = nil,
        btnStk = btnStk,
        switchPill = switchPill,
        pillStk = pillStk,
        switchKnob = switchKnob,
        textEN = textEN,
        textES = textES,
        text = textEN
    }
    Spooky.ToggleCopies[name] = Spooky.ToggleCopies[name] or {}
    table.insert(Spooky.ToggleCopies[name], ToggleButtons[name])
    if FeatureStates[name] == nil then FeatureStates[name] = false end
    updateToggleVisual(name, FeatureStates[name])
    Spooky.RegisterControl(btn,name,textEN,textES,function() toggleFeature(name) end)
    table.insert(TranslatableUI, {
        txtLbl = txtLbl,
        btn = btn,
        rawEN = textEN,
        rawES = textES,
        isToggle = true,
        toggleName = name
    })
    table.insert(AllUIButtons, btn)

    local lastToggleClick = 0
    local function onToggleActivated()
        local now = os.clock()
        if now - lastToggleClick < 0.12 then return end
        lastToggleClick = now
        toggleFeature(name)
    end
    btn.Activated:Connect(onToggleActivated)
    return btn
end
local function createActionButton(parent, textEN, textES, size, pos, onClick)
    local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    btn.Size = size
    btn.Position = pos
    btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 26)
    btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    btn.Text = ""
    btn.AutoButtonColor = true
    btn.Parent = parent
    btn.ClipsDescendants = true
    Instance.new("UICorner", btn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 7)
    local aStk = Instance.new("UIStroke", btn)
    aStk.Color = Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 58)
    aStk.Thickness = 1

    local txtLbl = Instance.new("TextLabel", btn)
    txtLbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 1, 0)
    txtLbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 5, 0, 0)
    txtLbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    txtLbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    txtLbl.Text = translateTerm and translateTerm(textEN, textES, CurrentLang) or ((CurrentLang == "EN") and textEN or textES)
    txtLbl.TextSize = 11.5
    txtLbl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(235, 235, 245)
    txtLbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
    txtLbl.ZIndex = 3
    txtLbl.Active = false

    local isClearingBtnText = false
    btn:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
        if isClearingBtnText then return end
        if btn.Text ~= "" then
            isClearingBtnText = true
            txtLbl.Text = btn.Text
            btn.Text = ""
            isClearingBtnText = false
        end
    end)

    btn.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
        local curAccent = _G.CurrentAccentColor or Color3.fromRGB(65, 145, 255)
        TweenService:Create(btn, TweenInfo.new(0.12), { BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 26, 36) }):Play()
        TweenService:Create(aStk, TweenInfo.new(0.12), { Color = curAccent }):Play()
    end)
    btn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
        TweenService:Create(btn, TweenInfo.new(0.12), { BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 26) }):Play()
        TweenService:Create(aStk, TweenInfo.new(0.12), { Color = Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 58) }):Play()
    end)
    if onClick then
        local lastActionClick = 0
        local function onActionActivated()
            local now = os.clock()
            if now - lastActionClick < 0.12 then return end
            lastActionClick = now
            onClick()
        end
        Spooky.RegisterControl(btn,nil,textEN,textES,onActionActivated)
        btn.Activated:Connect(onActionActivated)
    end
    table.insert(TranslatableUI, {
        txtLbl = txtLbl,
        btn = btn,
        en = textEN,
        es = textES
    })
    table.insert(AllUIButtons, btn)
    return btn
end

local function createSlider(parent, textEN, textES, minV, maxV, defV, isFloat, step, suffix, callback, pos)
    local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
    frame.Size = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0, 38)
    frame.Position = pos or UDim2.new(0, 6, 0, 26)
    frame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    frame.Parent = parent

    local titleLbl = Instance.new("TextLabel", frame)
    titleLbl.Size = UDim2.new(0.65, 0, 0, 16)
    titleLbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, 0)
    titleLbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    titleLbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    titleLbl.Text = translateTerm and translateTerm(textEN, textES, CurrentLang) or ((CurrentLang == "EN") and textEN or textES)
    titleLbl.TextSize = 11
    titleLbl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(210, 210, 225)
    titleLbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left

    local sfx = suffix or ""
    local valLbl = Instance.new("TextLabel", frame)
    valLbl.Size = UDim2.new(0.35, -4, 0, 16)
    valLbl.Position = UDim2.new(0.65, 0, 0, 0)
    valLbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    valLbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    valLbl.Text = isFloat and string.format("%.2f%s", defV, sfx) or string.format("%d%s", math.floor(defV), sfx)
    valLbl.TextSize = 11
    valLbl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    valLbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right

    local track = Instance.new("Frame", frame)
    track.Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 6)
    track.Position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, 24)
    track.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(22, 22, 30)
    track.BorderSizePixel = 0
    Instance.new("UICorner", track).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
    local trStk = Instance.new("UIStroke", track)
    trStk.Color = Color3.fromRGB(42, 42, 55)
    trStk.Thickness = 1

    local fill = Instance.new("Frame", track)
    local curPct = math.clamp((defV - minV) / (maxV - minV), 0, 1)
    fill.Size = UDim2.new(curPct, 0, 1, 0)
    fill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(195, 205, 230)
    fill.BorderSizePixel = 0
    Instance.new("UICorner", fill).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

    local knob = Instance.new("ImageButton", track)
    knob.Size = UDim2.new(0, 18, 0, 18)
    knob.Position = UDim2.new(curPct, -9, 0.5, -9)
    knob.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(16, 16, 22)
    knob.Image = "rbxassetid://124747708335361"
    knob.BorderSizePixel = 0
    knob.ZIndex = 5
    Instance.new("UICorner", knob).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
    local knStk = Instance.new("UIStroke", knob)
    knStk.Color = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 255)
    knStk.Thickness = 1.5

    local isDragging = false
    local function updateValue(inputX)
        local absPos = track.AbsolutePosition.X
        local absSize = track.AbsoluteSize.X
        if absSize <= 0 then return end
        local pct = math.clamp((inputX - absPos) / absSize, 0, 1)
        local rawVal = minV + pct * (maxV - minV)
        if step and step > 0 then
            rawVal = math.floor(rawVal / step + 0.5) * step
        end
        rawVal = math.clamp(rawVal, minV, maxV)
        pct = (rawVal - minV) / (maxV - minV)
        fill.Size = UDim2.new(pct, 0, 1, 0)
        knob.Position = UDim2.new(pct, -9, 0.5, -9)
        valLbl.Text = isFloat and string.format("%.2f%s", rawVal, sfx) or string.format("%d%s", math.floor(rawVal), sfx)
        if callback then callback(rawVal) end
    end

    knob.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            isDragging = true
            updateValue(input.Position.X)
        end
    end)
    track.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            isDragging = true
            updateValue(input.Position.X)
        end
    end)
    UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if isDragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
            updateValue(input.Position.X)
        end
    end)
    UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            isDragging = false
        end
    end)

    table.insert(TranslatableUI, {
        label = titleLbl,
        en = textEN,
        es = textES
    })
    return frame
end
local function createCycleButton(parent, prefixEN, prefixES, choices, defaultIdx, size, pos, onChange)
    local currentIdx = defaultIdx or 1
    local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    btn.Size = size
    btn.Position = pos
    btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(16, 16, 22)
    btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    local pre = translateTerm and translateTerm(prefixEN, prefixES, CurrentLang) or ((CurrentLang == "EN") and prefixEN or prefixES)
    btn.Text = ""
    btn.AutoButtonColor = true
    btn.Parent = parent
    btn.ClipsDescendants = true
    Instance.new("UICorner", btn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 7)
    local cStk = Instance.new("UIStroke", btn)
    cStk.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
    cStk.Color = Color3.fromRGB(42, 42, 54)
    cStk.Thickness = 1

    local txtLbl = Instance.new("TextLabel", btn)
    txtLbl.Name = "CycleText"
    txtLbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, -26, 1, 0)
    txtLbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 0)
    txtLbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    txtLbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    txtLbl.Text = string.format("%s: %s", pre, tostring(choices[currentIdx]))
    txtLbl.TextSize = 11
    txtLbl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(225, 225, 240)
    txtLbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    txtLbl.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
    txtLbl.ZIndex = 3

    local arrowLbl = Instance.new("TextLabel", btn)
    arrowLbl.Name = "ArrowIndicator"
    arrowLbl.Size = UDim2.new(0, 16, 1, 0)
    arrowLbl.Position = UDim2.new(1, -18, 0, 0)
    arrowLbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    arrowLbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    arrowLbl.Text = "v"
    arrowLbl.TextSize = 8.5
    arrowLbl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(130, 135, 155)
    arrowLbl.ZIndex = 3

    btn.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
        local curAccent = _G.CurrentAccentColor or Color3.fromRGB(65, 145, 255)
        TweenService:Create(btn, TweenInfo.new(0.12), { BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(24, 26, 36) }):Play()
        TweenService:Create(cStk, TweenInfo.new(0.12), { Color = curAccent }):Play()
        TweenService:Create(arrowLbl, TweenInfo.new(0.12), { TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 245, 255) }):Play()
    end)
    btn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
        TweenService:Create(btn, TweenInfo.new(0.12), { BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(16, 16, 22) }):Play()
        TweenService:Create(cStk, TweenInfo.new(0.12), { Color = Color3.fromRGB(42, 42, 54) }):Play()
        TweenService:Create(arrowLbl, TweenInfo.new(0.12), { TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(130, 135, 155) }):Play()
    end)

    table.insert(TranslatableUI, {
        btn = btn,
        txtLbl = txtLbl,
        prefixEN = prefixEN,
        prefixES = prefixES,
        getChoice = function() return tostring(choices[currentIdx]) end,
        isCycle = true
    })
    table.insert(AllUIButtons, btn)
    if isSpookyTransparentActive then
        btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 22)
        btn.BackgroundTransparency = _G.SpookyGlassAlpha
    end
    local lastCycleClick = 0
    local function onCycleActivated()
        local now = os.clock()
        if now - lastCycleClick < 0.12 then return end
        lastCycleClick = now
        currentIdx = (currentIdx % #choices) + 1
        local choice = choices[currentIdx]
        local p = translateTerm and translateTerm(prefixEN, prefixES, CurrentLang) or ((CurrentLang == "EN") and prefixEN or prefixES)
        txtLbl.Text = string.format("%s: %s", p, tostring(choice))
        if onChange then onChange(choice, currentIdx) end
    end
    btn.Activated:Connect(onCycleActivated)
    btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(onCycleActivated)
    return btn
end

local function styleSpookyTextBox(box)
    if not box or not box:IsA("TextBox") then return end
    if box.Text == "TextBox" or box.Text == "textbox" then
        box.Text = ""
    end
    box.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(16, 16, 22)
    box.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 250)
    box.PlaceholderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(125, 130, 150)
    box.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
    if not box:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner") then
        Instance.new("UICorner", box).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
    end
    local stk = box:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
    if not stk then
        stk = Instance.new("UIStroke", box)
    end
    stk.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
    stk.Color = Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 58)
    stk.Thickness = 1

    if not box:FindFirstChild("SpookyBoxEmblem") and not box.MultiLine then
        local emblem = Instance.new("ImageLabel", box)
        emblem.Name = "SpookyBoxEmblem"
        emblem.Size = UDim2.new(0, 16, 0, 16)
        emblem.Position = UDim2.new(1, -22, 0.5, -8)
        emblem.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        emblem.Image = "rbxassetid://124747708335361"
        emblem.ImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(130, 135, 155)
        emblem.ZIndex = box.ZIndex + 1
        Instance.new("UICorner", emblem).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

        box.Focused:Connect(function()
            TweenService:Create(stk, TweenInfo.new(0.15), { Color = Color3.fromRGB(180, 195, 230) }):Play()
            TweenService:Create(emblem, TweenInfo.new(0.15), { ImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255) }):Play()
        end)
        box.FocusLost:Connect(function()
            TweenService:Create(stk, TweenInfo.new(0.15), { Color = Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 58) }):Play()
            TweenService:Create(emblem, TweenInfo.new(0.15), { ImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(130, 135, 155) }):Play()
        end)
    else
        box.Focused:Connect(function()
            TweenService:Create(stk, TweenInfo.new(0.15), { Color = Color3.fromRGB(180, 195, 230) }):Play()
        end)
        box.FocusLost:Connect(function()
            TweenService:Create(stk, TweenInfo.new(0.15), { Color = Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 58) }):Play()
        end)
    end
end

translateTerm = function(enText, esText, targetLang)
    if not targetLang or targetLang == "" then targetLang = CurrentLang or "EN" end
    if targetLang == "ES" and esText and esText ~= "" then return esText end
    if targetLang == "EN" and enText and enText ~= "" then return enText end
    local match = (enText and UI_DICTIONARY[enText]) or (esText and UI_DICTIONARY[esText])
    if match and match[targetLang] then
        return match[targetLang]
    end
    if targetLang == "ES" then return esText or enText or "" end
    return enText or esText or ""
end

applyLanguage = function(lang, silent)
    if lang == "ES" or lang == "EN" or lang == "PT" or lang == "TL" or lang == "FR" then
        CurrentLang = lang
    else
        CurrentLang = "EN"
    end
    _G.Spooky_CurrentLang = CurrentLang
    if _G.SpookyRefreshFloatingWidgets then _G.SpookyRefreshFloatingWidgets() end
    if _G.SpookyRefreshControlPicker then _G.SpookyRefreshControlPicker() end
    pcall(function()
        if writefile then writefile("spooky_lang.txt", CurrentLang) end
    end)

    if NavButtons then
        for tabId, btnData in pairs(NavButtons) do
            if btnData and btnData.lbl then
                local trans = TAB_TRANSLATIONS[tabId]
                if trans then
                    btnData.lbl.Text = trans[CurrentLang] or trans.EN or btnData.lbl.Text
                end
            end
        end
    end

    for _, item in ipairs(TranslatableUI) do
        pcall(function()
            if item.isHeader and item.label then
                item.label.Text = translateTerm(item.en, item.es, CurrentLang)
            elseif item.isToggle then
                local tr = translateTerm(item.rawEN, item.rawES, CurrentLang)
                if item.txtLbl then item.txtLbl.Text = tr end
                if item.btn then item.btn.Text = "" end
                if item.toggleName and ToggleButtons[item.toggleName] then
                    ToggleButtons[item.toggleName].text = tr
                end
            elseif item.isCycle and (item.txtLbl or item.btn) then
                local p = translateTerm(item.prefixEN, item.prefixES, CurrentLang)
                local choice = item.getChoice and item.getChoice() or ""
                if item.txtLbl then
                    item.txtLbl.Text = string.format("%s: %s", p, choice)
                else
                    item.btn.Text = string.format("  %s: %s", p, choice)
                end
            elseif item.txtLbl then
                item.txtLbl.Text = translateTerm(item.en, item.es, CurrentLang)
                if item.btn then item.btn.Text = "" end
            elseif item.label then
                item.label.Text = translateTerm(item.en, item.es, CurrentLang)
            elseif item.btn then
                item.btn.Text = translateTerm(item.en, item.es, CurrentLang)
            end
        end)
    end

    if btnDash then
        local tDash = { ES = "Panel", EN = "Dashboard", PT = "Painel", TL = "Panel", FR = "Panneau" }
        btnDash.Text = tDash[CurrentLang] or "Dashboard"
    end
    if btnCustoms then
        local tCust = { ES = "Personalizar", EN = "UI Customs", PT = "Personalizar", TL = "I-customize", FR = "Personnaliser" }

    end
    if btnConfigs then
        local tConf = { ES = "Ajustes", EN = "Configs", PT = "Configuracoes", TL = "Mga Config", FR = "Configs" }
        btnConfigs.Text = tConf[CurrentLang] or "Configs"
    end
    if _G.btnTogglePicture then
        local isPic = (CurrentLang == "ES" and "Imagen: ") or (CurrentLang == "PT" and "Imagem: ") or (CurrentLang == "FR" and "Image: ") or "Picture: "
        _G.btnTogglePicture.Text = isPic .. (_G.isPictureVisible and "ON" or "OFF")
    end
    if btnToggleTransparent then
        local isTr = (CurrentLang == "ES" and "Transparente: ") or (CurrentLang == "PT" and "Transparente: ") or (CurrentLang == "FR" and "Transparent: ") or "Transparent UI: "
        btnToggleTransparent.Text = isTr .. (isSpookyTransparentActive and "ON" or "OFF")
    end
    if autoBountyMainBtn then
        local abActive = (getgenv().SpookyAutoBountyEnabled == true) or (FeatureStates["AutoBounty"] == true)
        if CurrentLang == "ES" then
            autoBountyMainBtn.Text = abActive and "Detener Auto Bounty" or "Activar Auto Bounty"
        elseif CurrentLang == "PT" then
            autoBountyMainBtn.Text = abActive and "Parar Auto Bounty" or "Ativar Auto Bounty"
        elseif CurrentLang == "FR" then
            autoBountyMainBtn.Text = abActive and "Arreter Auto Bounty" or "Activer Auto Bounty"
        elseif CurrentLang == "TL" then
            autoBountyMainBtn.Text = abActive and "Itigil ang Auto Bounty" or "Paganahin ang Auto Bounty"
        else
            autoBountyMainBtn.Text = abActive and "Stop Auto Bounty" or "Activate Auto Bounty"
        end
    end
    if fruitVBtn then
        local isBlocked = (getgenv().BlockFruitV == true)
        local fvPrefix = (CurrentLang == "ES" and "Bloquear Fruit V: ") or (CurrentLang == "PT" and "Bloquear Fruit V: ") or (CurrentLang == "FR" and "Bloquer Fruit V: ") or "Block Fruit V: "
        fruitVBtn.Text = fvPrefix .. (isBlocked and "ON" or "OFF")
    end
    if not silent then
        local msgs = {
            ES = "Idioma cambiado a Espanol",
            EN = "Language changed to English",
            PT = "Idioma alterado para Portugues",
            TL = "Wika pinalitan sa Tagalog",
            FR = "Langue changee en Francais"
        }
        notifyToggle(msgs[CurrentLang] or "Language switched", true)
    end
end
