local currentIslandTween = nil
local isTweeningIsland = false
local islandNoclipConn = nil
local activeTweenTargetName = nil
local onIslandTweenStateChanged = nil
local function CheckNearestTeleporter(targetPos)
    local pos = typeof(targetPos) == "CFrame" and targetPos.Position or targetPos
    local minDist = math.huge
    local nearest = nil
    local placeId = game.PlaceId
    local teleporters = {}
    if placeId == 7449423635 or placeId == 100117331123089 then
        teleporters = {
            ["Floating Turtle"] = Vector3.new(-12462, 375, -7552),
            ["Hydra Island"] = Vector3.new(5657.88, 1013.08, -335.50),
            Mansion = Vector3.new(-12462, 375, -7552),
            Castle = Vector3.new(-5036, 315, -3179),
            ["Temple of Time"] = Vector3.new(28286, 14897, 103)
        }
    elseif placeId == 4442272183 or placeId == 79091703265657 then
        teleporters = {
            ["Swan Mansion"] = Vector3.new(-390, 332, 673),
            ["Swan Room"] = Vector3.new(2285, 15, 905),
            ["Cursed Ship"] = Vector3.new(923, 126, 32852),
            ["Zombie Island"] = Vector3.new(-6509, 83, -133)
        }
    else
        teleporters = {
            Sky3 = Vector3.new(-7894, 5547, -380),
            ["Underwater City"] = Vector3.new(61165.19, 0.19, 1897.38),
            ["Pirate Village"] = Vector3.new(-1242.46, 4.79, 3901.28)
        }
    end
    local myHrp = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local myPos = myHrp and myHrp.Position or Vector3.zero
    for _, tpPos in pairs(teleporters) do
        local d = (tpPos - pos).Magnitude
        if d < minDist then
            minDist = d
            nearest = tpPos
        end
    end
    if minDist <= (pos - myPos).Magnitude - 150 then
        return nearest
    end
    return nil
end
local function stopIslandTween()
    _G.stopIslandTween = stopIslandTween
    isTweeningIsland = false
    activeIslandTargetCF = nil
    activeTweenTargetName = nil
    if currentIslandTween then
        pcall(function() currentIslandTween:Cancel() end)
        currentIslandTween = nil
    end
    if islandNoclipConn then
        pcall(function() islandNoclipConn:Disconnect() end)
        islandNoclipConn = nil
    end
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if char then
        local pt = char:FindFirstChild("PartTele")
        if pt then pcall(function() pt:Destroy() end) end
        local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if hrp then hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero end
    end
    if onIslandTweenStateChanged then onIslandTweenStateChanged(false) end
    notifyToggle("Island Tween: STOPPED (OFF)", false)
end
local activeIslandTargetCF = nil
local function updateRunningIslandTweenSpeed()
    if isTweeningIsland and currentIslandTween and activeIslandTargetCF then
        local char = LocalPlayer.Character
        local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local partTele = char and char:FindFirstChild("PartTele")
        if hrp and partTele then
            pcall(function() currentIslandTween:Cancel() end)
            local dist = (activeIslandTargetCF.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude
            local speed = getgenv().IslandTweenSpeed or 350
            local t = math.max(dist / speed, 0.1)
            currentIslandTween = TweenService:Create(partTele, TweenInfo.new(t, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), { CFrame = activeIslandTargetCF })
            currentIslandTween:Play()
            pcall(function()
                currentIslandTween.Completed:Connect(function(playbackState)
                    if playbackState == Enum.PlaybackState.Completed then
                        stopIslandTween()
                        notifyToggle("Arrived at " .. (activeTweenTargetName or "Island") .. "!", true)
                    end
                end)
            end)
        end
    end
end
local function startIslandTween(targetCF, islandName)
    stopIslandTween()
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not hrp or not hum or (type(hum.Health) == "number" and hum.Health <= 0) then return end
    isTweeningIsland = true
    activeIslandTargetCF = targetCF
    activeTweenTargetName = islandName or "Island"
    if onIslandTweenStateChanged then onIslandTweenStateChanged(true, activeTweenTargetName) end
    notifyToggle("Tweening to " .. activeTweenTargetName .. " (ON)", true)
    pcall(function()
        local nearest = CheckNearestTeleporter(targetCF)
        if nearest then
            game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Remotes.CommF_:InvokeServer("requestEntrance", nearest)
            task.wait(0.4)
        end
    end)
    if not isTweeningIsland then return end
    islandNoclipConn = RunService.Stepped:Connect(function()
        if not isTweeningIsland then
            if islandNoclipConn then islandNoclipConn:Disconnect(); islandNoclipConn = nil end
            return
        end
        local c = LocalPlayer.Character
        if c then
            for _, p in ipairs(c:GetDescendants()) do
                if p:IsA("BasePart") then p.CanCollide = false end
            end
        end
    end)
    local partTele = char:FindFirstChild("PartTele")
    if not partTele then
        partTele = Instance.new("Part", char)
        partTele.Size = Vector3.new(10, 1, 10)
        partTele.Name = "PartTele"
        partTele.Anchored = true
        partTele.Transparency = 1
        partTele.CanCollide = false
        partTele.CFrame = hrp.CFrame
        partTele:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CFrame"):Connect(function()
            if isTweeningIsland and char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
                char.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = partTele.CFrame
                char.HumanoidRootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
            end
        end)
    end
    local dist = (targetCF.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude
    local speed = getgenv().IslandTweenSpeed or 350
    local t = math.max(dist / speed, 0.1)
    currentIslandTween = TweenService:Create(partTele, TweenInfo.new(t, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), { CFrame = targetCF })
    currentIslandTween:Play()
    pcall(function()
        if currentIslandTween and currentIslandTween.Completed and currentIslandTween.Completed.Connect then
            currentIslandTween.Completed:Connect(function(playbackState)
                if playbackState == Enum.PlaybackState.Completed then
                    stopIslandTween()
                    notifyToggle("Arrived at " .. (islandName or "Island") .. "!", true)
                end
            end)
        end
    end)
end
local ServerBrowserGui = nil
local BestServersGui = nil
local isFetchingServers = false
local function enableAntiTeleportFail()
    pcall(function()
        local CoreGui = game:GetService("CoreGui")
        local promptOverlay = CoreGui:FindFirstChild("RobloxPromptGui")
            and CoreGui.RobloxPromptGui:FindFirstChild("promptOverlay")
        if not promptOverlay then return end
        local function dismiss(v)
            if v and v.Name == "ErrorPrompt" then
                pcall(function()
                    v.Visible = false
                end)
                task.spawn(function()
                    task.wait(1)
                    local fn = _G.quickHopLowestPing or (type(quickHopLowestPing) == "function" and quickHopLowestPing)
                    if fn then fn() end
                end)
            end
        end
        for _, v in ipairs(promptOverlay:GetChildren()) do dismiss(v) end
        promptOverlay.ChildAdded:Connect(dismiss)
    end)
    pcall(function()
        TeleportService.TeleportInitFailed:Connect(function(player, teleportResult, errorMessage)
            notifyToggle("Teleport init failed. Retrying best server...", false)
            task.delay(1.5, function()
                local fn = _G.quickHopLowestPing or (type(quickHopLowestPing) == "function" and quickHopLowestPing)
                if fn then fn() end
            end)
        end)
    end)
end
local function checkInCombat()
    local inCombat = false
    pcall(function()
        local pGui = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
        local main = pGui and pGui:FindFirstChild("Main")
        local bList = main and main:FindFirstChild("BottomHUDList")
        local ic = bList and bList:FindFirstChild("InCombat")
        if ic and ic.Visible and ic.Text and (string.find(string.lower(ic.Text), "risk") or string.find(string.lower(ic.Text), "combat")) then
            inCombat = true
        end
    end)
    return inCombat
end
local isTeleporting = false
local function teleportToServer(jobId)
    if not jobId or jobId == "" or jobId == game.JobId then return false end
    if isTeleporting then return false end
    if checkInCombat() then
        notifyToggle("Cannot hop: In Combat (Risk)", false)
        return false
    end
    isTeleporting = true
    enableAntiTeleportFail()
    notifyToggle("Connecting to server (" .. string.sub(tostring(jobId), 1, 8) .. "...)", true)
    task.spawn(function()
        if string.find(tostring(jobId), "auto_hop") then
            pcall(function()
                TeleportService:Teleport(game.PlaceId, LocalPlayer)
            end)
            task.wait(6)
            isTeleporting = false
            return
        end
        local sb = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("__ServerBrowser")
        if sb then
            local ok = pcall(function()
                sb:InvokeServer("teleport", tostring(jobId))
            end)
            if ok then
                task.wait(6)
                isTeleporting = false
                return
            end
        end
        pcall(function()
            TeleportService:TeleportToPlaceInstance(game.PlaceId, tostring(jobId), LocalPlayer)
        end)
        task.wait(6)
        isTeleporting = false
    end)
    return true
end
local function rejoinCurrentServer()
    enableAntiTeleportFail()
    notifyToggle("Rejoining game...", true)
    local ok = false
    pcall(function()
        local sb = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("__ServerBrowser")
        if sb then
            sb:InvokeServer("teleport", game.JobId)
            ok = true
        end
    end)
    if not ok then
        pcall(function()
            TeleportService:Teleport(game.PlaceId, LocalPlayer)
        end)
    end
end
local selectedServerRegion = "United States"
local maxPlayerServerFilter = 10
local isFetchingServers = false
local cachedServerList = {}
local refreshServerDisplay = function() end
local function setServerRegion(region)
    selectedServerRegion = region or "Auto"
    pcall(function()
        local sbGui = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui") and LocalPlayer.PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("ServerBrowser")
        if sbGui and sbGui:FindFirstChild("Frame") and sbGui.Frame:FindFirstChild("Filters") and sbGui.Frame.Filters:FindFirstChild("SearchRegion") then
            sbGui.Frame.Filters.SearchRegion.TextBox.Text = (selectedServerRegion == "Auto") and "" or selectedServerRegion
        end
    end)
    notifyToggle("Region: " .. selectedServerRegion, true)
    if refreshServerDisplay then pcall(refreshServerDisplay) end
end
local function httpGetRaw(url)
    local req = (syn and syn.request) or (http and http.request) or http_request or (fluxus and fluxus.request) or request
    if req then
        local ok, r = pcall(function()
            return req({
                Url = url,
                Method = "GET",
                Headers = {
                    ["User-Agent"] = "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0.0.0 Safari/537.36"
                }
            })
        end)
        if ok and r and r.Body then return r.Body end
    end
    if game.HttpGet then
        local ok, res = pcall(function() return game:HttpGet(url) end)
        if ok and res and #res > 0 then return res end
    end
    return nil
end
local function fetchBestServers(onComplete)
    if isFetchingServers then
        if onComplete then onComplete(cachedServerList or {}) end
        return
    end
    isFetchingServers = true
    task.spawn(function()
        local serverList = {}
        local seenIds = {}
        local function finalize()
            table.sort(serverList, function(a, b)
                local pingA = (a.ping and a.ping > 0) and a.ping or 999
                local pingB = (b.ping and b.ping > 0) and b.ping or 999
                if pingA ~= pingB then
                    return pingA < pingB
                end
                return a.playing < b.playing
            end)
            cachedServerList = serverList
            isFetchingServers = false
            if onComplete then pcall(onComplete, serverList) end
        end
        pcall(function()
            local sbGui = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui") and LocalPlayer.PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("ServerBrowser")
            if sbGui and sbGui:FindFirstChild("Frame") and sbGui.Frame:FindFirstChild("Filters") and sbGui.Frame.Filters:FindFirstChild("SearchRegion") then
                sbGui.Frame.Filters.SearchRegion.TextBox.Text = (selectedServerRegion == "Auto") and "" or selectedServerRegion
            end
        end)
        pcall(function()
            local sb = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("__ServerBrowser")
            if sb then
                for page = 1, 8 do
                    local ok, data = pcall(function() return sb:InvokeServer(page) end)
                    if ok and type(data) == "table" then
                        for k, v in pairs(data) do
                            if type(v) == "table" and k ~= game.JobId and not seenIds[k] then
                                local cnt = tonumber(v.Count) or 0
                                if cnt > 0 and cnt < 12 then
                                    seenIds[k] = true
                                    table.insert(serverList, {
                                        id = tostring(k),
                                        playing = cnt,
                                        maxPlayers = 12,
                                        ping = 0,
                                        fps = 60,
                                        region = selectedServerRegion
                                    })
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end)
        pcall(function()
            local url = "https://games.roblox.com/v1/games/" .. tostring(game.PlaceId) .. "/servers/Public?sortOrder=Asc&limit=100&excludeFullGames=true"
            local res = httpGetRaw(url)
            if res then
                local parsed = HttpService:JSONDecode(res)
                if parsed and parsed.data then
                    for _, s in ipairs(parsed.data) do
                        if s.id and s.id ~= game.JobId and not seenIds[s.id] then
                            local playing = tonumber(s.playing) or 0
                            local maxPlayers = tonumber(s.maxPlayers) or 12
                            local ping = tonumber(s.ping) or 0
                            local fps = tonumber(s.fps) or 60
                            if playing < 12 then
                                seenIds[s.id] = true
                                table.insert(serverList, {
                                    id = tostring(s.id),
                                    playing = playing,
                                    maxPlayers = maxPlayers,
                                    ping = ping,
                                    fps = math.floor(fps + 0.5),
                                    region = selectedServerRegion
                                })
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end)
        finalize()
    end)
end
local function quickHopLowestPing(maxCount)
_G.quickHopLowestPing = quickHopLowestPing
    local maxC = maxCount or maxPlayerServerFilter or 9
    if checkInCombat() then
        notifyToggle("Cannot hop: In Combat (Risk)", false)
        return
    end
    notifyToggle("Searching optimal server...", true)
    task.spawn(function()
        local sb = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("__ServerBrowser")
        if sb then
            for page = 1, 15 do
                local ok, data = pcall(function() return sb:InvokeServer(page) end)
                if ok and type(data) == "table" then
                    for k, v in pairs(data) do
                        if k ~= game.JobId and type(v) == "table" then
                            local cnt = tonumber(v.Count) or 0
                            if cnt > 0 and cnt <= maxC then
                                notifyToggle("Found server (" .. tostring(cnt) .. " players), joining...", true)
                                pcall(function()
                                    sb:InvokeServer("teleport", tostring(k))
                                end)
                                task.wait(4)
                                return
                            end
                        end
                    end
                else
                    break
                end
            end
        end
        fetchBestServers(function(servers)
            for _, s in ipairs(servers) do
                if s.id ~= game.JobId and not string.find(tostring(s.id), "auto_hop") and s.playing <= maxC and s.playing > 0 then
                    teleportToServer(s.id)
                    return
                end
            end
            pcall(function()
                TeleportService:Teleport(game.PlaceId, LocalPlayer)
            end)
        end)
    end)
end
if type(getgenv) == "function" then
    pcall(function() getgenv().HopServer = quickHopLowestPing end)
end
local function openServerBrowserModal()
    if globalShowTab then
        globalShowTab("ServerBrowser")
    end
end
_G.OpenServerBrowser = openServerBrowserModal
_G.OpenBestServers = openServerBrowserModal
local IslandTeleportGui = nil
local function openIslandTeleportWindow()
    if IslandTeleportGui and IslandTeleportGui.Parent then
        IslandTeleportGui:Destroy()
        IslandTeleportGui = nil
        return
    end
    local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
    gui.Name = "SpookyIslandTeleport"
    gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
    safeParent(gui)
    IslandTeleportGui = gui
    local f = Instance.new("Frame", gui)
    f.Size = UDim2.new(0, 500, 0, 430)
    f.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -250, 0.5, -215)
    f.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(16, 16, 20)
    f.Active = true
    f.Draggable = true
    Instance.new("UICorner", f).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
    local st = Instance.new("UIStroke", f)
    st.Color = Color3.fromRGB(48, 48, 55)
    st.Thickness = 1.5

            nameLbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left

            onBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 52, 0, 24)
            onBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -114, 0.5, -12)

            offBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                stopIslandTween()
            end)

        scroll.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, #islands * 38 + 12)
    end
    local seaTabs = {
        { id = "Sea1", name = "Sea 1 (World 1)" },
        { id = "Sea2", name = "Sea 2 (World 2)" },

local openShipModWindow = nil

Spooky.Runtime = {}
function Spooky.Runtime.number(value, fallback, minimum, maximum)
    local n = tonumber(value)
    if not n or n ~= n or n == math.huge or n == -math.huge then n = fallback end
    return math.clamp(n, minimum, maximum)
end
function Spooky.Runtime.copy(value)
    if type(value) ~= "table" then return value end
    local result = {}
    for k, v in pairs(value) do result[k] = Spooky.Runtime.copy(v) end
    return result
end
function Spooky.Runtime.validWebhook(url)
    if type(url) ~= "string" then return false end
    return url:match("^https://discord%.com/api/webhooks/%d+/[%w_-]+$") ~= nil
        or url:match("^https://discordapp%.com/api/webhooks/%d+/[%w_-]+$") ~= nil
end
function Spooky.Runtime.httpStatus(response)
    if type(response) ~= "table" then return false, 0 end
    local status = tonumber(response.StatusCode or response.Status or response.status_code) or 0
    return status >= 200 and status < 300, status
end

do
    local VirtualInputManager = game:GetService("VirtualInputManager")
    local MacroRunning = false
    local MacroRunToken = 0

    local WeaponHelper = {}
    _G.SpookyWeaponHelper = WeaponHelper
    function WeaponHelper.toolToWeaponType(tool)
        if not tool or not tool:IsA("Tool") then return nil end
        if tool:GetAttribute("WeaponType") == "Gun" or tool:FindFirstChild("RemoteFunctionShoot") then return "Gun" end
        local tip = string.lower(tool.ToolTip or ""):gsub("%s+", " "):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") or ""
        if tip == "melee" then return "Melee"
        elseif tip == "blox fruit" or tip == "fruit" then return "Fruit"
        elseif tip == "sword" then return "Sword"
        elseif tip == "gun" then return "Gun" end
        local name = string.lower(tool.Name)
        if name:find("katana") or name:find("blade") or name:find("saber") or name:find("sword") or name:find("dagger") or name:find("trident") or name:find("cane") or name:find("pole") or name:find("scythe") or name:find("anchor") then
            return "Sword"
        elseif name:find("rifle") or name:find("gun") or name:find("slingshot") or name:find("cannon") or name:find("bazooka") or name:find("kabucha") or name:find("guitar") then
            return "Gun"
        elseif name:find("step") or name:find("karate") or name:find("kung fu") or name:find("claw") or name:find("talon") or name:find("superhuman") or name:find("godhuman") or name:find("sanguine") or name:find("combat") then
            return "Melee"
        elseif name:find("fruit") or name:find("bomb") or name:find("spike") or name:find("chop") or name:find("spring") or name:find("smoke") or name:find("flame") or name:find("ice") or name:find("sand") or name:find("dark") or name:find("light") or name:find("magma") or name:find("quake") or name:find("buddha") or name:find("string") or name:find("phoenix") or name:find("portal") or name:find("rumble") or name:find("blizzard") or name:find("gravity") or name:find("dough") or name:find("shadow") or name:find("venom") or name:find("control") or name:find("spirit") or name:find("dragon") or name:find("leopard") or name:find("kitsune") or name:find("trex") or name:find("mammoth") or name:find("sound") or name:find("gas") or name:find("yeti") then
            return "Fruit"
        end
        return nil
    end

    function WeaponHelper.getEquippedWeaponType()
        local char = LocalPlayer.Character
        if not char then return nil, nil end
        for _, item in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
            if item:IsA("Tool") then
                local wType = WeaponHelper.toolToWeaponType(item)
                if wType then return wType, item end
            end
        end
        return nil, nil
    end

    function WeaponHelper.findToolByType(weaponType)
        local char = LocalPlayer.Character
        local backpack = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
        local pools = {char or false, backpack or false}
        for _, container in ipairs(pools) do
            if container then
                for _, item in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do
                    if item:IsA("Tool") and WeaponHelper.toolToWeaponType(item) == weaponType then
                        return item
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        return nil
    end

    function WeaponHelper.getHotbarKeyForTool(tool)
        if not tool then return nil end
        local pGui = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
        local hotbar = pGui and pGui:FindFirstChild("Backpack") and pGui.Backpack:FindFirstChild("Hotbar")
        local container = hotbar and hotbar:FindFirstChild("Container")
        if not container then return nil end
        local slotNum = nil
        for _, elem in ipairs(container:GetDescendants()) do
            if elem:IsA("GuiObject") and elem:GetAttribute("ItemName") == tool.Name then
                slotNum = math.floor(tonumber(elem.LayoutOrder) or 0)
                if slotNum > 0 then break end
            end
        end
        local keyMap = {
            [1] = Enum.KeyCode.One, [2] = Enum.KeyCode.Two, [3] = Enum.KeyCode.Three,
            [4] = Enum.KeyCode.Four, [5] = Enum.KeyCode.Five, [6] = Enum.KeyCode.Six,
            [7] = Enum.KeyCode.Seven, [8] = Enum.KeyCode.Eight, [9] = Enum.KeyCode.Nine,
            [10] = Enum.KeyCode.Zero
        }
        return keyMap[slotNum]
    end

    function WeaponHelper.equipWeaponType(weaponType)
        if not weaponType or weaponType == "None" then return true end
        local curType = WeaponHelper.getEquippedWeaponType()
        if curType == weaponType then return true end

        local char = LocalPlayer.Character
        local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local tool = WeaponHelper.findToolByType(weaponType)
        if not hum or not tool then return false end

        local hotbarKey = WeaponHelper.getHotbarKeyForTool(tool)
        if hotbarKey and VirtualInputManager then
            pcall(function()
                VirtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent(true, hotbarKey, false, game)
                task.wait(0.02)
                VirtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent(false, hotbarKey, false, game)
            end)
            local deadline = tick() + 0.18
            repeat
                if WeaponHelper.getEquippedWeaponType() == weaponType then return true end
                task.wait(0.015)
            until tick() >= deadline
        end

        pcall(function()
            hum:EquipTool(tool)
        end)
        local deadline2 = tick() + 0.25
        repeat
            if WeaponHelper.getEquippedWeaponType() == weaponType then return true end
            task.wait(0.015)
        until tick() >= deadline2
        return WeaponHelper.getEquippedWeaponType() == weaponType
    end

    function WeaponHelper.isCharacterBusyOrStunned()
        local char = LocalPlayer.Character
        if not char then return true end
        local busy = char:FindFirstChild("Busy")
        local stun = char:FindFirstChild("Stun")
        local isBusy = busy and (busy.Value == true or (tonumber(busy.Value) or 0) > 0)
        local isStun = stun and (stun.Value == true or (tonumber(stun.Value) or 0) > 0)
        return (isBusy or isStun)
    end

    function WeaponHelper.findSkillCooldown(toolName, skillKey)
        local pGui = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
        local main = pGui and pGui:FindFirstChild("Main")
        local skills = main and main:FindFirstChild("Skills")
        if not skills then return nil end
        local toolFrame = skills:FindFirstChild(toolName or "")
        if not toolFrame then
            local normalized = string.lower(toolName or ""):gsub("[^%w]", "")
            for _, child in ipairs(skills:GetChildren()) do
                local cn = string.lower(child.Name):gsub("[^%w]", "")
                if cn == normalized or cn == normalized .. normalized then
                    toolFrame = child
                    break
                end
            end
        end
        local skillFrame = toolFrame and toolFrame:FindFirstChild(tostring(skillKey or ""))
        local cdFrame = skillFrame and skillFrame:FindFirstChild("Cooldown")
        if cdFrame and cdFrame:IsA("GuiObject") then return cdFrame end
        return nil
    end

    function WeaponHelper.isSkillOnCooldown(toolName, skillKey)
        local cd = WeaponHelper.findSkillCooldown(toolName, skillKey)
        if not cd or not cd.Parent or not cd.Visible then return false end
        local sx = cd.Size.X
        return (math.abs(sx.Scale) > 0.005 or math.abs(sx.Offset) > 2)
    end

    function WeaponHelper.isTransformed()
        local char = LocalPlayer.Character
        if not char then return false end
        local attrs = {"Transformed", "Transformation", "IsTransformed", "FruitTransformed"}
        for _, attr in ipairs(attrs) do
            if char:GetAttribute(attr) == true then return true end
        end
        local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if hum and hum.HipHeight > 3.5 then return true end
        return false
    end

    local activeContext
    Spooky.IsMacroRunning=function() return MacroRunning end
    local syntheticKeys = {}
    _G.IsSyntheticKey = function(key)
        local name = typeof(key) == "EnumItem" and key.Name or tostring(key)
        if (syntheticKeys[name] or 0) > os.clock() then return true end
        return false
    end
    Spooky.IsMacroSyntheticKey = _G.IsSyntheticKey

    local function status(text, running)
        for _, label in pairs({_G.MacroStatusLabel or false, _G.MacroFloatingStatus or false}) do
            if label and label.Parent then
                label.Text = text
                label.TextColor3 = running and Color3.fromRGB(255, 170, 70) or Color3.fromRGB(130, 230, 255)
            end
        end
    end
    local function release(ctx)
        if not ctx then return end
        for key in pairs(ctx.keys) do
            syntheticKeys[key.Name] = os.clock() + 0.15
            pcall(function() VirtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent(false, key, false, game) end)
            ctx.keys[key] = nil
        end
        if ctx.tool then pcall(function() ctx.tool:Deactivate() end); ctx.tool = nil end
    end
    local function stopMacro(reason)
        MacroRunning = false
        MacroRunToken += 1
        local ctx = activeContext
        activeContext = nil
        release(ctx)
        status("READY [" .. (Settings.macroTriggerKey or "T") .. "]", false)
    end
    _G.SpookyStopMacro = function()
        stopMacro("Stopped")
        if _G.SpookyStopLegacyMacro then _G.SpookyStopLegacyMacro() end
    end
    registerConnection(LocalPlayer.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function() _G.SpookyStopMacro() end))

    executeMacroCombo = function()
        if MacroRunning then stopMacro("Stopped"); return end
        if UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox() or not isCurrentSession() then return end
        if _G.SpookyStopLegacyMacro then _G.SpookyStopLegacyMacro() end
        local char = LocalPlayer.Character
        local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then return end
        local index = math.floor(Spooky.Runtime.number(Settings.macroActiveSlot, 1, 1, 5))
        local source = (Settings.macroSlots or {})[index]
        local slot = Spooky.Runtime.copy(source or {steps = Settings.macroCustomSteps or {}})
        local steps = slot.steps or {}
        MacroRunToken += 1
        MacroRunning = true
        local ctx = {token = MacroRunToken, keys = {}, character = char, loop = Settings.macroLoop == true}
        activeContext = ctx
        status("RUNNING SLOT " .. index, true)
        task.spawn(function()
            local function valid()
                return activeContext == ctx and MacroRunning and MacroRunToken == ctx.token
                    and isCurrentSession() and LocalPlayer.Character == char and hum.Parent and hum.Health > 0
            end
            local function waitFor(seconds)
                local deadline = os.clock() + Spooky.Runtime.number(seconds, 0, 0, 10)
                while valid() and os.clock() < deadline do
                    task.wait(math.min(0.02, deadline - os.clock()))
                end
                return valid()
            end
            local function press(name, seconds)
                if not valid() then return false end
                local key = Enum.KeyCode[name]
                if not key then return false end
                ctx.keys[key] = true
                syntheticKeys[name] = os.clock() + seconds + 0.2
                if _G.MarkSyntheticKey then _G.MarkSyntheticKey(name, seconds + 0.2) end
                local ok = pcall(function() VirtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent(true, key, false, game) end)
                if ok then waitFor(seconds) end

                if ctx.keys[key] then
                    pcall(function() VirtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent(false, key, false, game) end)
                    ctx.keys[key] = nil
                end
                return ok and valid()
            end
            local function ready()
                local deadline = os.clock() + 1.5
                while valid() and WeaponHelper.isCharacterBusyOrStunned() and os.clock() < deadline do waitFor(0.02) end
                return valid() and not WeaponHelper.isCharacterBusyOrStunned()
            end
            local function equip(weapon)
                if not valid() then return false end

                local tool = WeaponHelper.findToolByType(weapon)
                if not tool then return false end
                if tool.Parent ~= char then hum:EquipTool(tool) end
                local deadline = os.clock() + 0.4
                while valid() and tool.Parent ~= char and os.clock() < deadline do waitFor(0.02) end
                return valid() and tool.Parent == char, tool
            end
            local function m1(weapon, count)
                if not ready() then return end
                local ok, tool = equip(weapon or "Melee")
                if not ok then return end
                for _ = 1, math.floor(Spooky.Runtime.number(count, 2, 1, 6)) do
                    if not valid() then break end
                    ctx.tool = tool
                    tool:Activate()
                    waitFor(0.035)
                    if ctx.tool == tool then tool:Deactivate(); ctx.tool = nil end
                    if not waitFor(0.08) then break end
                end
            end
            local function extras(position)
                if not valid() then return end
                if slot.soruEnabled and Spooky.Runtime.number(slot.soruAfter, 0, 0, 10) == position and ready() then
                    press("R", 0.04); waitFor(0.12)
                end
                if slot.m1Enabled and Spooky.Runtime.number(slot.m1After, 0, 0, 10) == position then m1(slot.m1Weapon, slot.m1Count) end
                if slot.v3Enabled and Spooky.Runtime.number(slot.v3After, 0, 0, 10) == position and ready() then
                    local remotes = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
                    local remote = remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("CommE")
                    if remote then remote:FireServer("ActivateAbility") end
                    waitFor(0.08)
                end
            end
            local function choose(block)
                local weapon, skill = block.weapon, tostring(block.skill or ""):upper()
                local tool = WeaponHelper.findToolByType(weapon)
                if tool and not WeaponHelper.isSkillOnCooldown(tool.Name, skill) then
                    return weapon, skill, block.mode, block.hold
                end
                if block.fallbackEnabled then
                    weapon, skill = block.fallbackWeapon, tostring(block.fallbackSkill or ""):upper()
                    tool = WeaponHelper.findToolByType(weapon)
                    if tool and not WeaponHelper.isSkillOnCooldown(tool.Name, skill) then
                        return weapon, skill, block.fallbackMode, block.fallbackHold
                    end
                elseif tool then
                    local deadline = os.clock() + 1.5
                    while valid() and WeaponHelper.isSkillOnCooldown(tool.Name, skill) and os.clock() < deadline do waitFor(0.02) end
                    if valid() and not WeaponHelper.isSkillOnCooldown(tool.Name, skill) then
                        return weapon, skill, block.mode, block.hold
                    end
                end
            end
            local ok, err = pcall(function()
                local trigger = Enum.KeyCode[Settings.macroTriggerKey or "T"]
                local deadline = os.clock() + 0.5
                while trigger and valid() and UserInputService:IsKeyDown(trigger) and os.clock() < deadline do waitFor(0.02) end
                repeat
                    extras(0)
                    for i = 1, 10 do
                        if not valid() then break end
                        local block = steps[i]
                        if type(block) == "table" and block.enabled and ready() then
                            local weapon, skill, mode, hold = choose(block)
                            if weapon and equip(weapon) and valid() then
                                if skill == "TAP" or skill == "M1" then
                                    m1(weapon, 1)
                                elseif skill:match("^[ZXCVF]$") then
                                    mode = tostring(mode or (hold == true and "Hold" or "Tap")):lower()
                                    local transform = mode == "transform"
                                    local tool = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
                                    local name = tool and tool.Name:lower():gsub("[^%w]", "") or ""
                                    local forms = {dragon=true,gas=true,kitsune=true,leopard=true,mammoth=true,phoenix=true,tiger=true,trex=true,venom=true,yeti=true,empyrean=true,fiend=true,werewolf=true,buddha=true}
                                    local transformOK = not transform or (weapon == "Fruit" and skill == "V" and forms[name] and not WeaponHelper.isTransformed())
                                    if transformOK and ready() then
                                        local duration = mode == "hold" and Spooky.Runtime.number(hold, 0.35, 0.03, 5) or 0.05
                                        press(skill, duration)
                                        if valid() then
                                            for _ = 1, math.floor(Spooky.Runtime.number(block.jumpsAfter or block.postJumps, 0, 0, 5)) do
                                                if not press("Space", 0.035) then break end
                                                waitFor(0.08)
                                            end
                                        end
                                    end
                                end
                                waitFor(Spooky.Runtime.number(block.delay, 0.12, 0, 5))
                            end
                        end
                        extras(i)
                    end
                    if ctx.loop then waitFor(0.1) end
                until not ctx.loop or not valid()
            end)
            if activeContext == ctx then
                stopMacro(ok and "Completed" or "Error")
                if not ok then warn("[Spooky Macro] " .. tostring(err)); status("STOPPED: playback error", false) end
            end
        end)
    end
    _G.ExecuteMacroCombo = executeMacroCombo
end

local MacroEditorGui = nil
local SelectedSoruTarget = "Nearest"
local function getClientPing()
    local ping = nil
    pcall(function()
        if LocalPlayer and LocalPlayer.GetNetworkPing then
            local p = LocalPlayer:GetNetworkPing()
            if p and p > 0 then
                ping = p * 1000
            end
        end
    end)
    if not ping then
        pcall(function()
            local stats = game:GetService("Stats")
            local net = stats:FindFirstChild("Network")
            local item = net and net:FindFirstChild("ServerStatsItem") and net.ServerStatsItem:FindFirstChild("Data Ping")
            if item then
                local str = item:GetValueString()
                local num = tonumber(str:match("[%d%.]+"))
                if num then ping = num end
            end
        end)
    end
    if not ping then
        pcall(function()
            local ps = game:GetService("Stats"):FindFirstChild("PerformanceStats")
            local p = ps and ps:FindFirstChild("Ping")
            if p then ping = p:GetValue() end
        end)
    end
    return math.clamp(ping or 45, 8, 999)
end
local function getToolCategory(tool)
    if not tool then return "Melee" end
    local tName = string.lower(tool.Name)
    local tt = ""
    pcall(function()
        local tip=tool.ToolTip
        if not tip or tip=="" then tip=tool:GetAttribute("Type") or tool:GetAttribute("WeaponType") end
        tt=string.lower(tostring(tip or ""))
    end)
    if string.find(tt, "sword") or string.find(tt, "espada") then return "Sword" end
    if string.find(tt, "gun") or string.find(tt, "pistola") or string.find(tt, "arma") then return "Gun" end
    if string.find(tt, "fruit") or string.find(tt, "bloxfruit") or string.find(tt, "fruta") then return "Fruit" end
    if string.find(tt, "melee") or string.find(tt, "combat") then return "Melee" end
    local swordKeywords = {
        "sword", "blade", "katana", "yoru", "cursed", "scythe", "saber", "pole", "bisento",
        "trident", "dagger", "anchor", "lamp", "tushita", "yama", "rengoku", "wando", "shisui",
        "saddi", "canvander", "cavander", "koko", "cane", "jitte", "pipe", "mace", "cutlass",
        "hallow", "warden", "dragon trident", "spikey trident", "dark blade", "triple katana", "dual katana"
    }
    for _, sk in ipairs(swordKeywords) do
        if string.find(tName, sk) then return "Sword" end
    end
    local gunKeywords = {
        "guitar", "rifle", "flintlock", "kabucha", "slingshot", "bazooka", "cannon", "gun",
        "serpent bow", "bow", "acidum", "musket", "bizarre", "dragonstorm"
    }
    for _, gk in ipairs(gunKeywords) do
        if string.find(tName, gk) then return "Gun" end
    end
    local meleeKeywords = {
        "godhuman", "electric claw", "superhuman", "dragon talon", "death step", "sharkman karate",
        "combat", "black leg", "electro", "fishman karate", "dragon breath", "sanguine art", "sanguine"
    }
    for _, mk in ipairs(meleeKeywords) do
        if string.find(tName, mk) then return "Melee" end
    end
    local isFruit = string.find(tName, "fruit") or tool:FindFirstChild("Fruit") ~= nil
    if not isFruit and string.find(tName, "-") then
        local firstPart, secondPart = tName:match("^([%w%s]+)%-(%w+)$")
        if firstPart and secondPart and (firstPart:find(secondPart) or secondPart:find(firstPart)) then
            isFruit = true
        end
    end
    local fruitKeywords = {
        "portal", "dough", "dragon", "leopard", "kitsune", "buddha", "t-rex", "trex",
        "mammoth", "sound", "blizzard", "spirit", "venom", "shadow", "control", "gravity",
        "rumble", "paw", "spider", "love", "quake", "magma", "light", "ice", "flame",
        "dark", "sand", "falcon", "diamond", "rubber", "barrier", "ghost", "spin", "chop",
        "spring", "bomb", "smoke", "rocket"
    }
    if not isFruit then
        for _, kw in ipairs(fruitKeywords) do
            if string.find(tName, kw) then
                isFruit = true
                break
            end
        end
    end
    if isFruit then return "Fruit" end
    return "Melee"
end

    local SuperJumpGui = nil
    local isSuperJumping = false
    local superJumpBtn = nil
    local function doSuperJump()
        local char = LocalPlayer.Character
        local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not hrp or not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then return end
        hum.PlatformStand = false
        hum.Sit = false
        local jumpHeight = math.clamp(tonumber(Settings.superJumpHeight) or 500, 150, 3000)
        pcall(function()
            hum.JumpPower = 50
            hum.JumpHeight = 7.2
        end)
        local curV = hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity
        local moveDir = hum.MoveDirection
        local hSpeed = 45
        local targetX = (moveDir.Magnitude > 0.1) and (moveDir.X * hSpeed) or curV.X
        local targetZ = (moveDir.Magnitude > 0.1) and (moveDir.Z * hSpeed) or curV.Z

        hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
        hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(targetX, jumpHeight, targetZ)

        task.defer(function()
            if hrp and hrp.Parent then
                hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(targetX, jumpHeight, targetZ)
            end
        end)
        task.delay(0.04, function()
            if hrp and hrp.Parent and hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y < (jumpHeight * 0.7) then
                hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity.X, jumpHeight, hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Z)
            end
            pcall(function()
                if hum and hum.Parent then
                    hum.JumpPower = 50
                    hum.JumpHeight = 7.2
                end
            end)
        end)

        if not isSuperJumping then
            isSuperJumping = true
            task.spawn(function()
                local t0 = tick()
                local apex = false
                while tick() - t0 < 8 do
                    task.wait(0.06)
                    local c = LocalPlayer.Character
                    local h = c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                    local hm = c and c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                    if not h or not hm or hm.Health <= 0 then break end
                    local velY = h.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y
                    if velY < 0 then apex = true end
                    if apex and velY < -60 then
                        local params = RaycastParams.new()
                        params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { c }
                        params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
                        local ray = workspace:Raycast(h.Position, Vector3.new(0, -35, 0), params)
                        if ray then
                            h.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(h.AssemblyLinearVelocity.X, -20, h.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Z)
                            hm.PlatformStand = false
                            hm.Sit = false
                            hm:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running)
                            break
                        end
                    end
                    if apex and (hm.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air or hm:GetState() == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Landed) then
                        hm.PlatformStand = false
                        hm.Sit = false
                        hm:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running)
                        break
                    end
                end
                local c = LocalPlayer.Character
                local hm = c and c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                if hm and hm.Health > 0 then
                    hm.PlatformStand = false
                    hm.Sit = false
                    if hm:GetState() == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall or hm:GetState() == Enum.HumanoidStateType.PlatformStanding or hm:GetState() == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics then
                        hm:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running)
                    end
                    pcall(function()
                        hm.JumpPower = 50
                        hm.JumpHeight = 7.2
                    end)
                end
                isSuperJumping = false
            end)
        end
    end

        local isPressed = false
        local dragging = false
        local dragStart = nil
        local startPos = nil
        local hasMoved = false

        local function updateDrag(input)
            local isLocked = _G.SpookyLockFloatingButtons or (FeatureStates and FeatureStates["LockFloatingButtons"])
            if isLocked then
                dragging = false
                return
            end
            if dragging and dragStart and startPos then
                local delta = input.Position - dragStart
                if delta.Magnitude > 6 then
                    hasMoved = true
                end
                card.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
            end
        end

        local function endDrag()
            if isPressed then
                isPressed = false
                dragging = false
                if not hasMoved then
                    TweenService:Create(card, TweenInfo.new(0.1), { BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 35, 50) }):Play()
                    task.delay(0.12, function()
                        if card and card.Parent then
                            TweenService:Create(card, TweenInfo.new(0.15), { BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(18, 18, 24) }):Play()
                        end
                    end)
                    doSuperJump()
                end
            end
        end

        btn.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                isPressed = true
                hasMoved = false
                dragStart = input.Position
                startPos = card.Position
                local isLocked = _G.SpookyLockFloatingButtons or (FeatureStates and FeatureStates["LockFloatingButtons"])
                dragging = not isLocked
                input.Changed:Connect(function()
                    if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                        endDrag()
                    end
                end)
            end
        end)

        btn.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                updateDrag(input)
            end
        end)

        UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                updateDrag(input)
            end
        end)

        btn.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                endDrag()
            end
        end)

        UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                endDrag()
            end
        end)
    end

    local noclipSteppedConnection = nil
    local function applyNoclipToCharacter(char)
        if not char then return end
        local cached = _G.cachedCharacterParts
        if cached and #cached > 0 then
            for i = 1, #cached do
                local p = cached[i]
                if p and p.CanCollide then p.CanCollide = false end
            end
        else
            for _, p in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
                if p:IsA("BasePart") and p.CanCollide then p.CanCollide = false end
            end
        end
    end

    local function restoreCharacterCollisions(char)
        if not char then return end
        for _, p in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
            if p:IsA("BasePart") and p.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then
                p.CanCollide = true
            end
        end
    end

    local function setNoclipState(enable)
        FeatureStates["NoClip"] = enable
        FeatureStates["Noclip"] = enable
        if enable then
            if not noclipSteppedConnection then
                noclipSteppedConnection = RunService.Stepped:Connect(function()
                    if not (FeatureStates["NoClip"] or FeatureStates["Noclip"]) then
                        if noclipSteppedConnection then
                            noclipSteppedConnection:Disconnect()
                            noclipSteppedConnection = nil
                        end
                        return
                    end
                    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
                    if char then
                        applyNoclipToCharacter(char)
                    end
                end)
            end
        else
            if noclipSteppedConnection then
                noclipSteppedConnection:Disconnect()
                noclipSteppedConnection = nil
            end
            local char = LocalPlayer.Character
            if char then
                restoreCharacterCollisions(char)
            end
        end
    end

        notifyToggle((CurrentLang == "ES") and ("Atravesar Paredes: " .. (v and "ON" or "OFF")) or ("Noclip: " .. (v and "ON" or "OFF")), v)
    end

        end
        notifyToggle((CurrentLang == "ES") and ("Sin Colision Accesorios: " .. (v and "ON" or "OFF")) or ("No-Collide Accessories: " .. (v and "ON" or "OFF")), v)
    end

    end

    local ShipModGui = nil
    local currentShipFound = nil
    local function findCurrentPlayerShip()
        local char = LocalPlayer.Character
        local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not root then return nil end
        local rootPos = root.Position
        local closestSeat, minDist = nil, math.huge

        local function checkSeat(obj)
            if obj:IsA("VehicleSeat") or obj:IsA("Seat") then
                local dist = (obj.Position - rootPos).Magnitude
                if dist < minDist and dist <= 120 then
                    minDist = dist
                    closestSeat = obj
                end
            end
        end

        local boats = workspace:FindFirstChild("Boats")
        if boats then
            for _, obj in ipairs(boats:GetDescendants()) do
                checkSeat(obj)
            end
        end

        if not closestSeat then
            for _, model in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
                if model:IsA("Model") and model ~= char and model.Parent ~= workspace:FindFirstChild("Characters") then
                    local primary = model.PrimaryPart or model:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
                    if primary and (primary.Position - rootPos).Magnitude <= 100 then
                        for _, child in ipairs(model:GetChildren()) do
                            checkSeat(child)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        if closestSeat then
            local model = closestSeat:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
            if model and model ~= char and model.Parent ~= workspace:FindFirstChild("Characters") then
                currentShipFound = model
                return model
            end
        end
        return nil
    end

    _G.__SyntheticKeys = _G.__SyntheticKeys or {}
    local function markSyntheticKey(key, duration)
        local keyName = typeof(key) == "EnumItem" and key.Name or tostring(key or "")
        if keyName ~= "" then
            _G.__SyntheticKeys[keyName] = tick() + (duration or 2.5)
        end
    end
    local function isSyntheticKey(key)
        local keyName = typeof(key) == "EnumItem" and key.Name or tostring(key or "")
        return tick() < (_G.__SyntheticKeys[keyName] or 0)
    end
    _G.MarkSyntheticKey = markSyntheticKey
    _G.IsSyntheticKey = function(key)
        return (Spooky.IsMacroSyntheticKey and Spooky.IsMacroSyntheticKey(key)) or isSyntheticKey(key)
    end

    local CooldownCache = {}
    local function findSmartCooldown(toolName, skillKey)
        local cacheKey = tostring(toolName or "") .. "__" .. tostring(skillKey or "")
        local cached = CooldownCache[cacheKey]
        if cached then
            local ok, p = pcall(function() return cached.Parent end)
            if ok and p then return cached end
            CooldownCache[cacheKey] = nil
        end
        local ok, result = pcall(function()
            local playerGui = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui") or LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
            local main = playerGui and playerGui:FindFirstChild("Main")
            local skills = main and main:FindFirstChild("Skills")
            if not skills then return nil end
            local toolSkills = skills:FindFirstChild(toolName or "")
            if not toolSkills then
                local cleanTool = tostring(toolName or ""):lower():gsub("[^%w]", "")
                if cleanTool == "" then return nil end
                for _, child in ipairs(skills:GetChildren()) do
                    local cleanChild = child.Name:lower():gsub("[^%w]", "")
                    if cleanChild == cleanTool or string.find(cleanChild, cleanTool) then
                        toolSkills = child
                        break
                    end
                end
            end
            local skillFrame = toolSkills and toolSkills:FindFirstChild(tostring(skillKey or ""))
            local cooldown = skillFrame and skillFrame:FindFirstChild("Cooldown")
            if cooldown and cooldown:IsA("GuiObject") then
                CooldownCache[cacheKey] = cooldown
                return cooldown
            end
            return nil
        end)
        return ok and result or nil
    end

    local function isSkillReady(toolName, skillKey)
        local ok, ready = pcall(function()
            local cd = findSmartCooldown(toolName, skillKey)
            if not cd then return true end
            if not cd.Visible then return true end
            return (cd.Size.X.Scale <= 0.05)
        end)
        return (not ok) or ready
    end

    local function getSkillCooldownScale(toolName, skillKey)
        local ok, scale = pcall(function()
            local cd = findSmartCooldown(toolName, skillKey)
            if not cd or not cd.Visible then return 0 end
            return cd.Size.X.Scale
        end)
        return ok and scale or 0
    end

    local function waitForSmartCooldown(toolName, skillKey, maxTimeout)
        local scale = getSkillCooldownScale(toolName, skillKey)
        if scale <= 0.05 then return true end
        local timeout = (scale <= 0.20) and math.max(maxTimeout or 1.2, 1.8) or (maxTimeout or 0.60)
        local t0 = tick()
        while (tick() - t0 < timeout) and MacroRunning do
            if isSkillReady(toolName, skillKey) then return true end
            task.wait(0.025)
        end
        return isSkillReady(toolName, skillKey)
    end

    local function isFruitTransformed()
        local ok, r = pcall(function()
            local char = LocalPlayer.Character
            if not char then return false end
            return char:GetAttribute("Transformed") == true
                or char:FindFirstChild("Transformation") ~= nil
                or char:FindFirstChild("KitsuneMode") ~= nil
                or char:FindFirstChild("DragonMode") ~= nil
                or char:FindFirstChild("BuddhaForm") ~= nil
        end)
        return ok and r
    end

    local function dispatchFastM1()
        pcall(function()
            local net = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Modules") and ReplicatedStorage.Modules:FindFirstChild("Net")
            local regAttack = (net and net:FindFirstChild("RE/RegisterAttack")) or ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("RegisterAttack", true)
            local regHit = (net and net:FindFirstChild("RE/RegisterHit")) or ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("RegisterHit", true)
            if regAttack then regAttack:FireServer(0) end
            local char = LocalPlayer.Character
            local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if regHit and root then regHit:FireServer(root, {{root, root.Position}}) end
        end)
        pcall(function()
            local char = LocalPlayer.Character
            local tool = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
            if tool then tool:Activate() end
        end)
    end

    local function runM1Burst(count)
        for _ = 1, math.clamp(tonumber(count) or 2, 1, 5) do
            if not MacroRunning then break end
            dispatchFastM1()
            task.wait(0.035)
        end
    end

    local function waitForMacroBusyFree(timeout)
        local t0 = tick()
        local maxT = timeout or 0.60
        while (tick() - t0 < maxT) and MacroRunning do
            local char = LocalPlayer.Character
            if not char then break end
            local isBusy = char:GetAttribute("Busy") or char:FindFirstChild("Busy") or char:GetAttribute("isUsingSkill") or char:GetAttribute("UsingSkill")
            if not isBusy then break end
            task.wait(0.025)
        end
    end

    local function smartEquipWeapon(toolType)
        if not toolType or toolType == "None" then return true end
        local char = LocalPlayer.Character
        if not char then return false end
        local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not hum then return false end
        local targetCategory = (toolType == "Blox Fruit" and "Fruit") or toolType

        local cur = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
        if cur and getToolCategory(cur) == targetCategory then return true end

        waitForMacroBusyFree(0.50)

        local bp = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack") or LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("Backpack")
        local targetTool = nil
        if bp then
            for _, t in ipairs(bp:GetChildren()) do
                if t:IsA("Tool") and getToolCategory(t) == targetCategory then
                    targetTool = t
                    break
                end
            end
        end
        if not targetTool then
            for _, t in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
                if t:IsA("Tool") and getToolCategory(t) == targetCategory then
                    return true
                end
            end
            return false
        end

        if cur and cur ~= targetTool then
            pcall(function() hum:UnequipTools() end)
            task.wait(0.04)
        end

        for attempt = 1, 3 do
            if not MacroRunning then return false end
            pcall(function() hum:EquipTool(targetTool) end)
            local t0 = tick()
            while tick() - t0 < 0.40 do
                if targetTool.Parent == char then
                    task.wait(0.08)
                    return true
                end
                task.wait(0.02)
            end
            task.wait(0.04)
        end
        return (targetTool.Parent == char)
    end

    local lastMacroEndTime = 0

    local function safeMousePress()
        if mouse1press then
            pcall(mouse1press)
            return
        end
        pcall(function()
            local vim = game:GetService("VirtualInputManager")
            vim:SendMouseButtonEvent(0, 0, 0, true, nil, 0)
        end)
        pcall(function()
            local vu = game:GetService("VirtualUser")
            vu:Button1Down(Vector2.zero)
        end)
    end

    local function safeMouseRelease()
        if mouse1release then
            pcall(mouse1release)
            return
        end
        pcall(function()
            local vim = game:GetService("VirtualInputManager")
            vim:SendMouseButtonEvent(0, 0, 0, false, nil, 0)
        end)
        pcall(function()
            local vu = game:GetService("VirtualUser")
            vu:Button1Up(Vector2.zero)
        end)
    end

    local function safeMouseClick()
        if mouse1click then
            pcall(mouse1click)
            return
        end
        safeMousePress()
        task.wait(0.04)
        safeMouseRelease()
    end

    local VK_KEY_MAP = {
        Z = 90, X = 88, C = 67, V = 86, F = 70, T = 84, Q = 81, E = 69, R = 82
    }
    local function sendVirtualKey(skillKey, isDown)
        local skill = string.upper(tostring(skillKey or ""))
        local kc = Enum.KeyCode[skill]
        if not kc then return end

        pcall(function()
            local vim = game:GetService("VirtualInputManager")
            if vim then
                vim:SendKeyEvent(isDown, kc, false, game)
            end
        end)

        local vk = VK_KEY_MAP[skill] or string.byte(skill)
        if vk and vk >= 65 and vk <= 90 then
            if isDown and keypress then
                pcall(keypress, vk)
            elseif (not isDown) and keyrelease then
                pcall(keyrelease, vk)
            end
        end
    end

    local function triggerSkillInput(skillKey, isDown)
        local skill = string.upper(tostring(skillKey or ""))
        local kc = Enum.KeyCode[skill]
        if not kc then return end
        isSimulatingKeys = isDown
        if isDown then
            markSyntheticKey(skill, 2.5)
            markSyntheticKey(kc.Name, 2.5)
        end
        sendVirtualKey(skill, isDown)
    end

    local function smartCastSkill(skillName, customHold, weaponType)
        local skill = string.upper(skillName or "Z")
        local kc = Enum.KeyCode[skill]
        if not kc then return false end
        if not MacroRunning then return false end

        local pingSec = getClientPing() / 1000

        if weaponType and weaponType ~= "None" then
            local targetCat = (weaponType == "Blox Fruit" and "Fruit") or weaponType
            local char = LocalPlayer.Character
            local cur = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
            if not (cur and getToolCategory(cur) == targetCat) then
                smartEquipWeapon(weaponType)
                task.wait(0.18)
            end
        end

        faceMacroTarget()

        if skill == "V" and (weaponType == "Fruit" or weaponType == "Blox Fruit") and isFruitTransformed() then
            task.wait(0.05)
            return true
        end

        local char = LocalPlayer.Character
        local curTool = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
        local toolName = curTool and curTool.Name or ""

        if not isSkillReady(toolName, skill) then
            waitForSmartCooldown(toolName, skill, 0.80)
        end
        if not MacroRunning then return false end

        if _G.SpookySetSkillKey then _G.SpookySetSkillKey(skill) end
        _G.CurrentSkillKey = skill

        local isHold = (customHold == true) or (type(customHold) == "number" and customHold > 0.15)
        local holdDuration = 0.05
        if isHold then
            if type(customHold) == "number" then
                holdDuration = math.clamp(customHold, 0.05, 5.0)
            else
                holdDuration = 0.38 + math.clamp(pingSec * 0.12, 0.02, 0.12)
            end
        end

        markSyntheticKey(skill, holdDuration + 2.5)
        markSyntheticKey(kc.Name, holdDuration + 2.5)
        isSimulatingKeys = true

        sendVirtualKey(skill, false)
        task.wait(0.02)

        faceMacroTarget()
        sendVirtualKey(skill, true)

        task.wait(holdDuration)

        sendVirtualKey(skill, false)

        local postDelay
        if isHold then
            postDelay = math.clamp(pingSec * 0.12 + 0.44, 0.38, 0.65)
        else
            local baseDelay = 0.50
            local wCat = weaponType or ""
            if wCat == "Melee" then
                if skill == "Z" then
                    baseDelay = 0.68
                elseif skill == "C" or skill == "V" then
                    baseDelay = 0.58
                elseif skill == "X" then
                    baseDelay = 0.55
                else
                    baseDelay = 0.50
                end
            elseif wCat == "Sword" then
                if skill == "Z" then
                    baseDelay = 0.54
                elseif skill == "X" then
                    baseDelay = 0.56
                else
                    baseDelay = 0.50
                end
            elseif wCat == "Fruit" then
                baseDelay = 0.60
            else
                baseDelay = 0.48
            end
            postDelay = math.clamp(pingSec * 0.12 + baseDelay, 0.45, 0.78)
        end
        task.wait(postDelay)

        task.delay(0.08, function() isSimulatingKeys = false end)
        return true
    end

    local function smartTap()
        faceMacroTarget()
        runM1Burst(1)
        safeMouseClick()
        task.wait(0.15)
    end

    local function restoreMacroMobility()

    end

    local function ReleaseAll()
        for _, k in ipairs({"Z", "X", "C", "V", "F"}) do
            triggerSkillInput(k, false)
        end
        safeMouseRelease()
        restoreMacroMobility()
        task.delay(0.08, restoreMacroMobility)
    end

    local function StopSequence()
        if not MacroRunning then return end
        MacroRunning = false
        MacroRunToken = MacroRunToken + 1
        ReleaseAll()
        restoreMacroMobility()
        task.delay(0.08, restoreMacroMobility)
    end

    _G.SpookyStopLegacyMacro = StopSequence

    local function RunSmartSteps()
        if MacroRunning then return end
        MacroRunning = true
        MacroRunToken = MacroRunToken + 1
        local myToken = MacroRunToken

        task.spawn(function()
            local ok, err = pcall(function()

                local tKey = Settings.macroTriggerKey or "T"
                local tCode = Enum.KeyCode[tKey]
                if tCode and UserInputService:IsKeyDown(tCode) then
                    local relWait = tick()
                    while UserInputService:IsKeyDown(tCode) and (tick() - relWait < 0.35) do
                        task.wait(0.03)
                    end
                end
                task.wait(0.06)

                repeat
                    local steps = Settings.macroCustomSteps or {}

                    local firstStep = nil
                    for _, s in ipairs(steps) do
                        if s and s.enabled then firstStep = s; break end
                    end
                    if firstStep then
                        local w = firstStep.weapon or firstStep.tool or "Melee"
                        local sk = tostring(firstStep.skill or firstStep.key or "Z"):upper()
                        if w ~= "None" then
                            smartEquipWeapon(w)
                            task.wait(0.12)
                        end
                        local char = LocalPlayer.Character
                        local cur = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
                        local tName = cur and cur.Name or ""
                        local scale = getSkillCooldownScale(tName, sk)
                        if scale > 0.20 then

                            if _G.MacroStatusLabel then
                                _G.MacroStatusLabel.Text = "COOLDOWN: " .. w .. " [" .. sk .. "]"
                                _G.MacroStatusLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 170, 70)
                            end
                            if _G.MacroFloatingStatus then
                                _G.MacroFloatingStatus.Text = "COOLDOWN"
                                _G.MacroFloatingStatus.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 170, 70)
                            end
                            notifyToggle("Macro: Habilidades en Cooldown! Espera a que recarguen", false)
                            return
                        elseif scale > 0.05 then

                            if _G.MacroStatusLabel then
                                _G.MacroStatusLabel.Text = "WAITING CD: " .. w .. " [" .. sk .. "]..."
                            end
                            waitForSmartCooldown(tName, sk, 2.0)
                        end
                    end

                    for stepIndex, step in ipairs(steps) do
                        if not MacroRunning or MacroRunToken ~= myToken then return end
                        if step and step.enabled then
                            local weapon = step.weapon or step.tool or "Melee"
                            local skill = tostring(step.skill or step.key or "Z"):upper()

                            waitForMacroBusyFree(0.55)

                            if weapon ~= "None" then
                                smartEquipWeapon(weapon)
                                task.wait(0.06)
                            end
                            if not MacroRunning or MacroRunToken ~= myToken then return end

                            if skill == "M1" or skill == "TAP" then
                                smartTap()
                            elseif ValidSkills[skill] then
                                smartCastSkill(skill, step.hold, weapon)
                            end
                            if not MacroRunning or MacroRunToken ~= myToken then return end

                            local gap = (type(step.delay) == "number" and step.delay > 0) and step.delay or 0.06
                            task.wait(gap)
                        end
                    end
                until not Settings.macroLoop or not MacroRunning or MacroRunToken ~= myToken
            end)
            if not ok then warn("[SpookyMacro]:", tostring(err)) end
            ReleaseAll()
            MacroRunning = false
            isSimulatingKeys = false
            lastMacroEndTime = tick()
            if _G.MacroStatusLabel then
                _G.MacroStatusLabel.Text = "STATUS: READY [Key: " .. (Settings.macroTriggerKey or "T") .. " - Auto-Timed]"
                _G.MacroStatusLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(140, 230, 255)
            end
            if _G.MacroFloatingStatus then
                _G.MacroFloatingStatus.Text = "READY [" .. (Settings.macroTriggerKey or "T") .. "]"
                _G.MacroFloatingStatus.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(140, 230, 255)
            end
        end)
    end

    local function RunSequence(sequence)
        if MacroRunning then return end
        MacroRunning = true
        MacroRunToken = MacroRunToken + 1
        local myToken = MacroRunToken

        task.spawn(function()
            local ok, err = pcall(function()
                repeat
                    for _, rawCmd in ipairs(string.split(sequence, "&")) do
                        if not MacroRunning or MacroRunToken ~= myToken then return end
                        local cmd = rawCmd:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
                        local waitT = cmd:match("^wait%s*%(?([%d%.]+)%)?$")
                        if waitT then
                            task.wait(tonumber(waitT) or 0.2)
                        elseif ValidWeapons[cmd] then
                            smartEquipWeapon(cmd)
                        elseif cmd == "holdTAP" or cmd == "TAP" or cmd == "M1" then
                            smartTap()
                        elseif cmd:match("^hold(.+)$") then
                            local s = cmd:match("^hold(.+)$")
                            if ValidSkills[s] and s ~= "TAP" and s ~= "M1" then smartCastSkill(s, true) end
                        elseif cmd:match("^unhold(.+)$") then
                            local s = cmd:match("^unhold(.+)$")
                            if ValidSkills[s] and s ~= "TAP" and s ~= "M1" then triggerSkillInput(s, false) end
                        elseif ValidSkills[cmd] and cmd ~= "TAP" and cmd ~= "M1" then
                            smartCastSkill(cmd, false)
                        elseif cmd:find(":") then
                            local parts = string.split(cmd, ":")
                            local wType = parts[1] and parts[1]:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
                            local sKey = parts[2] and parts[2]:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
                            if wType and ValidWeapons[wType] then smartEquipWeapon(wType) end
                            if sKey == "M1" or sKey == "TAP" then
                                smartTap()
                            elseif sKey and ValidSkills[sKey] then
                                smartCastSkill(sKey, false, wType)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                until not Settings.macroLoop or not MacroRunning or MacroRunToken ~= myToken
            end)
            if not ok then warn("[SpookyMacro]:", tostring(err)) end
            ReleaseAll()
            MacroRunning = false
            isSimulatingKeys = false
            lastMacroEndTime = tick()
            if _G.MacroStatusLabel then
                _G.MacroStatusLabel.Text = "STATUS: READY [Key: " .. (Settings.macroTriggerKey or "T") .. " - Auto-Timed]"
                _G.MacroStatusLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(140, 230, 255)
            end
            if _G.MacroFloatingStatus then
                _G.MacroFloatingStatus.Text = "READY [" .. (Settings.macroTriggerKey or "T") .. "]"
                _G.MacroFloatingStatus.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(140, 230, 255)
            end
        end)
    end

        floatBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(16, 16, 18)
