        floatBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        floatBtn.TextSize = 12.5
        floatBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        floatBtn.Active = true
        Instance.new("UICorner", floatBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 9)
        local floatStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", floatBtn)
        floatStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(36, 36, 42)
        floatStroke.Thickness = 1.2
        floatingStatusLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel", floatBtn)
        floatingStatusLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 12)
        floatingStatusLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -13)
        floatingStatusLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        floatingStatusLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        floatingStatusLabel.Text = "READY"
        floatingStatusLabel.TextSize = 9
        floatingStatusLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 180, 185)

        local mIsPressed, mDragging, mDragStart, mStartPos, mHasMoved = false, false, nil, nil, false
        floatBtn.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                mIsPressed = true
                mHasMoved = false
                mDragStart = input.Position
                mStartPos = floatBtn.Position
                local isLocked = _G.SpookyLockFloatingButtons or (FeatureStates and FeatureStates["LockFloatingButtons"])
                mDragging = not isLocked
            end
        end)
        UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
            local isLocked = _G.SpookyLockFloatingButtons or (FeatureStates and FeatureStates["LockFloatingButtons"])
            if isLocked then mDragging = false return end
            if mDragging and mDragStart and mStartPos and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
                local delta = input.Position - mDragStart
                if delta.Magnitude > 5 then mHasMoved = true end
                floatBtn.Position = UDim2.new(mStartPos.X.Scale, mStartPos.X.Offset + delta.X, mStartPos.Y.Scale, mStartPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
            end
        end)
        UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                if mIsPressed then
                    mIsPressed = false
                    mDragging = false
                    if not mHasMoved then
                        if executeMacroCombo then executeMacroCombo() end
                    end
                end
            end
        end)
        task.spawn(function()
            while floatingTriggerGui and floatingTriggerGui.Parent do
                if floatingStatusLabel then
                    floatingStatusLabel.Text = MacroRunning and "RUNNING..." or "READY"
                    floatingStatusLabel.TextColor3 = MacroRunning and Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255) or Color3.fromRGB(180, 180, 185)
                end
                task.wait(0.2)
            end
        end)
    end

        local savedHeaderLbl = Instance.new("TextLabel", f)

        local savedScroll = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame", f)
        savedScroll.Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 146)

            for _, ch in ipairs(savedScroll:GetChildren()) do

        renderSavedCombos()
    end
    FeatureCallbacks["MacroBeta"] = function(v)
        if not v and _G.SpookyStopMacro then _G.SpookyStopMacro() end
        notifyToggle("Macro Sequence Pro: " .. (v and "ON" or "OFF"), v)
        showFloatingComboTrigger(v and Settings.macroMode == "Combo")
    end
    local TrackerGui = nil
    local trackerStickEnabled = false
    local trackerLockedChar = nil
    local function createTrackerWidget()
        if TrackerGui and TrackerGui.Parent then pcall(function() TrackerGui:Destroy() end) end
        local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
        gui.Name = "SpookyTrackerWidget"
        gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
        gui.DisplayOrder = 9999
        gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
        safeParent(gui)
        if (not gui.Parent or not gui.Parent:IsDescendantOf(game)) and LocalPlayer then
            gui.Parent = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui") or LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
        end
        TrackerGui = gui
        local floatBtn = Instance.new("TextButton", gui)
        floatBtn.Name = "TrackerToggle"
        floatBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 80, 0, 36)
        floatBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0.42, 0)
        floatBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(18, 18, 24)
        floatBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 0
        floatBtn.Text = "TRACK"
        floatBtn.TextSize = 12.5
        floatBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        floatBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        floatBtn.Active = true
        floatBtn.Visible = true
        floatBtn.ZIndex = 100
        Instance.new("UICorner", floatBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
        local fStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", floatBtn)
        fStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(36, 36, 42)
        fStroke.Thickness = 1.3

        local trackerIsPressed, trackerDragging, trackerDragStart, trackerStartPos, trackerHasMoved = false, false, nil, nil, false
        local function updateTrackerDrag(input)
            local isLocked = _G.SpookyLockFloatingButtons or (FeatureStates and FeatureStates["LockFloatingButtons"])
            if isLocked then trackerDragging = false return end
            if trackerDragging and trackerDragStart and trackerStartPos then
                local delta = input.Position - trackerDragStart
                if delta.Magnitude > 6 then trackerHasMoved = true end
                floatBtn.Position = UDim2.new(trackerStartPos.X.Scale, trackerStartPos.X.Offset + delta.X, trackerStartPos.Y.Scale, trackerStartPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
            end
        end

        floatBtn.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                trackerIsPressed = true
                trackerHasMoved = false
                trackerDragStart = input.Position
                trackerStartPos = floatBtn.Position
                local isLocked = _G.SpookyLockFloatingButtons or (FeatureStates and FeatureStates["LockFloatingButtons"])
                trackerDragging = not isLocked
            end
        end)
        floatBtn.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                updateTrackerDrag(input)
            end
        end)
        UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                updateTrackerDrag(input)
            end
        end)

        local trackerConn = nil
        local function stopTracker()
            trackerStickEnabled = false
            trackerLockedChar = nil
            if trackerConn then
                trackerConn:Disconnect()
                trackerConn = nil
            end
            fStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(48, 48, 55)
            floatBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 180, 180)
        end
        local function toggleTrackerAction()
            trackerStickEnabled = not trackerStickEnabled
            fStroke.Color = trackerStickEnabled and Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255) or Color3.fromRGB(48, 48, 55)
            floatBtn.TextColor3 = trackerStickEnabled and Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255) or Color3.fromRGB(180, 180, 180)
            if not trackerStickEnabled then
                stopTracker()
                return
            end
            if trackerConn then trackerConn:Disconnect() end
            trackerConn = RunService.Stepped:Connect(function(step, dt)
                if not trackerStickEnabled then
                    stopTracker()
                    return
                end
                local char = LocalPlayer.Character
                local myHRP = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                if not myHRP then return end
                myHRP.CanCollide = false
                local targetChar = nil
                if trackerLockedChar and trackerLockedChar.Parent and trackerLockedChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
                    local hum = trackerLockedChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                    if hum and hum.Health > 0 then
                        targetChar = trackerLockedChar
                    end
                end
                if not targetChar then
                    local closest, closestDist = nil, 650
                    for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                        if p ~= LocalPlayer and p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
                            if not (_G.PlayerBlacklist and (_G.PlayerBlacklist[p.UserId] or _G.PlayerBlacklist[p.Name])) then
                                local hum = p.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                                if hum and hum.Health > 0 then
                                    local d = (p.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position - myHRP.Position).Magnitude
                                    if d < closestDist then
                                        closest = p.Character
                                        closestDist = d
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    if not closest then
                        for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                            if p ~= LocalPlayer and p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
                                local hum = p.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                                if hum and hum.Health > 0 then
                                    local d = (p.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position - myHRP.Position).Magnitude
                                    if d < closestDist then
                                        closest = p.Character
                                        closestDist = d
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    trackerLockedChar = closest
                    targetChar = closest
                end
                if targetChar and targetChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
                    local tHrp = targetChar.HumanoidRootPart
                    local tHum = targetChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                    if tHum and tHum.Health > 0 and (myHRP.Position - tHrp.Position).Magnitude <= 700 then
                        local dist = Settings.trackerDist or 3.5
                        myHRP.CFrame = tHrp.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, dist)
                        myHRP.AssemblyLinearVelocity = tHrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity
                    else
                        trackerLockedChar = nil
                    end
                end
            end)
            registerConnection(trackerConn)
        end
        local function endTrackerDrag()
            if trackerIsPressed then
                trackerIsPressed = false
                trackerDragging = false
                if not trackerHasMoved then
                    toggleTrackerAction()
                end
            end
        end

        floatBtn.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                endTrackerDrag()
            end
        end)
        UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                endTrackerDrag()
            end
        end)
    end
    FeatureCallbacks["Tracker"] = function(v)
        if v then
            createTrackerWidget()
        else
            trackerStickEnabled = false
            trackerLockedChar = nil
            if TrackerGui then pcall(function() TrackerGui:Destroy() end); TrackerGui = nil end
        end
    end
local function _initCamLockSystem()
    local CamLockGui = nil
    local camLockActive = false
    local camLockTargetPlayer = nil
    local camLockStepBound = false
    local updateCamLockVisual = nil
    local stopCamLockTracking

    local function getBestCamLockTarget(excludeCurrent)
        if not Spooky.SelectAimPlayer then return nil end
        return Spooky.SelectAimPlayer(750, excludeCurrent and camLockTargetPlayer or nil)
    end

    local camLockNextScan=0
    local function camLockCameraStep(dt)
        if not isCurrentSession() then stopCamLockTracking(); return end
        if not camLockActive then return end
        if not camLockTargetPlayer then
            if os.clock()<camLockNextScan then return end
            camLockNextScan=os.clock()+0.25
            camLockTargetPlayer=getBestCamLockTarget(false)
            if not camLockTargetPlayer then Spooky.Diagnostics.statuses.CamLock="Waiting for a valid target";return end
            if updateCamLockVisual then updateCamLockVisual(true) end
        end
        Spooky.Diagnostics.statuses.CamLock="Tracking " .. camLockTargetPlayer.Name
        local currentRoot = camLockTargetPlayer.Character and camLockTargetPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not _G.SpookyCombatTargetValid or not _G.SpookyCombatTargetValid(camLockTargetPlayer,750)
            or not currentRoot or (Spooky.AimScore and not Spooky.AimScore(currentRoot,0))
            or (Settings.aimTargetPolicy == "Selected" and tostring(camLockTargetPlayer.UserId) ~= tostring(Settings.aimTargetUserId)) then
            camLockTargetPlayer = getBestCamLockTarget(true)
            if not camLockTargetPlayer then return end
        end
        local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
        if not cam then return end

        local targetChar = camLockTargetPlayer.Character
        if not (targetChar and targetChar.Parent) then
            local nextPlr = getBestCamLockTarget(true)
            if nextPlr then
                camLockTargetPlayer = nextPlr
                if updateCamLockVisual then updateCamLockVisual(true) end
            else
                camLockTargetPlayer=nil
            end
            return
        end

        local hum = targetChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local targetPartName = Settings.camLockTargetPart or "HumanoidRootPart"
        local hrp = targetChar:FindFirstChild(targetPartName) or targetChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or targetChar:FindFirstChild("Head") or targetChar.PrimaryPart
        if not hum or hum.Health <= 0 or not hrp then
            local nextPlr = getBestCamLockTarget(true)
            if nextPlr then
                camLockTargetPlayer = nextPlr
                if updateCamLockVisual then updateCamLockVisual(true) end
            else
                camLockTargetPlayer=nil
            end
            return
        end

        local camPos = cam.CFrame.Position
        local targetOffset = Vector3.new(0, (targetPartName == "Head" and 0.2 or 0.5), 0)
        local aimPos = hrp.Position + targetOffset

        local vel = hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity or hrp.Velocity
        if vel and vel.Magnitude > 2 and vel.Magnitude < 450 then
            aimPos = aimPos + (vel * math.clamp(tonumber(Settings.camLockPrediction) or 0.04, 0, 0.15))
        end

        local diff = aimPos - camPos
        local dist = diff.Magnitude

        if dist > 750 then
            local nextPlr = getBestCamLockTarget(true)
            if nextPlr then
                camLockTargetPlayer = nextPlr
                if updateCamLockVisual then updateCamLockVisual(true) end
            else
                camLockTargetPlayer=nil
            end
            return
        end

        if dist > 1 then
            local smooth = 0.32
            if Settings.camLockSmoothness == "Instant" then
                smooth = 1.0
            elseif Settings.camLockSmoothness == "Very Smooth" then
                smooth = 0.18
            end
            local targetCFrame = CFrame.lookAt(camPos, aimPos)
            local alpha = 1 - (1 - math.clamp(smooth, 0.05, 1)) ^ (math.clamp(tonumber(dt) or 1/60, 0, 0.1) * 60)
            cam.CFrame = cam.CFrame:Lerp(targetCFrame, alpha)
        end
    end

    stopCamLockTracking = function()
        camLockActive = false
        Spooky.Diagnostics.statuses.CamLock="Off"
        camLockTargetPlayer = nil
        if camLockStepBound then
            camLockStepBound = false
            pcall(function() RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep("SpookyCamLockExecution") end)
        end
        if updateCamLockVisual then updateCamLockVisual(false) end
    end

    local function startCamLockTracking()
        local target = getBestCamLockTarget(false)
        camLockTargetPlayer = target
        camLockActive = true
        if updateCamLockVisual then updateCamLockVisual(true) end
        if not camLockStepBound then
            camLockStepBound = true
            RunService:BindToRenderStep("SpookyCamLockExecution", Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 1, function(dt)
                local ok, err = pcall(camLockCameraStep,dt)
                if not ok then Spooky.ReportIssue("CamLock",err) end
            end)
        end
        local tName = target and (target.DisplayName or target.Name) or "waiting for target"
        notifyToggle("CamLock: LOCKED on " .. tName, true)
    end

    local function toggleCamLockTracking()
        if camLockActive then
            stopCamLockTracking()
            notifyToggle("CamLock: OFF", false)
        else
            startCamLockTracking()
        end
    end

    local camWidgetConnections = {}
    local function disconnectCamWidget()
        for _, connection in ipairs(camWidgetConnections) do connection:Disconnect() end
        table.clear(camWidgetConnections)
        updateCamLockVisual = nil
    end
    local function createCamLockWidget()
        disconnectCamWidget()
        if CamLockGui then CamLockGui:Destroy() end
        local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
        gui.Name = "SpookyCamLockWidget"
        gui.ResetOnSpawn, gui.IgnoreGuiInset, gui.Enabled = false, true, true
        gui.DisplayOrder = 1000000
        gui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling

        gui.Parent = (ScreenGui and ScreenGui.Parent) or TargetParent or LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui") or PlayerGui
        if not gui.Parent then safeParent(gui) end
        if not gui.Parent then error("Cannot parent the CamLock control") end
        CamLockGui = gui
        local card = Instance.new("TextButton", gui)
        card.Name = "CamLockCard"
        card.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(146, 40)
        card.Position = UDim2.new(0, 24, 0.5, -20)
        card.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 22, 29)
        card.BorderSizePixel, card.TextSize = 0, 12
        card.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
        card.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
        card.AutoButtonColor, card.Active, card.Visible, card.ZIndex = false, true, true, 10
        Instance.new("UICorner", card).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
        local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", card)
        stroke.Thickness = 1.5
        updateCamLockVisual = function(active)
            if not card.Parent then return end
            stroke.Color = active and (_G.CurrentAccentColor or Color3.fromRGB(130, 115, 240)) or Color3.fromRGB(65, 67, 79)
            card.Text = active and (camLockTargetPlayer and "CAMLOCK  •  ON" or "CAMLOCK  •  ...") or "CAMLOCK  •  OFF"
        end
        updateCamLockVisual(camLockActive)
        local dragStart, startPosition, dragInput, moved
        table.insert(camWidgetConnections, card.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                dragStart, startPosition, dragInput, moved = input.Position, card.Position, input, false
            end
        end))
        table.insert(camWidgetConnections, UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
            if not dragInput or _G.SpookyLockFloatingButtons or FeatureStates["LockFloatingButtons"] then return end
            if input ~= dragInput and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then return end
            local delta = input.Position - dragStart
            if delta.Magnitude > 6 then moved = true end
            if moved then
                local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
                local vp = cam and cam.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(800, 600)
                local x = startPosition.X.Scale * vp.X + startPosition.X.Offset + delta.X
                local y = startPosition.Y.Scale * vp.Y + startPosition.Y.Offset + delta.Y
                card.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(math.clamp(x, 0, math.max(0, vp.X - 146)), math.clamp(y, 0, math.max(0, vp.Y - 40)))
            end
        end))
        table.insert(camWidgetConnections, UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
            if input == dragInput then dragInput = nil end
        end))
        table.insert(camWidgetConnections, card.Activated:Connect(function()
            if not moved then toggleCamLockTracking() end
        end))
        registerConnection(gui.Destroying:Connect(disconnectCamWidget))
        Spooky.Diagnostics.statuses["CamLock control"] = "Visible in PlayerGui"
    end

    local function destroyCamLockWidget()
        stopCamLockTracking()
        disconnectCamWidget()
        if CamLockGui then
            CamLockGui:Destroy()
            CamLockGui = nil
        end
    end

    FeatureCallbacks["CamLock"] = function(v)
        if v then
            createCamLockWidget()
            startCamLockTracking()
            notifyToggle("CamLock Widget: Active", true)
        else
            destroyCamLockWidget()
            notifyToggle("CamLock Widget: Hidden", false)
        end
    end

    local function reconcileCamLockWidget()
        if FeatureStates["CamLock"] then
            if not CamLockGui or not CamLockGui.Parent then
                createCamLockWidget()
                if not camLockStepBound then startCamLockTracking() end
            end
            CamLockGui.Enabled = true
            local button = CamLockGui:FindFirstChild("CamLockCard")
            if button then button.Visible = true end
        elseif CamLockGui then
            destroyCamLockWidget()
        end
    end
    local camWidgetClock = 0
    registerConnection(RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
        if not isCurrentSession() then return end
        camWidgetClock += dt
        if camWidgetClock < 0.3 then return end
        camWidgetClock = 0
        local ok, err = pcall(reconcileCamLockWidget)
        if not ok then Spooky.ReportIssue("CamLock control",err) end
    end))
    FeatureCallbacks["SwitchCamLock"] = function()
        if not FeatureStates["CamLock"] then
            setFeatureState("CamLock",true)
            return
        end
        camLockTargetPlayer=getBestCamLockTarget(true) or getBestCamLockTarget(false)
        camLockActive=true
        if not camLockStepBound then
            camLockStepBound=true
            RunService:BindToRenderStep("SpookyCamLockExecution",Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value+1,camLockCameraStep)
        end
        if updateCamLockVisual then updateCamLockVisual(camLockTargetPlayer~=nil) end
    end
    end
    _initCamLockSystem()
end
showHomeSubView = showHomeSubView or nil
local currentWallpaperOpacity = 0.85
local currentCustomWallpaperId = "rbxassetid://98256258425377"
local currentPanelTransparency = 0
local currentBorderThickness = 1.5
local currentCornerRadius = 8
local currentUIFontName = "GothamBold"

local function setPanelTransparency(alpha)
    currentPanelTransparency = math.clamp(alpha or 0, 0, 0.95)
    pcall(function()
        local el = _G.SpookyThemedElements
        if el then
            if el.leftSideImg then el.leftSideImg.BackgroundTransparency = currentPanelTransparency end
            if el.rightSideImg then el.rightSideImg.BackgroundTransparency = currentPanelTransparency end
            if el.centerPagesBg then el.centerPagesBg.BackgroundTransparency = currentPanelTransparency end
        end
        for _, card in ipairs(AllCardFrames) do
            if card and card.Parent then
                card.BackgroundTransparency = math.clamp(currentPanelTransparency + 0.1, 0, 0.95)
            end
        end
    end)
end
_G.SpookySetPanelTransparency = setPanelTransparency

local function applyBorderColor(color)
    if getgenv().SpookyUIStroke then
        getgenv().SpookyUIStroke.Color = color
    end
end
_G.SpookyApplyBorderColor = applyBorderColor

local function applyFontToAll(fontEnum, fontName)
    if fontName then currentUIFontName = fontName end
    for _, desc in ipairs(MAINUIframe:GetDescendants()) do
        if desc:IsA("TextLabel") or desc:IsA("TextButton") or desc:IsA("TextBox") then
            pcall(function()
                if not desc:GetAttribute("PreserveFont") then
                    desc.Font = fontEnum
                end
            end)
        end
    end
end
_G.SpookyApplyFontToAll = applyFontToAll

local function applyBorderThickness(thickness)
    currentBorderThickness = thickness
    if getgenv().SpookyUIStroke then
        getgenv().SpookyUIStroke.Thickness = thickness
    end
end
_G.SpookyApplyBorderThickness = applyBorderThickness

local function applyCornerRadius(radiusPx)
    currentCornerRadius = radiusPx
    for _, desc in ipairs(MAINUIframe:GetDescendants()) do
        if desc:IsA("UICorner") then
            pcall(function()
                if not desc:GetAttribute("PreserveCorner") then
                    desc.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, radiusPx)
                end
            end)
        end
    end
end
_G.SpookyApplyCornerRadius = applyCornerRadius

applyWallpaper = function(assetId, opacity)
    if opacity then currentWallpaperOpacity = opacity end
    local wp = getgenv().SpookyUIWallpaper
    if wp then
        if assetId == false or assetId == "" or assetId == "0" or assetId == "None (Def)" or assetId == "none" then
            wp.Image = ""
            wp.Visible = false
            currentCustomWallpaperId = ""
            setPanelTransparency(0)
            if MAINUIframe then
                MAINUIframe.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(9, 9, 13)
                MAINUIframe.BackgroundTransparency = 0
            end
        elseif assetId ~= nil then
            local strId = tostring(assetId)
            local cleanId
            if string.find(strId, "://") then
                cleanId = strId
            else
                local digits = string.match(strId, "%d+") or strId
                cleanId = "rbxassetid://" .. digits
            end
            currentCustomWallpaperId = cleanId
            wp.Image = cleanId
            wp.Visible = true
            wp.ImageTransparency = isSpookyTransparentActive and 0 or (1 - (currentWallpaperOpacity or 0.85))
            if currentPanelTransparency == 0 then
                setPanelTransparency(0.40)
            end
            if MAINUIframe then
                MAINUIframe.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(8, 8, 12)
            end
        end
    end
end
_G.SpookyApplyWallpaper = applyWallpaper

local function applyOverlayEffect(effectType)
    if getgenv().SpookyUIOverlay then
        if effectType == "Tech Grid Pattern" then
            getgenv().SpookyUIOverlay.Image = "rbxassetid://12975543160"
            getgenv().SpookyUIOverlay.ImageTransparency = 0.88
            getgenv().SpookyUIOverlay.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Tile
            getgenv().SpookyUIOverlay.TileSize = UDim2.new(0, 64, 0, 64)
            getgenv().SpookyUIOverlay.Visible = true
        elseif effectType == "Carbon Weave" then
            getgenv().SpookyUIOverlay.Image = "rbxassetid://2151741365"
            getgenv().SpookyUIOverlay.ImageTransparency = 0.90
            getgenv().SpookyUIOverlay.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Tile
            getgenv().SpookyUIOverlay.TileSize = UDim2.new(0, 100, 0, 100)
            getgenv().SpookyUIOverlay.Visible = true
        elseif effectType == "Vignette Dark Radial" then
            getgenv().SpookyUIOverlay.Image = "rbxassetid://6015897843"
            getgenv().SpookyUIOverlay.ImageTransparency = 0.70
            getgenv().SpookyUIOverlay.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Stretch
            getgenv().SpookyUIOverlay.Visible = true
        elseif effectType == "Hexagon Tech" then
            getgenv().SpookyUIOverlay.Image = "rbxassetid://300122283"
            getgenv().SpookyUIOverlay.ImageTransparency = 0.92
            getgenv().SpookyUIOverlay.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Tile
            getgenv().SpookyUIOverlay.TileSize = UDim2.new(0, 80, 0, 80)
            getgenv().SpookyUIOverlay.Visible = true
        else
            getgenv().SpookyUIOverlay.Image = ""
            getgenv().SpookyUIOverlay.Visible = false
        end
    end
end

local function saveUILayout()
    pcall(function()
        if writefile then
            local layoutData = {}
            for name, el in pairs(SpookyEditableElements) do
                if el and el.Parent then
                    if not originalUILayout[name] then
                        originalUILayout[name] = { Position = el.Position, Size = el.Size, AnchorPoint = el.AnchorPoint }
                    end
                    layoutData[name] = {
                        XS = el.Position.X.Scale,
                        XO = el.Position.X.Offset,
                        YS = el.Position.Y.Scale,
                        YO = el.Position.Y.Offset
                    }
                end
            end
            writefile("ProjectSpooky_UILayout.json", HttpService:JSONEncode(layoutData))
            notifyToggle("UI Layout Saved Successfully!", true)
        end
    end)
end
_G.SpookySaveLayout = saveUILayout

local function resetUILayout()
    pcall(function()
        if _G.SpookySideLayout then
            _G.SpookySideLayout.Enabled = true
        end
        for name, data in pairs(originalUILayout) do
            local el = SpookyEditableElements[name]
            if el and el.Parent then
                el.Position = data.Position
                if data.Size then el.Size = data.Size end
                if data.AnchorPoint then el.AnchorPoint = data.AnchorPoint end
            end
        end
        if MAINUIframe then
            MAINUIframe.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
            MAINUIframe.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
            lastUIPos = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
        end
        if _G.SpookyThemedElements.MobileToggle then
            _G.SpookyThemedElements.MobileToggle.Position = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0, 80)
        end
        if delfile and isfile and isfile("ProjectSpooky_UILayout.json") then
            delfile("ProjectSpooky_UILayout.json")
        end
        notifyToggle("UI Layout Reset to Default!", true)
    end)
end
_G.SpookyResetLayout = resetUILayout

local function loadUILayout()
    pcall(function()
        if isfile and isfile("ProjectSpooky_UILayout.json") and readfile then
            local raw = readfile("ProjectSpooky_UILayout.json")
            if raw and #raw > 10 then
                local data = HttpService:JSONDecode(raw)
                if data and type(data) == "table" then
                    for name, pos in pairs(data) do
                        local el = SpookyEditableElements[name]
                        if el and el.Parent and pos.XS ~= nil and pos.XO ~= nil and pos.YS ~= nil and pos.YO ~= nil then
                            el.Position = UDim2.new(pos.XS, pos.XO, pos.YS, pos.YO)
                            if name == "MainFrame" then
                                lastUIPos = el.Position
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end)
end

    isEditModeActive = false

        studioToolbar = nil
    end
end

    local function applyTheme(themeName)
        CurrentTheme = ThemeAccents[themeName] and themeName or "White"

    applyCustomAvatar = function(id)
        if not id or id == "" or id == "none" or id == "default" then
            currentCustomAvatarId = ""
            pcall(function()
                local thumb = Players:GetUserThumbnailAsync(LocalPlayer.UserId, Enum.ThumbnailType.HeadShot, Enum.ThumbnailSize.Size150x150)
                if thumb and _G.SpookyThemedElements and _G.SpookyThemedElements.playerProfile then
                    _G.SpookyThemedElements.playerProfile.Image = thumb
                elseif _G.SpookyThemedElements and _G.SpookyThemedElements.playerProfile then
                    _G.SpookyThemedElements.playerProfile.Image = "rbxthumb://type=AvatarHeadShot&id=" .. tostring(LocalPlayer.UserId) .. "&w=150&h=150"
                end
            end)
            saveUIConfig()
            notifyToggle("Default Avatar Restored", true)
            return
        end

        local strId = tostring(id)
        local cleanDigits = string.match(strId, "%d+")
        if not cleanDigits then return end

        local applied = false
        pcall(function()
            local num = tonumber(cleanDigits)
            if num and num > 0 and num < 100000000000 then
                local thumb = Players:GetUserThumbnailAsync(num, Enum.ThumbnailType.HeadShot, Enum.ThumbnailSize.Size150x150)
                if thumb and thumb ~= "" and _G.SpookyThemedElements and _G.SpookyThemedElements.playerProfile then
                    _G.SpookyThemedElements.playerProfile.Image = thumb
                    applied = true
                end
            end
        end)
        if not applied and _G.SpookyThemedElements and _G.SpookyThemedElements.playerProfile then
            _G.SpookyThemedElements.playerProfile.Image = "rbxassetid://" .. cleanDigits
        end
        currentCustomAvatarId = cleanDigits
        saveUIConfig()
        notifyToggle("Avatar Set: " .. cleanDigits, true)
    end

    resetAllToFactoryDefaults = function()
        pcall(function()
            for k in pairs(FeatureStates) do

            local char = LocalPlayer.Character
            if char then

            Settings.dashDist = 50
            Settings.flySpeed = 100
            Settings.superJumpHeight = 500
            resetUISettingsOnly()

                if delfile and isfile then
                    if isfile("ProjectSpooky_QuickToggles.json") then delfile("ProjectSpooky_QuickToggles.json") end

                    if isfile("ProjectSpooky_ESPConfig.json") then delfile("ProjectSpooky_ESPConfig.json") end
                    if isfile("spooky_ui_config.txt") then delfile("spooky_ui_config.txt") end
                    if isfile("spooky_theme.txt") then delfile("spooky_theme.txt") end
                    if isfile("spooky_config.txt") then delfile("spooky_config.txt") end
                end
            end)
            notifyToggle("ALL SETTINGS & UI RESET TO FACTORY DEFAULTS!", true)
        end)

    local function loadUIConfig()
        local applied = false
        pcall(function()
            if isfile and isfile("ProjectSpooky_UIConfig.json") and readfile then
                local raw = readfile("ProjectSpooky_UIConfig.json")
                if raw and #raw > 5 then
                    local data = HttpService:JSONDecode(raw)
                    if data and type(data) == "table" then
                        if data.theme then applyTheme(data.theme) end
                        if data.scale and data.scale >= 0.35 and data.scale <= 1.5 and UIScale then
                            UIScale.Scale = data.scale
                            currentBaseScale = data.scale
                            userCustomScale = data.scale
                            _G.InitialUIScaleVal = data.scale
                        end
                        if data.animation and _G.SpookySetUIAnimation then
                            _G.SpookySetUIAnimation(data.animation, data.animationDuration)
                        end
                        if data.font then
                            local fontEnum = Enum.Font[data.font] or Enum.Font.GothamBold
                            applyFontToAll(fontEnum, data.font)
                        end
                        if data.borderThickness then
                            applyBorderThickness(data.borderThickness)
                        end
                        if data.cornerRadius then
                            applyCornerRadius(data.cornerRadius)
                        end
                        if data.wallpaper and data.wallpaper ~= "" then
                            applyWallpaper(data.wallpaper, data.wallpaperOpacity)
                        end
                        if data.panelTransparency then
                            setPanelTransparency(data.panelTransparency)
                        end
                        if data.customAvatarId and data.customAvatarId ~= "" and applyCustomAvatar then
                            applyCustomAvatar(data.customAvatarId)
                        end
                        applied = true
                    end
                end
            end
            if not applied and isfile and isfile("spooky_ui_config.txt") and readfile then
                local raw = readfile("spooky_ui_config.txt")
                if raw and #raw > 2 then
                    local parts = string.split(raw, "|")
                    local savedTheme = parts[1]
                    local savedScale = parts[2] and tonumber(parts[2])
                    if savedTheme then applyTheme(savedTheme); applied = true end
                    if savedScale and UIScale then
                        UIScale.Scale = savedScale
                        currentBaseScale = savedScale
                    end
                end
            end
        end)
        if not applied then
            applyTheme(CurrentTheme or "White")
            applyWallpaper("rbxassetid://98256258425377", 0.85)
        end
        loadUILayout()
        return applied
    end

    local function parseColorInput(str)
        if not str or type(str) ~= "string" then return nil end
        local s = string.gsub(str, "%s+", "")
        local hex = string.match(s, "^#?([0-9a-fA-F]{6})$")
        if hex then
            local r = tonumber(string.sub(hex, 1, 2), 16) or 255
            local g = tonumber(string.sub(hex, 3, 4), 16) or 255
            local b = tonumber(string.sub(hex, 5, 6), 16) or 255
            return Color3.fromRGB(r, g, b)
        end
        local r, g, b = string.match(s, "^(%d+),(%d+),(%d+)$")
        if r and g and b then
            return Color3.fromRGB(math.clamp(tonumber(r) or 0, 255), math.clamp(tonumber(g) or 0, 255), math.clamp(tonumber(b) or 0, 255))
        end
        return nil
    end

    local function applyCustomAccent(col)
        if not col then return end
        local r, g, b = col.R * 255, col.G * 255, col.B * 255
        local brightCol = Color3.fromRGB(math.min(255, math.floor(r * 1.25)), math.min(255, math.floor(g * 1.25)), math.min(255, math.floor(b * 1.25)))
        _G.CurrentAccentColor = col
        _G.CurrentAccentColorBright = brightCol
        CurrentTheme = "Custom"
        pcall(function()
            local el = _G.SpookyThemedElements
            if el then
                if el.titleBanner then el.titleBanner.ImageColor3 = col end
                if el.spookyIcon then el.spookyIcon.ImageColor3 = col end
                if el.spookyIconStroke then el.spookyIconStroke.Color = col end
                if el.spookyFireAura and el.spookyFireAura.Parent then el.spookyFireAura.ImageColor3 = col end
                if el.spookyAuraStroke and el.spookyAuraStroke.Parent then el.spookyAuraStroke.Color = col end
                if el.spookyLbl then el.spookyLbl.TextColor3 = col end
                if el.CloseBtn then el.CloseBtn.TextColor3 = col end
                if el.MinimizeBtn then el.MinimizeBtn.TextColor3 = col end
                if el.changeHudBtn then
                    local chStk = el.changeHudBtn:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
                    if chStk then
                        chStk.Color = Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 58)
                    end
                    el.changeHudBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(235, 235, 245)
                end
                if el.playerProfileStroke then el.playerProfileStroke.Color = col end
                if el.AllHeaderEmblems then
                    for _, emb in ipairs(el.AllHeaderEmblems) do
                        if emb and emb.Parent then
                            emb.ImageColor3 = col
                        end
                    end
                end
                if el.MobileToggle then
                    el.MobileToggle.ImageColor3 = col
                    local mtStk = el.MobileToggle:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
                    if mtStk then mtStk.Color = col end
                end
            end
            if _G.UpdateSidebarVisual then _G.UpdateSidebarVisual(_G.CurrentActiveTab or "Home") end
            if _G.SpookyUpdateAnimButtonsVisual and _G.SpookyGetUIAnimation then
                _G.SpookyUpdateAnimButtonsVisual((_G.SpookyGetUIAnimation()))
            end

            if _G.SpookyESPCustomizerIcon and _G.SpookyESPCustomizerIcon.Parent then
                _G.SpookyESPCustomizerIcon.ImageColor3 = col
            end
            if _G.SpookyESPCustomizerBorder and _G.SpookyESPCustomizerBorder.Parent then
                _G.SpookyESPCustomizerBorder.Color = col
            end
            if _G.SpookyDockStroke and _G.SpookyDockStroke.Parent then
                _G.SpookyDockStroke.Color = col
            end
        end)
        saveUIConfig()
        notifyToggle("UI Accent Color Updated!", true)
    end
    _G.SpookyApplyCustomAccent = applyCustomAccent

    createActionButton(cWindowLayout, "Center Main Window", "Centrar Ventana Principal", UDim2.new(1, -12, 0, 26), UDim2.new(0, 6, 0, 26), function()
        if MAINUIframe then
            MAINUIframe.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
            MAINUIframe.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
            lastUIPos = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
            notifyToggle("Main Window Centered", true)
        end
    end)

    local uiResetBtn = createActionButton(cWindowLayout, "RESET UI SETTINGS (DEFAULT)", "RESTABLECER UI POR DEFECTO", UDim2.new(1, -12, 0, 28), UDim2.new(0, 6, 0, 58), function()
        if _G.SpookyResetUISettingsToDefault then
            _G.SpookyResetUISettingsToDefault()
        end
    end)
    pcall(function()
        local stk = uiResetBtn:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
        if stk then stk.Color = Color3.fromRGB(140, 115, 235); stk.Thickness = 1.3 end
        uiResetBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 185, 255)
    end)

    task.spawn(function()
        loadUIConfig()
    end)
end

local function mathClamp(val, minV, maxV)
    if math.clamp then return math.clamp(val, minV, maxV) end
    if val < minV then return minV end
    if val > maxV then return maxV end
    return val
end

local function showSpookyNotice(title, desc, isSuccess)
    pcall(function()
        if notifyToggle then
            notifyToggle(title .. ": " .. desc, isSuccess)
        else
            print(string.format("[Project Spooky] %s: %s (%s)", title, desc, isSuccess and "SUCCESS" or "WARN"))
        end
    end)
    pcall(function()
        local sg = game:GetService("StarterGui")
        if sg and sg.SetCore then
            sg:SetCore("SendNotification", {
                Title = title,
                Text = desc,
                Duration = 3.5
            })
        end
    end)
end

local Agent2_MacroConfigs = {}
_G.Agent2_MacroConfigs = Agent2_MacroConfigs
local B64_CHARS = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
local B64_LOOKUP = {}
for i = 1, 64 do
    B64_LOOKUP[B64_CHARS:sub(i, i)] = i - 1
end

local function base64Encode(data)
    if not data or #data == 0 then return "" end

    if crypt and crypt.base64encode then
        local ok, res = pcall(crypt.base64encode, data)
        if ok and res then return res end
    elseif syn and syn.crypt and syn.crypt.base64_encode then
        local ok, res = pcall(syn.crypt.base64_encode, data)
        if ok and res then return res end
    elseif base64_encode then
        local ok, res = pcall(base64_encode, data)
        if ok and res then return res end
    end

    local len = #data
    local out = {}
    local k = 1
    for i = 1, len, 3 do
        local b1 = data:byte(i)
        local b2 = data:byte(i + 1) or 0
        local b3 = data:byte(i + 2) or 0

        local n = (b1 * 65536) + (b2 * 256) + b3
        local c1 = math.floor(n / 262144) % 64
        local c2 = math.floor(n / 4096) % 64
        local c3 = math.floor(n / 64) % 64
        local c4 = n % 64

        out[k]     = B64_CHARS:sub(c1 + 1, c1 + 1)
        out[k + 1] = B64_CHARS:sub(c2 + 1, c2 + 1)

        if i + 1 > len then
            out[k + 2] = "="
            out[k + 3] = "="
        elseif i + 2 > len then
            out[k + 2] = B64_CHARS:sub(c3 + 1, c3 + 1)
            out[k + 3] = "="
        else
            out[k + 2] = B64_CHARS:sub(c3 + 1, c3 + 1)
            out[k + 3] = B64_CHARS:sub(c4 + 1, c4 + 1)
        end
        k = k + 4
    end
    return table.concat(out)
end

local function base64Decode(data)
    if not data or #data == 0 then return "" end

    if crypt and crypt.base64decode then
        local ok, res = pcall(crypt.base64decode, data)
        if ok and res then return res end
    elseif syn and syn.crypt and syn.crypt.base64_decode then
        local ok, res = pcall(syn.crypt.base64_decode, data)
        if ok and res then return res end
    elseif base64_decode then
        local ok, res = pcall(base64_decode, data)
        if ok and res then return res end
    end

    data = data:gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9+/=]", "")
    local len = #data
    local out = {}
    local k = 1
    for i = 1, len, 4 do
        local c1 = B64_LOOKUP[data:sub(i, i)] or 0
        local c2 = B64_LOOKUP[data:sub(i + 1, i + 1)] or 0
        local s3 = data:sub(i + 2, i + 2)
        local s4 = data:sub(i + 3, i + 3)
        local c3 = B64_LOOKUP[s3] or 0
        local c4 = B64_LOOKUP[s4] or 0

        local n = (c1 * 262144) + (c2 * 4096) + (c3 * 64) + c4
        local b1 = math.floor(n / 65536) % 256
        local b2 = math.floor(n / 256) % 256
        local b3 = n % 256

        out[k] = string.char(b1)
        k = k + 1

        if s3 ~= "=" and i + 2 <= len then
            out[k] = string.char(b2)
            k = k + 1
        end
        if s4 ~= "=" and i + 3 <= len then
            out[k] = string.char(b3)
            k = k + 1
        end
    end
    return table.concat(out)
end

Agent2_MacroConfigs.base64Encode = base64Encode
Agent2_MacroConfigs.base64Decode = base64Decode

local function exportMacroConfig()
    local payload = {
        type = "MACRO",
        version = 2,
        activeSlot = Settings.macroActiveSlot or 1,
        triggerKey = Settings.macroTriggerKey or "T",
        macroLoop = Settings.macroLoop or false,
        macroSmartDelay = Settings.macroSmartDelay ~= false,
        macroSmartSpeed = Settings.macroSmartSpeed or "Max",
        slots = Settings.macroSlots or {},
        customSteps = Settings.macroCustomSteps or {}
    }
    local json = HttpService:JSONEncode(payload)
    local encoded = "SPK_MACRO:" .. base64Encode(json)
    local ok = universalCopy(encoded)
    if ok then
        showSpookyNotice("Macro Config", "Configuración de Macro copiada al portapapeles!", true)
    else
        showSpookyNotice("Macro Config", "Código generado (Error de portapapeles)", false)
    end
    return encoded
end

Spooky.CreateDefaultBlock=function()
    return {enabled=false,weapon="Melee",skill="Z",mode="Tap",hold=0.35,delay=0.22,jumpsAfter=0,
        fallbackEnabled=false,fallbackWeapon="Sword",fallbackSkill="X",fallbackMode="Tap",fallbackHold=0.35}
end
Spooky.CreateDefaultSlot=function(name)
    local slot={name=name or "Slot",soruEnabled=false,soruAfter=0,m1Enabled=false,m1Weapon="Melee",m1Count=2,m1After=1,v3Enabled=false,v3After=0,steps={}}
    for i=1,10 do slot.steps[i]=Spooky.CreateDefaultBlock() end
    return slot
end
local function applyMacroConfigData(data)
    if _G.SpookyStopMacro then _G.SpookyStopMacro() end
    if not data or type(data) ~= "table" then return false end

    local slots = data.slots or data.macroSlots
    if slots and type(slots) == "table" and #slots >= 1 then
        Settings.macroSlots = slots
        for sIdx = 1, 5 do
            if not Settings.macroSlots[sIdx] then
                if Spooky.CreateDefaultSlot then
                    Settings.macroSlots[sIdx] = Spooky.CreateDefaultSlot("Slot " .. sIdx)
                else
                    Settings.macroSlots[sIdx] = { name = "Slot " .. sIdx, steps = {} }
                end
            end
            Settings.macroSlots[sIdx].steps = Settings.macroSlots[sIdx].steps or {}
            for st = 1, 10 do
                if not Settings.macroSlots[sIdx].steps[st] then
                    if Spooky.CreateDefaultBlock then
                        Settings.macroSlots[sIdx].steps[st] = Spooky.CreateDefaultBlock()
                    else
                        Settings.macroSlots[sIdx].steps[st] = { enabled = false, weapon = "Melee", skill = "Z", mode = "Tap", hold = 0.35, delay = 0.22 }
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    if data.activeSlot or data.macroActiveSlot then
        Settings.macroActiveSlot = math.floor(Spooky.Runtime.number(data.activeSlot or data.macroActiveSlot, 1, 1, 5))
    end

    if Settings.macroSlots and Settings.macroSlots[Settings.macroActiveSlot] then
        Settings.macroCustomSteps = Settings.macroSlots[Settings.macroActiveSlot].steps
    elseif data.customSteps and type(data.customSteps) == "table" then
        Settings.macroCustomSteps = data.customSteps
    end

    if data.triggerKey or data.macroTriggerKey then
        Settings.macroTriggerKey = tostring(data.triggerKey or data.macroTriggerKey):upper()
    end
    if data.macroLoop ~= nil or data.loop ~= nil then
        local lVal = (data.macroLoop ~= nil and data.macroLoop) or (data.loop ~= nil and data.loop)
        Settings.macroLoop = (lVal == true)
        if setFeatureState then setFeatureState("MacroLoopToggle", Settings.macroLoop) end
    end
    if data.macroSmartDelay ~= nil then Settings.macroSmartDelay = data.macroSmartDelay end
    if data.macroSmartSpeed then Settings.macroSmartSpeed = data.macroSmartSpeed end

    pcall(function()
        if slotNameBox and Settings.macroSlots[Settings.macroActiveSlot] then
            slotNameBox.Text = Settings.macroSlots[Settings.macroActiveSlot].name or ("Slot " .. Settings.macroActiveSlot)
        end
        if _G.SpookySelectMacroSlot then
            _G.SpookySelectMacroSlot(Settings.macroActiveSlot)
        end
        if _G.UpdateMacroBannerFunc then _G.UpdateMacroBannerFunc() end
        if _G.RefreshMacroStepsUI then _G.RefreshMacroStepsUI() end
        if _G.MacroStatusLabel then
            _G.MacroStatusLabel.Text = "STATUS: READY [Key: " .. (Settings.macroTriggerKey or "T") .. " - Auto-Timed]"
            _G.MacroStatusLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(140, 230, 255)
        end
        if _G.MacroFloatingStatus then
            _G.MacroFloatingStatus.Text = "READY [" .. (Settings.macroTriggerKey or "T") .. "]"
            _G.MacroFloatingStatus.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(140, 230, 255)
        end
    end)

    pcall(function()
        if writefile then
            local sv = {
                name = "MacroProfile",
                customSteps = Settings.macroCustomSteps,
                triggerKey = Settings.macroTriggerKey or "T",
                slots = Settings.macroSlots
            }
            writefile("Spooky_MacroSteps.json", HttpService:JSONEncode(sv))
        end
    end)
    return true
end

local function applyUIConfigData(data)
    if not data or type(data) ~= "table" then return false end
    local success,configError=pcall(function()
        local t = data.theme or data.t
        if t and _G.ApplyTheme then _G.ApplyTheme(t) end

        local s = tonumber(data.scale or data.s)
        if s and UIScale then
            s = mathClamp(s, 0.40, 1.50)
            UIScale.Scale = s
            currentBaseScale = s
            userCustomScale = s
        end

        local a = data.animation or data.a
        local ad = tonumber(data.animationDuration or data.ad) or 0.28
        if a and _G.SpookySetUIAnimation then
            _G.SpookySetUIAnimation(a, ad)
        end

        local f = data.font or data.f
        if f and _G.SpookyApplyFontToAll then
            local fEnum = Enum.Font[f] or Enum.Font.GothamBold
            _G.SpookyApplyFontToAll(fEnum, f)
        end

        local bt = tonumber(data.borderThickness or data.bt)
        if bt and _G.SpookyApplyBorderThickness then
            _G.SpookyApplyBorderThickness(bt)
        end

        local cr = tonumber(data.cornerRadius or data.cr)
        if cr and _G.SpookyApplyCornerRadius then
            _G.SpookyApplyCornerRadius(cr)
        end

        local w = data.wallpaper or data.w
        local wo = tonumber(data.wallpaperOpacity or data.wo) or 0.85
        if w ~= nil and applyWallpaper then
            applyWallpaper(w, wo)
        end

        local pt = tonumber(data.panelTransparency or data.pt)
        if pt ~= nil and setPanelTransparency then
            setPanelTransparency(pt)
        end

        if _G.saveUIConfig then _G.saveUIConfig() end
    end)
    if not success then Spooky.ReportIssue("UI config",configError);return false end
    return true
end

local function applyGlobalConfigData(data)
    if not data or type(data) ~= "table" then return false end
    if data.PlayerBlacklist then Spooky.RestorePlayerBlacklist(data.PlayerBlacklist) end

    local s = data.settings or data.S
    if s and type(s) == "table" then
        for k, v in pairs(s) do
            if Settings[k] ~= nil then
                Settings[k] = v
            end
        end
        if s.w then Settings.walkSpeed = s.w end
        if s.d then Settings.dashDist = s.d end
        if s.f then Settings.flySpeed = s.f end
        if s.tk then Settings.macroTriggerKey = s.tk end
        if s.mcs then Settings.macroCustomSteps = s.mcs end
    end

    if data.features and type(data.features) == "table" then
        local activeSet = {}
        for _, f in ipairs(data.features) do activeSet[f] = true end
        for fName in pairs(FeatureStates) do
            local desired = activeSet[fName] == true
            if setFeatureState then setFeatureState(fName, desired) end
        end
    elseif data.F and type(data.F) == "table" then
        for _, k in ipairs(data.F) do
            if setFeatureState then setFeatureState(k, true) end
        end
    end

    if data.language and applyLanguage then applyLanguage(data.language,true) end
    if type(data.CustomControls) == "table" then
        if _G.SpookySetCustomControls then _G.SpookySetCustomControls(data.CustomControls)
        else Spooky.PendingCustomControls = data.CustomControls end
    end

    if data.ui then
        applyUIConfigData(data.ui)
    end

    if type(data.FloatPos) == "table" then
        if _G.SpookySetFloatingPositions then _G.SpookySetFloatingPositions(data.FloatPos)
        else Spooky.PendingFloatingPositions = data.FloatPos end
    end

    if data.macro then
        applyMacroConfigData(data.macro)
    end

    local kbData = data.keybinds or data.KB
    if kbData and type(kbData) == "table" and _G.ALL_KEYBIND_DEFS then
        local targetKBs = _G.PCKeybinds or PCKeybinds
        if targetKBs then
            table.clear(targetKBs)
            for _, s in ipairs(kbData) do
                for _, def in ipairs(_G.ALL_KEYBIND_DEFS) do
                    if Spooky.ResolveFeature(def.id) == Spooky.ResolveFeature(s.id) then
                        table.insert(targetKBs, {
                            id = def.id,
                            name = def.name,
                            mode = def.mode,
                            key = s.key or def.defaultKey,
                            run = def.run
                        })
                        break
                    end
                end
            end
            if _G.savePCKeybinds then _G.savePCKeybinds() end
            if _G.RefreshKeybindsList then pcall(_G.RefreshKeybindsList) end
        end
    end

    return true
end

local function importConfigString(str)
    if not str or type(str) ~= "string" then
        showSpookyNotice("Import Config", "Pega un código de configuración válido!", false)
        return false, "No data provided"
    end

    str = string.match(str, "^%s*(.-)%s*$")
    if #str < 4 then
        showSpookyNotice("Import Config", "Código de configuración demasiado corto!", false)
        return false, "String too short"
    end

    local decodedTable = nil
    local isPrefixedMacro = string.sub(str, 1, 10) == "SPK_MACRO:"
    local isPrefixedUI = string.sub(str, 1, 7) == "SPK_UI:"
    local isPrefixedGlobal = string.sub(str, 1, 11) == "SPK_GLOBAL:" or string.sub(str, 1, 8) == "SPK_CFG:"

    local rawPayload = str
    if isPrefixedMacro then
        rawPayload = string.sub(str, 11)
    elseif isPrefixedUI then
        rawPayload = string.sub(str, 8)
    elseif isPrefixedGlobal then
        if string.sub(str, 1, 11) == "SPK_GLOBAL:" then
            rawPayload = string.sub(str, 12)
        else
            rawPayload = string.sub(str, 9)
        end
    end

    if isPrefixedMacro or isPrefixedUI or isPrefixedGlobal then
        local b64Decoded = base64Decode(rawPayload)
        local okB64Json, resB64Json = pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONDecode(b64Decoded) end)
        if okB64Json and type(resB64Json) == "table" then
            decodedTable = resB64Json
        end
    end

    if not decodedTable then
        local okJson, resJson = pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONDecode(rawPayload) end)
        if okJson and type(resJson) == "table" then
            decodedTable = resJson
        else

            local b64Decoded = base64Decode(rawPayload)
            if b64Decoded and #b64Decoded > 0 then
                local okB64Json, resB64Json = pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONDecode(b64Decoded) end)
                if okB64Json and type(resB64Json) == "table" then
                    decodedTable = resB64Json
                end
            end
        end
    end

    if not decodedTable or type(decodedTable) ~= "table" then
        showSpookyNotice("Import Config", "Código de configuración inválido o dañado!", false)
        return false, "Decode failed"
    end

    local cfgType = decodedTable.type
    local handled = false

    if cfgType == "MACRO" or isPrefixedMacro or decodedTable.slots or decodedTable.macroSlots or decodedTable.customSteps then
        handled = applyMacroConfigData(decodedTable)
        if handled then
            showSpookyNotice("Configuración Importada", "Configuración de Macro importada con éxito!", true)
            return true, "Macro"
        end
    elseif cfgType == "UI" or isPrefixedUI or (decodedTable.theme and decodedTable.scale) or decodedTable.t then
        handled = applyUIConfigData(decodedTable)
        if handled then
            showSpookyNotice("Configuración Importada", "Configuración UI importada con éxito!", true)
            return true, "UI"
        end
    elseif cfgType == "GLOBAL" or isPrefixedGlobal or decodedTable.features or decodedTable.F or decodedTable.settings then
        handled = applyGlobalConfigData(decodedTable)
        if handled then
            showSpookyNotice("Configuración Importada", "Configuración Global importada con éxito!", true)
            return true, "Global"
        end
    end

    local ranAny = false
    if decodedTable.slots or decodedTable.macroSlots then
        applyMacroConfigData(decodedTable)
        ranAny = true
    end
    if decodedTable.theme or decodedTable.scale or decodedTable.t then
        applyUIConfigData(decodedTable)
        ranAny = true
    end
    if decodedTable.features or decodedTable.F or decodedTable.settings then
        applyGlobalConfigData(decodedTable)
        ranAny = true
    end

    if ranAny then
        showSpookyNotice("Configuración Importada", "Configuración importada con éxito!", true)
        return true, "Generic"
    else
        showSpookyNotice("Import Config", "Formato de configuración no reconocido!", false)
        return false, "Unrecognized format"
    end
end

    local function getCompactUIConfigString()
        local animName, animDur = "Pop", 0.28
        if _G.SpookyGetUIAnimation then animName, animDur = _G.SpookyGetUIAnimation() end
        local pack = {
            t = CurrentTheme or "White",
            s = currentBaseScale or 0.85,
            a = animName or "Pop",
            ad = animDur or 0.28,
            f = currentUIFontName or "GothamBold",
            bt = currentBorderThickness or 1.5,
            cr = currentCornerRadius or 8,
            w = currentCustomWallpaperId or "",
            wo = currentWallpaperOpacity or 0.85,
            pt = currentPanelTransparency or 0
        }
        return "SPK_UI:" .. HttpService:JSONEncode(pack)
    end

    local function applyCompactUIConfig(data)
        if not data or type(data) ~= "table" then return false end
        pcall(function()
            if data.t and _G.ApplyTheme then _G.ApplyTheme(data.t) end
            if data.s and UIScale then
                UIScale.Scale = data.s
                currentBaseScale = data.s
                userCustomScale = data.s
            end
            if data.a and _G.SpookySetUIAnimation then
                _G.SpookySetUIAnimation(data.a, data.ad or 0.28)
            end
            if data.f and _G.SpookyApplyFontToAll then
                local fEnum = Enum.Font[data.f] or Enum.Font.GothamBold
                _G.SpookyApplyFontToAll(fEnum, data.f)
            end
            if data.bt and _G.SpookyApplyBorderThickness then
                _G.SpookyApplyBorderThickness(data.bt)
            end
            if data.cr and _G.SpookyApplyCornerRadius then
                _G.SpookyApplyCornerRadius(data.cr)
            end
            if data.w ~= nil and applyWallpaper then
                applyWallpaper(data.w, data.wo or 0.85)
            end
            if data.pt ~= nil and setPanelTransparency then
                setPanelTransparency(data.pt)
            end
            if _G.saveUIConfig then _G.saveUIConfig() end
        end)
        return true
    end

    local function getCompactConfigString()
        local activeFeats = {}
        local allToggles = {}
        for k, v in pairs(FeatureStates) do
            allToggles[k] = (v == true)
            if v == true then table.insert(activeFeats, k) end
        end
        local kbList = {}
        local kbs = _G.PCKeybinds or PCKeybinds
        if kbs then
            for _, ent in ipairs(kbs) do
                table.insert(kbList, { id = ent.id, key = ent.key })
            end
        end
        local floatPos = nil
        pcall(function()
            if _G.SpookyGetFloatingPositions then floatPos = _G.SpookyGetFloatingPositions() end
        end)
        local isLocked = (_G.SpookyLockFloatingButtons == true) or (FeatureStates and FeatureStates["LockFloatingButtons"] == true)
        local pack = {
            F = activeFeats,
            PlayerBlacklist = Spooky.ExportPlayerBlacklist(),
            Toggles = allToggles,
            Locked = isLocked,
            FloatPos = floatPos,
            CustomControls = _G.SpookyGetCustomControls and _G.SpookyGetCustomControls() or {},
            CustomFunctions = _G.SpookyGetCustomFunctions and _G.SpookyGetCustomFunctions() or {},
            language = CurrentLang,
            S = {
                aimMode = Settings.aimMode,
                aimFovRadius = Settings.aimFovRadius,
                aimFovOrigin = Settings.aimFovOrigin,
                aimTargetPolicy = Settings.aimTargetPolicy,
                aimTargetUserId = Settings.aimTargetUserId,
                w = Settings.walkSpeed,
                d = Settings.dashDist,
                f = Settings.flySpeed,
                m = Settings.macroMode,
                u = currentBaseScale,
                t = CurrentTheme,
                tc = Settings.tracerColorName,
                cp = Settings.camLockTargetPart,
                tk = Settings.macroTriggerKey,
                mcs = Settings.macroCustomSteps,
                minLvl = Settings.ignoreLowLevelThreshold,
                camSmooth = Settings.camLockSmoothness
            },
            KB = kbList,
            V = "SPK2"
        }
        return "SPK_CFG:" .. HttpService:JSONEncode(pack)
    end

    local function applyCompactConfigString(str)
        if not str or #str < 4 then return false end
        if string.sub(str, 1, 7) == "SPK_UI:" then
            local jsonPart = string.sub(str, 8)
            local ok, data = pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONDecode(jsonPart) end)
            if ok and data then
                return applyCompactUIConfig(data)
            end
            return false
        end
        if string.sub(str, 1, 8) == "SPK_CFG:" then
            str = string.sub(str, 9)
        end
        local ok, data = pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONDecode(str) end)
        if ok and data and (data.F or data.Toggles) then
            if data.PlayerBlacklist then Spooky.RestorePlayerBlacklist(data.PlayerBlacklist) end
            if data.S then
                for _, key in ipairs({"aimMode","aimFovRadius","aimFovOrigin","aimTargetPolicy","aimTargetUserId"}) do
                    if data.S[key] ~= nil then Settings[key] = data.S[key] end
                end
                if data.S.w then Settings.walkSpeed = data.S.w end
                if data.S.d then Settings.dashDist = data.S.d end
                if data.S.f then Settings.flySpeed = data.S.f end
                if data.S.u and UIScale then UIScale.Scale = data.S.u; currentBaseScale = data.S.u end
                if data.S.t and _G.ApplyTheme then _G.ApplyTheme(data.S.t) end
                if data.S.tc then Settings.tracerColorName = data.S.tc end
                if data.S.cp then Settings.camLockTargetPart = data.S.cp end
                if data.S.tk then Settings.macroTriggerKey = data.S.tk end
                if data.S.minLvl then Settings.ignoreLowLevelThreshold = data.S.minLvl end
                if data.S.camSmooth then Settings.camLockSmoothness = data.S.camSmooth end
                if data.S.mcs then
                    Settings.macroCustomSteps = data.S.mcs
                    if _G.UpdateMacroBannerFunc then pcall(_G.UpdateMacroBannerFunc) end
                    if _G.RefreshMacroStepsUI then pcall(_G.RefreshMacroStepsUI) end
                end
            end
            if data.Toggles and type(data.Toggles) == "table" then
                for k, v in pairs(data.Toggles) do
                    setFeatureState(k, v)
                end
            elseif data.F then
                for _, k in ipairs(data.F) do
                    setFeatureState(k, true)
                end
            end
            if data.Locked ~= nil then
                setFeatureState("LockFloatingButtons", data.Locked)
                _G.SpookyLockFloatingButtons = data.Locked
            end
    if data.language and applyLanguage then applyLanguage(data.language,true) end
    if type(data.CustomControls) == "table" then
        if _G.SpookySetCustomControls then _G.SpookySetCustomControls(data.CustomControls)
        else Spooky.PendingCustomControls = data.CustomControls end
    end
            if type(data.FloatPos) == "table" then
                if _G.SpookySetFloatingPositions then _G.SpookySetFloatingPositions(data.FloatPos)
                else Spooky.PendingFloatingPositions = data.FloatPos end
            end
            if data.KB and type(data.KB) == "table" and _G.ALL_KEYBIND_DEFS then
                local targetKBs = _G.PCKeybinds or PCKeybinds
                if targetKBs then
                    table.clear(targetKBs)
                    for _, s in ipairs(data.KB) do
                        for _, def in ipairs(_G.ALL_KEYBIND_DEFS) do
                            if Spooky.ResolveFeature(def.id) == Spooky.ResolveFeature(s.id) then
                                table.insert(targetKBs, {
                                    id = def.id,
                                    name = def.name,
                                    mode = def.mode,
                                    key = s.key or def.defaultKey,
                                    run = def.run
                                })
                                break
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    if _G.savePCKeybinds then _G.savePCKeybinds() end
                    if _G.RefreshKeybindsList then pcall(_G.RefreshKeybindsList) end
                end
            end
            return true
        elseif ok and data and (data.t or data.theme or data.scale or data.animation) then
            return applyCompactUIConfig(data)
        end
        return false
    end

        pcall(function()

            if isfile and isfile("ProjectSpooky_UIConfig.json") and readfile then
                local raw = readfile("ProjectSpooky_UIConfig.json")
                if raw and #raw > 10 then
                    local ok, data = pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONDecode(raw) end)
                    if ok and data then
                        applyCompactUIConfig(data)
                        return
                    end
                end
            end

            if isfile and isfile("spooky_ui_config.txt") and readfile then
                local raw = readfile("spooky_ui_config.txt")
                if raw and #raw > 2 then
                    local parts = string.split(raw, "|")
                    local savedTheme = parts[1]
                    local savedScale = parts[2] and tonumber(parts[2])
                    if savedTheme and _G.ApplyTheme then _G.ApplyTheme(savedTheme) end
                    if savedScale and savedScale >= 0.35 and savedScale <= 1.5 and UIScale then
                        UIScale.Scale = savedScale
                        currentBaseScale = savedScale
                        userCustomScale = savedScale
                    end
                end
            end
        end)
    end

do
    local AntiStunActive = false
    local StunConnections = {}
    local CurrentChar = nil
    local CurrentRoot = nil
    local StunObject = nil
    local StunConn = nil
    local LastStunVal = 0
    local MoverEpoch = 0
    local AttrTimes = { Character = {}, HRP = {} }
    local HostileUntil = 0

    local HostileAttrsChar = { LastDamageTick = true, LastDamageTakenAt = true, InCombat = true }
    local HostileAttrsHRP = {
        LastDetectedDuration = true, LastDetectedTimestamp = true, LastDetectedPriority = true,
        LastDetectedVelocity = true, LastDetectedKnockback = true, LastStunAnimation = true, IdleStunCounter = true
    }

    local function cancelHostileMovers()
        if not AntiStunActive or not CurrentRoot then return end
        pcall(function()
            for _, m in ipairs(CurrentRoot:GetChildren()) do
                if (m:IsA("BodyVelocity") or m:IsA("BodyPosition") or m:IsA("BodyGyro")) and m.Name ~= "RootVelocity" and m.Name ~= "Keep" and not m.Name:match("^Spooky_") then
                    pcall(function() m:Destroy() end)
                end
            end
        end)
    end

    local function onStunChanged()
        if not AntiStunActive or not StunObject then return end
        local val = tonumber(StunObject.Value) or 0
        if val > 0 then
            local now = os.clock()
            local recentDmg = math.max(AttrTimes.Character.LastDamageTick or 0, AttrTimes.Character.LastDamageTakenAt or 0)
            local isHostile = (now - recentDmg <= 0.35) or (now <= HostileUntil)
            if isHostile then
                StunObject.Value = 0
                cancelHostileMovers()
            end
        end
    end

    local function cleanupAntiStunChar()
        for _, c in ipairs(StunConnections) do
            pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end)
        end
        table.clear(StunConnections)
        if StunConn then pcall(function() StunConn:Disconnect() end); StunConn = nil end
        StunObject = nil
        CurrentRoot = nil
        CurrentChar = nil
    end

    local function bindAntiStun(char)
        cleanupAntiStunChar()
        if not char or not char.Parent then return end
        CurrentChar = char
        CurrentRoot = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        AttrTimes = { Character = {}, HRP = {} }

        table.insert(StunConnections, char.AttributeChanged:Connect(function(attr)
            if HostileAttrsChar[attr] then
                local now = os.clock()
                AttrTimes.Character[attr] = now
                HostileUntil = now + 0.35
                cancelHostileMovers()
                if StunObject and (tonumber(StunObject.Value) or 0) > 0 then
                    StunObject.Value = 0
                end
            end
        end))

        if CurrentRoot then
            table.insert(StunConnections, CurrentRoot.AttributeChanged:Connect(function(attr)
                if HostileAttrsHRP[attr] then
                    local now = os.clock()
                    AttrTimes.HRP[attr] = now
                    HostileUntil = now + 0.35
                    cancelHostileMovers()
                end
            end))
        end

        local function watchChild(child)
            if child.Name == "Stun" and child:IsA("NumberValue") then
                StunObject = child
                if StunConn then pcall(function() StunConn:Disconnect() end) end
                StunConn = child.Changed:Connect(onStunChanged)
                onStunChanged()
            elseif child.Name == "HumanoidRootPart" then
                CurrentRoot = child
            end
        end

        table.insert(StunConnections, char.ChildAdded:Connect(watchChild))
        table.insert(StunConnections, char.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(child)
            if child == StunObject then
                if StunConn then pcall(function() StunConn:Disconnect() end); StunConn = nil end
                StunObject = nil
            end
        end))

        local existingStun = char:FindFirstChild("Stun")
        if existingStun and existingStun:IsA("NumberValue") then
            watchChild(existingStun)
        end
    end

    function _G.SpookySetAntiStun(enabled)
        AntiStunActive = (enabled == true)
        if AntiStunActive then
            bindAntiStun(LocalPlayer.Character)
        else
            cleanupAntiStunChar()
        end
    end

    LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(newChar)
        if AntiStunActive then
            task.delay(0.2, function()
                bindAntiStun(newChar)
            end)
        end
    end)

    task.spawn(function()
        local lastAttempt = 0
        while isCurrentSession() do
            task.wait(0.4)
            if not isCurrentSession() then return end
            if FeatureStates["AutoV3"] or Settings.autoV3 then
                local now = os.clock()
                if now - lastAttempt >= 1.5 then
                    lastAttempt = now
                    pcall(function()
                        local rem = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("Remotes")
                        local commE = rem and rem:FindFirstChild("CommE")
                        if commE then
                            commE:FireServer("ActivateAbility")
                        else
                            local commF = rem and rem:FindFirstChild("CommF_")
                            if commF then commF:InvokeServer("ActivateAbility") end
                        end
                    end)
                end
            end
        end
    end)
end
