do
    local HitboxExpanderActive = false
    getgenv().tomultiply = 250

    task.spawn(function()
        pcall(function()
            local rs = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
            local mod = rs:WaitForChild("Modules", 5)
            local cuInst = mod and mod:WaitForChild("CombatUtil", 5)
            if cuInst then
                local CombatUtil = require(cuInst)
                if CombatUtil and typeof(CombatUtil) == "table" and CombatUtil.GetWeaponData then
                    local oldGetWeaponData = CombatUtil.GetWeaponData
                    CombatUtil.GetWeaponData = function(...)
                        local Data = oldGetWeaponData(...)
                        if not HitboxExpanderActive or not Data then
                            return Data
                        end
                        local Proxy = {}
                        setmetatable(Proxy, {
                            __index = function(self, key)
                                local val = Data[key]
                                if key == "HitboxMagnitude" and typeof(val) == "number" then
                                    local mult = tonumber(getgenv().tomultiply) or 250
                                    return val * mult
                                end
                                return val
                            end,
                            __newindex = function(self, key, val)
                                Data[key] = val
                            end
                        })
                        return Proxy
                    end
                end
            end
        end)
    end)

    function _G.SpookySetHitboxExpander(v)
        HitboxExpanderActive = (v == true)
    end
end

    local RegisterHit = nil
    local RegisterAttack = nil
    local function resolveAttackRemotes()
        if RegisterHit and RegisterAttack then return true end
        pcall(function()
            local net = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("Modules", 2):WaitForChild("Net", 2)
            if net then
                RegisterHit = net:FindFirstChild("RE/RegisterHit") or net["RE/RegisterHit"]
                RegisterAttack = net:FindFirstChild("RE/RegisterAttack") or net["RE/RegisterAttack"]
            end
        end)
        return (RegisterHit ~= nil and RegisterAttack ~= nil)
    end

    local lastFastAttackTime = 0
    local function executeFastAttackBurst()
        local now = tick()
        if now - lastFastAttackTime < math.max(tonumber(Settings.fastAttackDelay) or 0.15,0.12) then return end
        lastFastAttackTime = now
        local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
        local myHRP = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not myHRP then return end
        local isCasting = myChar:GetAttribute("isUsingSkill") or myChar:GetAttribute("UsingSkill") or myChar:GetAttribute("Busy")
        if isCasting == true then return end
        local currentTool = myChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
        if not currentTool or currentTool.ToolTip == "Gun" then return end
        local myPos = myHRP.Position
        local hitList = {}
        local enemies = workspace:FindFirstChild("Enemies")
        if enemies then
            for _, npc in ipairs(enemies:GetChildren()) do
                local hum = npc:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                local hrp = npc:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                local head = npc:FindFirstChild("Head") or hrp
                if hum and hum.Health > 0 and hrp and head and (hrp.Position - myPos).Magnitude <= 120 then
                    table.insert(hitList, { npc, head })
                end
            end
        end
        for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if p ~= LocalPlayer and p.Character then
                local hum = p.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                local hrp = p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                local head = p.Character:FindFirstChild("Head") or hrp
                if hum and hum.Health > 0 and hrp and head and _G.SpookyCombatTargetValid and _G.SpookyCombatTargetValid(p,120) then
                    table.insert(hitList, { p.Character, head })
                end
            end
        end
        if #hitList > 0 and Spooky.TakeAttackBudget("M1", Settings.fastAttackDelay) then
            local trimmedList = {}
            for i = 1, math.min(#hitList, 3) do
                table.insert(trimmedList, hitList[i])
            end
            local primaryPart = trimmedList[1][2]
            local targetPos = primaryPart.Position
            local diff = targetPos - myPos
            local aimDir = (diff.Magnitude > 0.05 and diff.Unit) or Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
            pcall(function()
                if currentTool and currentTool:FindFirstChild("LeftClickRemote") then
                    currentTool.LeftClickRemote:FireServer(aimDir, 1)
                elseif resolveAttackRemotes() then
                    RegisterAttack:FireServer(0)
                    RegisterHit:FireServer(primaryPart, trimmedList)
                end
            end)
        end
    end

    local lastFastAttackTick = 0
    registerConnection(RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        if not (FeatureStates["FastAttack"] or Settings.fastAttack) then return end
        local now = tick()
        if now - lastFastAttackTick < math.max(tonumber(Settings.fastAttackDelay) or 0.15,0.12) then return end
        lastFastAttackTick = now
        executeFastAttackBurst()
    end))

    M1Extender = (function()
        local M = {}
        local active = false
        local maxRange = 100

        local function getExtTarget()
            local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
            local myRoot = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if not myRoot then return nil end
            local myPos = myRoot.Position
            local target, shortestDist = nil, maxRange

            local enemies = workspace:FindFirstChild("Enemies")
            if enemies then
                for _, v in ipairs(enemies:GetChildren()) do
                    local eRoot = v:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                    local eHum = v:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                    if eRoot and eHum and eHum.Health > 0 then
                        local dist = (eRoot.Position - myPos).Magnitude
                        if dist < shortestDist then
                            shortestDist = dist
                            target = v
                        end
                    end
                end
            end

            local chars = workspace:FindFirstChild("Characters")
            if chars then
                for _, v in ipairs(chars:GetChildren()) do
                    if v ~= myChar then
                        local eRoot = v:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                        local eHum = v:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                        if eRoot and eHum and eHum.Health > 0 then
                            local dist = (eRoot.Position - myPos).Magnitude
                            if dist < shortestDist then
                                shortestDist = dist
                                target = v
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end

            for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                if p ~= LocalPlayer and p.Character and p.Character ~= myChar then
                    local eRoot = p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                    local eHum = p.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                    if eRoot and eHum and eHum.Health > 0 then
                        local dist = (eRoot.Position - myPos).Magnitude
                        if dist < shortestDist then
                            shortestDist = dist
                            target = p.Character
                        end
                    end
                end
            end

            return target
        end

        local lastM1Fire = 0
        local function triggerM1Attack()
            if not (FeatureStates["M1Extender"] or Settings.m1Extender) then return end
            local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
            local tool = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
            if not tool then return end

            local now = tick()
            if now - lastM1Fire < 0.12 then return end
            lastM1Fire = now

            local target = getExtTarget()
            if not target then return end
            local head = target:FindFirstChild("Head") or target:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if not head then return end

            local owner = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(target)
            if owner and (not _G.SpookyCombatTargetValid or not _G.SpookyCombatTargetValid(owner,100)) then return end
            if tool.ToolTip == "Gun" or myChar:GetAttribute("UsingSkill") or myChar:GetAttribute("isUsingSkill") or myChar:GetAttribute("Busy") then return end
            if not Spooky.TakeAttackBudget("M1",0.15) then return end
            local myHRP = myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if myHRP and tool:FindFirstChild("LeftClickRemote") then
                local dir = (head.Position - myHRP.Position).Unit
                pcall(function()
                    tool.LeftClickRemote:FireServer(dir, 1)
                end)
            elseif resolveAttackRemotes() then
                pcall(function()
                    RegisterAttack:FireServer(0)
                    local hitData = {}
                    table.insert(hitData, {target,head})
                    local sessionId = tostring(LocalPlayer.UserId):sub(2, 4) .. tostring(coroutine.running()):sub(11, 15)
                    RegisterHit:FireServer(head, hitData, {}, sessionId)
                end)
            end
        end

        registerConnection(UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
            if processed then return end
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
                triggerM1Attack()
            end
        end))

        local function bindTool(tool)
            if not tool or not tool:IsA("Tool") then return end
            registerConnection(tool.Activated:Connect(function()
                triggerM1Attack()
            end))
        end

        if LocalPlayer.Character then
            for _, item in ipairs(LocalPlayer.Character:GetChildren()) do
                if item:IsA("Tool") then bindTool(item) end
            end
            LocalPlayer.Character.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
                if child:IsA("Tool") then bindTool(child) end
            end)
        end
        LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(newChar)
            newChar.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
                if child:IsA("Tool") then bindTool(child) end
            end)
        end)

        function M:Toggle(v) active = v end
        function M:SetRange(v) maxRange = 100 end
        return M
    end)()

    task.spawn(function()
        while isCurrentSession() do
            if FeatureStates["AutoV4"] or Settings.autoV4 then
                local char = LocalPlayer.Character
                if char then
                    local energy = char:FindFirstChild("RaceEnergy")
                    local transformed = char:FindFirstChild("RaceTransformed")
                    local stun = char:FindFirstChild("Stun")
                    local busy = char:FindFirstChild("Busy")

                    local hasEnergy = energy and tonumber(energy.Value) and tonumber(energy.Value) >= 1
                    local notTransformed = not transformed or (transformed.Value ~= true)
                    local notStunned = not stun or (tonumber(stun.Value) or 0) <= 0
                    local notBusy = not busy or (busy.Value ~= true)

                    if hasEnergy and notTransformed and notStunned and notBusy then
                        pcall(function()
                            local remotes = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("Remotes")
                            local commE = remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("CommE")
                            if commE then commE:FireServer("ActivateAwakening", true) end
                        end)
                        pcall(function()
                            local bp = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack") or LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("Backpack")
                            local awk = (bp and bp:FindFirstChild("Awakening")) or (char and char:FindFirstChild("Awakening"))
                            if awk then
                                local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                                if awk.Parent == bp and hum then
                                    pcall(function() hum:EquipTool(awk) end)
                                end
                                pcall(function() awk:Activate() end)
                                local rf = awk:FindFirstChild("RemoteFunction")
                                if rf and rf:IsA("RemoteFunction") then pcall(function() rf:InvokeServer(true) end) end
                            end
                        end)
                        task.wait(2.0)
                    end
                end
                task.wait(0.5)
            else
                task.wait(0.5)
            end
        end
    end)

    task.spawn(function()
        while isCurrentSession() do
            if FeatureStates["AutoBuso"] or Settings.autoBuso then
                local char = LocalPlayer.Character
                if char and not char:FindFirstChild("HasBuso") then
                    pcall(function()
                        local rem = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("Remotes")
                        local commF = rem and rem:FindFirstChild("CommF_")
                        if commF then commF:InvokeServer("Buso") end
                    end)
                end
                task.wait(1.0)
            else
                task.wait(0.5)
            end
        end
    end)

    task.spawn(function()
        while isCurrentSession() do
            if FeatureStates["AutoKen"] or Settings.autoKen then
                pcall(function()
                    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
                    if char and not char:FindFirstChild("KenDisabled") then
                        local pGui = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
                        if pGui then
                            local ctx = pGui:FindFirstChild("MobileContextButtons")
                            local cFrame = ctx and ctx:FindFirstChild("ContextButtonFrame")
                            local kBtn = cFrame and cFrame:FindFirstChild("BoundActionKen")
                            if kBtn and kBtn:GetAttribute("Selected") ~= true then
                                kBtn:SetAttribute("Selected", true)
                            end
                        end
                        local om = (getrenv and getrenv()._G and getrenv()._G.OM) or (_G and _G.OM)
                        if om and not om.active then
                            om.radius = 0
                            om:setActive(true)
                            local remotes = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("Remotes")
                            local commE = remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("CommE")
                            if commE then commE:FireServer("Ken", true) end
                        elseif not om then
                            local remotes = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("Remotes")
                            local commE = remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("CommE")
                            if commE then commE:FireServer("Ken", true) end
                        end
                    end
                end)
                task.wait(0.2)
            else
                task.wait(0.5)
            end
        end
    end)

    _G.FruitsM1Enable = false
    _G.FruitsM1DelayValue = 0.15

    local function GetFruitRemote()
        local char = LocalPlayer.Character
        local tool = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
        if not tool or getToolCategory(tool) ~= "Fruit" then return nil end
        local remote = tool:FindFirstChild("LeftClickRemote") or tool:FindFirstChild("ClickRemote") or tool:FindFirstChild("M1Remote")
        if remote and remote:IsA("RemoteEvent") then return remote end
        for _, child in ipairs(tool:GetChildren()) do
            if child:IsA("RemoteEvent") and child.Name:lower():find("click") then return child end
        end
    end
    task.spawn(function()
        while isCurrentSession() do
            task.wait(math.clamp(tonumber(_G.FruitsM1DelayValue) or 0.15, 0.15, 2))
            if not isCurrentSession() then break end
            if _G.FruitsM1Enable or FeatureStates["OneShotKitsune"] then
                pcall(function()
                    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
                    local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                    local remote = GetFruitRemote()
                    if not root or not remote then return end

                    local folders = {workspace:FindFirstChild("Characters"), workspace:FindFirstChild("Enemies")}
                    for _, folder in pairs(folders) do
                        for _, model in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
                            local hrp = model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                            local hum = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                            local player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model)
                            local excluded = player and (not _G.SpookyCombatTargetValid or not _G.SpookyCombatTargetValid(player,500))
                            if model ~= char and not excluded and hrp and hum and hum.Health > 0 and (hrp.Position-root.Position).Magnitude < 500 then
                                remote:FireServer(Vector3.new(9e30, 9e30, 9e30), 5, false)
                                return
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end)
            end
        end
    end)

end

    local function hasToolEquipped()
        local char = LocalPlayer.Character
        return char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool") ~= nil

    local function pressKey(kc, holdDuration)
        if not kc then return end
        isSimulatingKeys = true
        pcall(function()
            local vim = game:GetService("VirtualInputManager")
            vim:SendKeyEvent(true, kc, false, nil)
            task.wait(holdDuration or 0.08)
            vim:SendKeyEvent(false, kc, false, nil)
        end)
        task.wait(0.02)
        isSimulatingKeys = false
    end
    local function getCategoryForSlot(rawSlot)
        if type(rawSlot) == "string" then
            if rawSlot == "Melee" or rawSlot == "Sword" or rawSlot == "Gun" or rawSlot == "Fruit" then
                return rawSlot
            end
        end
        local num = tonumber(rawSlot)
        if num == 1 then return "Melee"
        elseif num == 2 then return "Fruit"
        elseif num == 3 then return "Sword"
        elseif num == 4 then return "Gun" end
        return nil
    end
    local function safeEquipCategory(targetCat)
        if not targetCat or targetCat == "None" then return end
        local char = LocalPlayer.Character
        if not char then return end
        local currentTool = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
        if currentTool and getToolCategory(currentTool) == targetCat then
            return currentTool
        end
        local bp = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack") or LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("Backpack")
        local toolToEquip = nil
        if bp then
            for _, t in ipairs(bp:GetChildren()) do
                if t:IsA("Tool") and getToolCategory(t) == targetCat then
                    toolToEquip = t
                    break
                end
            end
        end
        local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if toolToEquip and hum then
            hum:EquipTool(toolToEquip)
            local t0 = tick()
            while tick() - t0 < 0.25 do
                if char:FindFirstChild(toolToEquip.Name) then break end
                task.wait(0.03)
            end
            return toolToEquip
        end
        local slotNum = toolToSlotNum[targetCat] or 1
        local kc = SLOT_KEYS[slotNum]
        if kc then
            pressKey(kc, 0.05)
            task.wait(0.12)
        end
        return char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
    end
    local function clickMacroMouse(waitDuration)
        pcall(function()
            if mouse1click then
                mouse1click()
                return
            end
            local vu = game:GetService("VirtualUser")
            if vu then
                vu:Button1Down(Vector2.zero)
                task.wait(waitDuration or 0.08)
                vu:Button1Up(Vector2.zero)
            end
        end)
    end

    local HideControlActive = false
    local HideV4Active = false
    local ControlConnections = {}
    local V4Connections = {}

    local function hideInstanceFX(inst)
        if not inst then return end
        pcall(function()
            if inst:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or inst:IsA("Trail") or inst:IsA("Beam") then
                inst.Enabled = false
                inst.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(1)
            elseif inst:IsA("Highlight") then
                inst.Enabled = false
                inst.FillTransparency = 1
                inst.OutlineTransparency = 1
            elseif inst:IsA("Light") or inst:IsA("Fire") or inst:IsA("Smoke") or inst:IsA("Sparkles") then
                inst.Enabled = false
            elseif inst:IsA("BasePart") then
                inst.Transparency = 1
                inst.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1
                inst.CastShadow = false
                inst.Size = Vector3.zero
                local sm = inst:FindFirstChildOfClass("SpecialMesh")
                if sm then sm.Scale = Vector3.zero end
                for _, sub in ipairs(inst:GetChildren()) do
                    if sub:IsA("Decal") or sub:IsA("Texture") then
                        sub.Transparency = 1
                    end
                end
            elseif inst:IsA("Decal") or inst:IsA("Texture") then
                inst.Transparency = 1
            end
        end)
    end

    local controlKeywords = {
        "control", "room", "globe", "cube", "dagger", "levitat", "sphere", "teleport_effect", "echoingslash", "dome", "area", "ring", "koko", "domain", "controlroom", "slash"
    }

    local function isControlEffect(inst)
        if not inst or not inst.Parent then return false end
        if inst:IsA("Model") and inst:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then return false end
        if inst == workspace.Terrain then return false end
        local map = workspace:FindFirstChild("Map")
        if map and (inst == map or inst:IsDescendantOf(map)) then return false end

        local n = string.lower(inst.Name)
        for _, kw in ipairs(controlKeywords) do
            if string.find(n, kw, 1, true) then
                return true
            end
        end
        local p = inst.Parent
        if p and p ~= workspace and p.Name ~= "Characters" and p.Name ~= "Enemies" then
            local pn = string.lower(p.Name)
            for _, kw in ipairs(controlKeywords) do
                if string.find(pn, kw, 1, true) then
                    return true
                end
            end
        end
        return false
    end

    local function processControlInstance(child)
        if not HideControlActive or not child then return end
        if isControlEffect(child) then
            hideInstanceFX(child)
            for _, d in ipairs(child:GetDescendants()) do
                hideInstanceFX(d)
                if d:IsA("AnimationTrack") then
                    pcall(function() d:AdjustSpeed(0) end)
                end
            end
        end
    end

    local function stopControlWatchers()
        for _, conn in ipairs(ControlConnections) do
            pcall(function() conn:Disconnect() end)
        end
        table.clear(ControlConnections)
    end

    function _G.SpookySetHideControlEffects(enabled)
        HideControlActive = (enabled == true)
        stopControlWatchers()
        if HideControlActive then

            local origin = workspace:FindFirstChild("_WorldOrigin")
            if origin then
                for _, ch in ipairs(origin:GetDescendants()) do
                    processControlInstance(ch)
                end
                table.insert(ControlConnections, origin.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(child)
                    if HideControlActive then task.defer(processControlInstance, child) end
                end))
            end

            local fx = workspace:FindFirstChild("Effects") or workspace:FindFirstChild("FX")
            if fx then
                for _, ch in ipairs(fx:GetDescendants()) do
                    processControlInstance(ch)
                end
                table.insert(ControlConnections, fx.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(child)
                    if HideControlActive then task.defer(processControlInstance, child) end
                end))
            end

            for _, ch in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
                processControlInstance(ch)
            end
            table.insert(ControlConnections, workspace.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
                if HideControlActive then
                    task.defer(processControlInstance, child)
                    if child.Name == "_WorldOrigin" or child.Name == "Effects" or child.Name == "FX" then
                        table.insert(ControlConnections, child.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(desc)
                            if HideControlActive then task.defer(processControlInstance, desc) end
                        end))
                    end
                end
            end))

            for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                if p.Character then
                    for _, ch in ipairs(p.Character:GetDescendants()) do
                        processControlInstance(ch)
                    end
                    table.insert(ControlConnections, p.Character.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(child)
                        if HideControlActive then task.defer(processControlInstance, child) end
                    end))
                end
                table.insert(ControlConnections, p.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(newChar)
                    if HideControlActive then
                        table.insert(ControlConnections, newChar.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(child)
                            if HideControlActive then task.defer(processControlInstance, child) end
                        end))
                    end
                end))
            end

            task.spawn(function()
                while HideControlActive and isCurrentSession() do
                    task.wait(1.5)
                    local wo = workspace:FindFirstChild("_WorldOrigin")
                    if wo then
                        for _, ch in ipairs(wo:GetChildren()) do
                            if isControlEffect(ch) then processControlInstance(ch) end
                        end
                    end
                    for _, ch in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
                        if isControlEffect(ch) then processControlInstance(ch) end
                    end
                end
            end)
        end
    end

    local function scanV4Container(container)
        if not container then return end
        for _, obj in ipairs(container:GetDescendants()) do
            hideInstanceFX(obj)
        end
    end

    function _G.SpookySetHideV4Effects(enabled)
        HideV4Active = (enabled == true)
        if HideV4Active then
            pcall(function()
                local effect = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("Effect")
                local container = effect and effect:FindFirstChild("Container")
                if container then
                    scanV4Container(container:FindFirstChild("RaceAwakenings"))
                    scanV4Container(container:FindFirstChild("RaceTransformation"))
                    scanV4Container(container:FindFirstChild("DracoRace"))
                end
                local fx = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("FX")
                if fx then scanV4Container(fx:FindFirstChild("DracoRace")) end
            end)
            for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                local c = p.Character
                if c then
                    for _, d in ipairs(c:GetDescendants()) do
                        local n = string.lower(d.Name)
                        if n:find("v4") or n:find("awakening") or n:find("aura") or n:find("transformation") then
                            hideInstanceFX(d)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

            local now = tick()
            if now - lastUpdate < 0.1 then return end
            lastUpdate = now

            local char = LocalPlayer.Character
            local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if hum then
                local maxHp = math.max(hum.MaxHealth, 1)
                local curHp = math.clamp(hum.Health, 0, maxHp)
                local pct = curHp / maxHp
                hpBar.Size = UDim2.new(pct, 0, 1, 0)
                hpText.Text = "HP: " .. tostring(math.floor(curHp)) .. " (" .. tostring(math.floor(pct * 100)) .. "%)"
                if pct > 0.5 then
                    hpBar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 210, 100)
                elseif pct > 0.25 then
                    hpBar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 180, 40)
                else
                    hpBar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(230, 60, 60)
                end
            else
                hpText.Text = "HP: Dead"
                hpBar.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0)
            end

            local pMs = (getClientPing and getClientPing()) or 50
            local curFps = math.floor(1 / math.max(dt or 0.016, 0.001))
            curFps = math.clamp(curFps, 1, 144)
            pingLbl.Text = tostring(curFps) .. "FPS | " .. tostring(math.floor(pMs)) .. "ms"
            if pMs < 80 then
                pingLbl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(80, 240, 140)
            elseif pMs < 160 then
                pingLbl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 200, 60)
            else
                pingLbl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 70, 70)
            end

            local tChar = _G.lockedAim1Char or _G.lockedAim2Char or _G.centuTargetChar
            if tChar and tChar.Parent then
                local tHum = tChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                local tHrp = tChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or tChar:FindFirstChild("Head") or tChar.PrimaryPart
                local tName = tChar.Name
                local myRoot = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                local dist = (myRoot and tHrp) and math.floor((tHrp.Position - myRoot.Position).Magnitude) or 0

                if tHum and tHum.Health > 0 then
                    local tMax = math.max(tHum.MaxHealth, 1)
                    local tCur = math.clamp(tHum.Health, 0, tMax)
                    local tPct = tCur / tMax
                    targetLbl.Text = "TARGET: " .. string.sub(tName, 1, 12) .. " (" .. tostring(math.floor(tCur)) .. " HP)"
                    targetLbl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 120)
                    targetSubLbl.Text = "Dist: " .. tostring(dist) .. " studs | " .. tostring(math.floor(tPct * 100)) .. "% HP"
                    targetSubLbl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 220, 255)
                    tHpBar.Size = UDim2.new(tPct, 0, 1, 0)
                    if tPct > 0.5 then
                        tHpBar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 80)
                    else
                        tHpBar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 30, 30)
                    end
                else
                    targetLbl.Text = "TARGET: " .. string.sub(tName, 1, 12) .. " (DEAD)"
                    targetLbl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(160, 160, 175)
                    targetSubLbl.Text = "Dist: " .. tostring(dist) .. " studs | Offline"
                    tHpBar.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0)
                end
            else
                targetLbl.Text = "TARGET: None"
                targetLbl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(160, 160, 175)
                targetSubLbl.Text = "Scanning active arena..."
                tHpBar.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0)
            end
        end)    end

    FeatureCallbacks["CombatHUD"] = function(v)
        if v then
            createCombatHUDWidget()
            notifyToggle("Combat HUD: ENABLED", true)
        else

            if CombatHUDWidgetGui then CombatHUDWidgetGui:Destroy(); CombatHUDWidgetGui = nil end
            notifyToggle("Combat HUD: DISABLED", false)
        end
    end

        local function updateVisuals()
            local stepData = getStepData()

                toggleStepBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(18, 40, 58)

                toggleStepBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(90, 225, 255)

            weaponBtn.BackgroundColor3 = pal.bg
            weaponBtn.Text = stepData.weapon or "Melee"
            weaponBtn.TextColor3 = pal.txt
            wStk.Color = pal.stroke

                holdBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(36, 26, 12)
                holdBtn.Text = "HOLD"
                holdBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 195, 75)
                hStk.Color = Color3.fromRGB(150, 100, 30)

                holdBtn.Text = "TAP"
                holdBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 155, 180)
                hStk.Color = Color3.fromRGB(38, 38, 52)
            end

            local jCount = tonumber(stepData.jumpsAfter or stepData.postJumps) or 0
            if jCount > 0 then
                jumpsBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(16, 32, 28)
                jumpsBtn.Text = jCount .. " Jump" .. (jCount > 1 and "s" or "")
                jumpsBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(110, 240, 180)
                jStk.Color = Color3.fromRGB(35, 110, 75)
            else
                jumpsBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(16, 16, 24)
                jumpsBtn.Text = "0 Jumps"
                jumpsBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(130, 130, 150)
                jStk.Color = Color3.fromRGB(38, 38, 50)
            end
        end

        end)

        local function getValidSkills()
            local stepData = getStepData()
            return WEAPON_SKILLS[stepData and stepData.weapon] or { "Z", "X", "C" }
        end

        weaponBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            local stepData = getStepData()
            if not stepData then return end
            local wIdx = 1
            for idx, wN in ipairs(weaponChoices) do
                if wN == stepData.weapon then wIdx = idx; break end
            end
            wIdx = (wIdx % #weaponChoices) + 1
            stepData.weapon = weaponChoices[wIdx]
            local vs = getValidSkills()
            local found = false
            for _, sk in ipairs(vs) do
                if sk == stepData.skill then found = true; break end
            end
            if not found then stepData.skill = vs[1] end
            updateVisuals()
            refreshBanner()
        end)

        skillBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            local stepData = getStepData()
            if not stepData then return end
            local vs = getValidSkills()
            local curIdx = 1
            for idx, sk in ipairs(vs) do
                if sk == stepData.skill then curIdx = idx; break end
            end
            local nextIdx = (curIdx % #vs) + 1
            stepData.skill = vs[nextIdx]
            updateVisuals()
            refreshBanner()
        end)

        holdBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            local stepData = getStepData()
            if not stepData then return end
            if stepData.mode == "Hold" or stepData.hold == true then
                stepData.mode = "Tap"
                stepData.hold = false
            else
                stepData.mode = "Hold"
                stepData.hold = 0.35
            end
            updateVisuals()
            refreshBanner()
        end)

        jumpsBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            local stepData = getStepData()
            if not stepData then return end
            local curJ = tonumber(stepData.jumpsAfter or stepData.postJumps) or 0
            curJ = (curJ + 1) % 6
            stepData.jumpsAfter = curJ
            stepData.postJumps = curJ
            updateVisuals()
        end)
    end

    Spooky.TryMacroInput = function(input)
        if not isCurrentSession() or Spooky.LastMacroInput == input then return end
        if not FeatureStates["MacroMasterToggle"] then return end
        Spooky.LastMacroInput = input
        if executeMacroCombo then executeMacroCombo() end
    end

    local macroLastToggleTime = 0
    UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gpe)
        if gpe or isSimulatingKeys or (_G.IsSyntheticKey and _G.IsSyntheticKey(input.KeyCode)) then return end
        if UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox() then return end
        local tKeyName = Settings.macroTriggerKey or "T"
        local tKeyCode = Enum.KeyCode[tKeyName] or Enum.KeyCode.T
        if FeatureStates["MacroMasterToggle"] and input.KeyCode == tKeyCode then

            if Spooky.IsMacroRunning and Spooky.IsMacroRunning() then
                if isSimulatingKeys or (_G.IsSyntheticKey and (_G.IsSyntheticKey(input.KeyCode) or _G.IsSyntheticKey(tKeyName))) then
                    return
                end
                if tick() - macroLastToggleTime < 0.6 then
                    return
                end
            end
            Spooky.TryMacroInput(input)
        end
    end)

    local function triggerAwakeningV4(on)
        pcall(function()
            local rem = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("Remotes")
            local commE = rem and rem:FindFirstChild("CommE")
            if commE then commE:FireServer("ActivateAwakening", on ~= false) end
            local bp = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack") or LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("Backpack")
            local char = LocalPlayer.Character
            local awk = (bp and bp:FindFirstChild("Awakening")) or (char and char:FindFirstChild("Awakening"))
            if awk then
                local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                if awk.Parent == bp and hum then
                    pcall(function() hum:EquipTool(awk) end)
                end
                pcall(function() awk:Activate() end)
                local rf = awk:FindFirstChild("RemoteFunction")
                if rf and rf:IsA("RemoteFunction") then pcall(function() rf:InvokeServer(on ~= false) end) end
                local re = awk:FindFirstChild("RemoteEvent")
                if re and re:IsA("RemoteEvent") then pcall(function() re:FireServer(on ~= false) end) end
            end
        end)
    end
    _G.SpookyTriggerAwakeningV4 = triggerAwakeningV4

    local function triggerInstantSoru()
        pcall(function()
            local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
            local hrp = myChar and (myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or myChar.PrimaryPart)
            if not hrp then return end

            pcall(function()
                myChar:SetAttribute("FlashstepCooldown", 0.95)
            end)

            local hum = myChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if hum then
                pcall(function()
                    local anim = Instance.new("Animation")
                    anim.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://17555632156"
                    local tr = hum:LoadAnimation(anim)
                    tr.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action
                    tr:Play()
                end)
                pcall(function()
                    local snd = Instance.new("Sound")
                    snd.SoundId = "rbxassetid://313762630"
                    snd.Volume = 2
                    snd.Parent = hrp
                    snd:Play()
                    game:GetService("Debris"):AddItem(snd, 2.5)
                end)
            end

            local targetPos = _G.SoruTargetPos or _G.aimbot1TargetPos or _G.centuAimPosition or _G.G_SilentAimTargetPos
            if not targetPos then
                local getter = _G.GetClosestPlayerCombat or _G.GetClosestPlayerAny
                if getter then
                    local char = getter(350)
                    local tHrp = char and (char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or char.PrimaryPart)
                    if tHrp then targetPos = tHrp.Position end
                end
            end
            if not targetPos then
                local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
                local lookDir = cam and cam.CFrame.LookVector or hrp.CFrame.LookVector
                targetPos = hrp.Position + (lookDir * 110)
            end

            if targetPos then
                _G.SoruTargetPos = targetPos
                pcall(function()
                    local rem = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("Remotes")
                    local commF = rem and rem:FindFirstChild("CommF_")
                    if commF then commF:InvokeServer("Blink", targetPos) end
                end)
                pcall(function()
                    hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(targetPos + Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0), targetPos + Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0) + hrp.CFrame.LookVector)
                    hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
                end)
            end
        end)
    end
    _G.SpookyTriggerInstantSoru = triggerInstantSoru

    local function savePCKeybinds()
        pcall(function()
            if writefile and HttpService then
                local saved = {}
                for _, ent in ipairs(PCKeybinds) do
                    table.insert(saved, { id = ent.id, key = ent.key })
                end
                writefile("ProjectSpooky_PCKeybinds.json", HttpService:JSONEncode(saved))
            end
        end)
    end
    _G.savePCKeybinds = savePCKeybinds

    pcall(function()
        if isfile and isfile("ProjectSpooky_PCKeybinds.json") and readfile and HttpService then
            local raw = readfile("ProjectSpooky_PCKeybinds.json")
            local list = HttpService:JSONDecode(raw)
            if type(list) == "table" and #list > 0 then
                for _, s in ipairs(list) do
                    for _, def in ipairs(ALL_KEYBIND_DEFS) do
                        if Spooky.ResolveFeature(def.id) == Spooky.ResolveFeature(s.id) then
                            table.insert(PCKeybinds, {
                                id = def.id,
                                name = def.name,
                                mode = def.mode,
                                key = s.key or def.defaultKey,
                                run = def.run
                            })
                            break
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end)

                        local exists = false
                        for _, existing in ipairs(PCKeybinds) do
                            if existing.id == def.id then exists = true break end
                        end
                        if not exists then
                            table.insert(PCKeybinds, {
                                id = def.id,
                                name = def.name,

    local function refreshPageIslands()
        for _, c in ipairs(islandsScroll:GetChildren()) do
            if c:IsA("Frame") then c:Destroy() end
        end
        local islands = Islands_NightSlayer[activeSea] or {}
        local char = LocalPlayer.Character
        local myHrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        for idx, isl in ipairs(islands) do
            local row = Instance.new("Frame", islandsScroll)
            row.Name = "Row_" .. isl.name
            row.Size = UDim2.new(1, -6, 0, 36)
            row.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(18, 18, 22)
            row.BorderSizePixel = 0
            Instance.new("UICorner", row).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
            local rowStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", row)
            rowStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(34, 34, 42)
            local dist = 0
            pcall(function()
                if myHrp and isl.cf and isl.cf.Position and myHrp.Position then
                    dist = math.floor((isl.cf.Position - myHrp.Position).Magnitude)
                end
            end)
            local nameLbl = Instance.new("TextLabel", row)
            nameLbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, -145, 1, 0)
            nameLbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 0)
            nameLbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            nameLbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
            nameLbl.Text = string.format("%d. %s   [%dm]", idx, isl.name, dist)
            nameLbl.TextSize = 12
            nameLbl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(235, 235, 245)
            nameLbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
            local isThisIslandActive = isTweeningIsland and (activeTweenTargetName == isl.name)
            local onBtn = Instance.new("TextButton", row)
            onBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 58, 0, 26)
            onBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -128, 0.5, -13)
            onBtn.BackgroundColor3 = isThisIslandActive and Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255) or Color3.fromRGB(14, 14, 18)
            onBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
            onBtn.Text = "ON"
            onBtn.TextSize = 11.5
            onBtn.TextColor3 = isThisIslandActive and Color3.fromRGB(12, 12, 15) or Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 240)
            onBtn.AutoButtonColor = false
            Instance.new("UICorner", onBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 5)
            local onStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", onBtn)
            onStroke.Color = isThisIslandActive and Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255) or Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 55)
            onBtn.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function()
                onBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
                onBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(12, 12, 15)
                onStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
            end)
            onBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                startIslandTween(isl.cf, isl.name)
            end)
            local offBtn = Instance.new("TextButton", row)
            offBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 58, 0, 26)
            offBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -64, 0.5, -13)
            offBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(14, 14, 18)
            offBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
            offBtn.Text = "OFF"
            offBtn.TextSize = 11.5
            offBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 240)
            offBtn.AutoButtonColor = false
            Instance.new("UICorner", offBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 5)
            local offStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", offBtn)
            offStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 55)
            offBtn.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function()
                offBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
                offBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(12, 12, 15)
                offStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
            end)
            local function resetOffVisual()
                TweenService:Create(offBtn, TweenInfo.new(0.18), {
                    BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(14, 14, 18),
                    TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 240)
                }):Play()
                TweenService:Create(offStroke, TweenInfo.new(0.18), {
                    Color = Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 55)
                }):Play()
            end
            offBtn.MouseButton1Up:Connect(resetOffVisual)
            offBtn.MouseLeave:Connect(resetOffVisual)
            offBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                stopIslandTween()
            end)
        end
        islandsScroll.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, #islands * 41 + 10)
    end
    for i, sData in ipairs(seaDataList) do
        local isSeaActive = (activeSea == sData.id)
        local btn = Instance.new("TextButton", seaTabsFrame)
        btn.Size = UDim2.new(0.32, -4, 1, 0)
        btn.Position = UDim2.new((i - 1) * 0.34, 0, 0, 0)
        btn.BackgroundColor3 = isSeaActive and Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255) or Color3.fromRGB(14, 14, 18)
        btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        btn.Text = sData.name
        btn.TextSize = 11
        btn.TextColor3 = isSeaActive and Color3.fromRGB(12, 12, 15) or Color3.fromRGB(180, 180, 190)
        btn.AutoButtonColor = false
        Instance.new("UICorner", btn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
        local sStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", btn)
        sStroke.Color = isSeaActive and Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255) or Color3.fromRGB(42, 42, 50)
        seaButtons[sData.id] = { btn = btn, stroke = sStroke }
        btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            activeSea = sData.id
            for sId, bData in pairs(seaButtons) do
                local sel = (sId == activeSea)
                TweenService:Create(bData.btn, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {
                    BackgroundColor3 = sel and Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255) or Color3.fromRGB(14, 14, 18),
                    TextColor3 = sel and Color3.fromRGB(12, 12, 15) or Color3.fromRGB(180, 180, 190)
                }):Play()
                TweenService:Create(bData.stroke, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {
                    Color = sel and Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255) or Color3.fromRGB(42, 42, 50)
                }):Play()
            end
            refreshPageIslands()
        end)
    end
    refreshPageIslands()
    local prevHook = onIslandTweenStateChanged
    onIslandTweenStateChanged = function(active, name)
        if prevHook then pcall(prevHook, active, name) end
        if statusText and statusText.Parent then
            statusText.Text = active and ("TWEENING: " .. (name or "Island")) or "STATUS: IDLE"
            statusText.TextColor3 = active and Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255) or Color3.fromRGB(160, 160, 170)
        end
        if statusDot and statusDot.Parent then
            statusDot.BackgroundColor3 = active and Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255) or Color3.fromRGB(120, 120, 125)
        end
        refreshPageIslands()
    end
end

    local function buildCornerBrackets(parentBox)
        local container = Instance.new("Frame", parentBox)
        container.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
        container.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        container.ZIndex = 5006

        local lines = {}
        local len, th = 14, 2

        local function addCorner(alignRight, alignBottom)
            local h = Instance.new("Frame", container)
            h.Size = UDim2.new(0, len, 0, th)
            h.Position = UDim2.new(alignRight and 1 or 0, alignRight and -len or 0, alignBottom and 1 or 0, alignBottom and -th or 0)
            h.BackgroundColor3 = _G.G_ESP_Color or _G.CurrentAccentColor or Color3.fromRGB(160, 130, 255)
            h.BorderSizePixel = 0
            h.ZIndex = 5007
            table.insert(lines, h)

            local v = Instance.new("Frame", container)
            v.Size = UDim2.new(0, th, 0, len)
            v.Position = UDim2.new(alignRight and 1 or 0, alignRight and -th or 0, alignBottom and 1 or 0, alignBottom and -len or 0)
            v.BackgroundColor3 = _G.G_ESP_Color or _G.CurrentAccentColor or Color3.fromRGB(160, 130, 255)
            v.BorderSizePixel = 0
            v.ZIndex = 5007
            table.insert(lines, v)
        end

        addCorner(false, false)
        addCorner(true, false)
        addCorner(false, true)
        addCorner(true, true)

        return { container = container, lines = lines }
    end

        updatePreview = function()
            local isSimple = (_G.G_ESP_SimpleMode == true or (FeatureStates and FeatureStates["SimpleEsp"] == true))
            local parts = {}
            if isSimple then
                parts[#parts+1] = "[SpookyTarget]\nHP: 12450/12450 (100%)"
                tagContainer.Size = UDim2.new(0, 140, 0, 32)
                previewAvatar.Visible = false
            else
                tagContainer.Size = UDim2.new(0, 190, 0, 75)
                previewAvatar.Visible = (_G.G_ESP_AvatarPhoto ~= false)
                if _G.G_ESP_Name ~= false then
                    parts[#parts+1] = "[Pirates] <font color=\"rgb(255,255,0)\">SpookyTarget</font>"
                end
                if _G.G_ESP_Level ~= false then
                    parts[#parts+1] = " [Lv.2550]"
                end
                if _G.G_ESP_PvP ~= false then
                    parts[#parts+1] = "\n<font color=\"rgb(255,70,70)\">[PVP] PVP: ON</font>"
                end
                if _G.G_ESP_Bounty ~= false then
                    parts[#parts+1] = " | Bounty: 30.0M"
                end
                if _G.G_ESP_Fruit ~= false then
                    parts[#parts+1] = "\nFruit: Kitsune"
                end
                local hpStr = ""
                local fmt = _G.G_ESP_HP_Format or "Numbers"
                if _G.G_ESP_HP ~= false then
                    if fmt == "Numbers" then
                        hpStr = "HP: 12450 / 12450"
                    elseif fmt == "Percentage" then
                        hpStr = "Health: 100%"
                    else
                        hpStr = "HP: 12450/12450 (100%)"
                    end
                end
                local distUnit = _G.G_ESP_DistanceUnit or "Meters"
                local distText = (distUnit == "Studs") and "150 studs" or "42m"
                local distStr = (_G.G_ESP_Distance ~= false) and (distText .. " | ") or ""
                if distStr ~= "" or hpStr ~= "" then
                    parts[#parts+1] = "\n" .. distStr .. hpStr
                end
            end
            previewTag.Text = table.concat(parts)
            previewTag.Font = _G.G_ESP_Font or Enum.Font.GothamBold
            previewTag.TextSize = isSimple and 10 or (_G.G_ESP_TextSize or 11)

            local col = _G.G_ESP_Color or _G.CurrentAccentColor or Color3.fromRGB(160, 130, 255)

            local bStyle = _G.G_ESP_BoxStyle or "Full"
            if _G.G_ESP_Boxes == false or bStyle == "None" then
                previewBox.Visible = false
            elseif bStyle == "Corners" then
                previewBox.Visible = true
                pBoxStk.Enabled = false
                cornerRefs.container.Visible = true
                for _, cl in ipairs(cornerRefs.lines) do
                    cl.BackgroundColor3 = col
                end
            else
                previewBox.Visible = true
                pBoxStk.Enabled = true
                pBoxStk.Color = col
                cornerRefs.container.Visible = false
            end

            previewTracer.Visible = (_G.G_ESP_Tracers == true)
            previewTracer.BackgroundColor3 = col
            previewAvatar.Visible = (_G.G_ESP_AvatarPhoto ~= false)
            previewTag.TextColor3 = col

            mannequin.visor.BackgroundColor3 = col
            mannequin.core.BackgroundColor3 = col
            mannequin.chams.BackgroundColor3 = col
            mannequin.chamsStk.Color = col

    createToggleButton(v3, "RainbowSkybox", "Rainbow Skybox", "Cielo Rainbow", BW, UDim2.new(0, X1, 0, 98))
    createActionButton(v3, "Ship Custom Window", "Ventana de Barcos", BW, UDim2.new(0, X2, 0, 98), function()
        if openShipModWindow then openShipModWindow() end
    end)

    local cAvatar = makeCard(VisualPage, "Avatar & Clothing Cloner", "Clonador de Ropa", 148, 394)
    createToggleButton(cAvatar, "AvatarDeleteAccessories", "Delete Old Accs", "Borrar Accs Viejos", BW, UDim2.new(0, X1, 0, 24))
    createToggleButton(cAvatar, "AvatarNoCollide", "No-Collide Accs", "Sin Colision Accs", BW, UDim2.new(0, X2, 0, 24))

    FeatureStates["AvatarDeleteAccessories"] = true
    FeatureStates["AvatarNoCollide"] = true

    local originalAvatarData = {
        saved = false,
        shirt = nil,
        pants = nil,
        colors = nil,
        face = nil,
        accessories = {}
    }

    local function saveMyOriginalAvatar()
        local char = LocalPlayer.Character
        if not char then return end
        if originalAvatarData.saved then return end

        local shirt = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Shirt")
        if shirt then originalAvatarData.shirt = shirt.ShirtTemplate end
        local pants = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Pants")
        if pants then originalAvatarData.pants = pants.PantsTemplate end
        local colors = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("BodyColors")
        if colors then
            originalAvatarData.colors = {
                HeadColor = colors.HeadColor,
                TorsoColor = colors.TorsoColor,
                LeftArmColor = colors.LeftArmColor,
                RightArmColor = colors.RightArmColor,
                LeftLegColor = colors.LeftLegColor,
                RightLegColor = colors.RightLegColor
            }
        end
        local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head")
        local face = head and head:FindFirstChild("face")
        if face then originalAvatarData.face = face.Texture end

        originalAvatarData.accessories = {}
        for _, obj in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
            if obj:IsA("Accessory") then
                pcall(function()
                    obj.Archivable = true
                    local cl = obj:Clone()
                    if cl then table.insert(originalAvatarData.accessories, cl) end
                end)
            end
        end

        originalAvatarData.saved = true
    end

    task.spawn(function()
        if LocalPlayer.Character then saveMyOriginalAvatar() end
        LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
            task.wait(1.5)
            originalAvatarData.saved = false
            saveMyOriginalAvatar()
        end)
    end)

    local function MakeAccessoryNonCollidable(accessory)
        if not accessory or not accessory:IsA("Accessory") then return end
        for _, obj in ipairs(accessory:GetDescendants()) do
            if obj:IsA("BasePart") then
                obj.CanCollide = false
                obj.CanTouch = false
                obj.CanQuery = false
                obj.Massless = true
            end
        end
    end

    local function attachAccessoryDirect(m, character)
        if not m or not m:IsA("Accessory") then return end
        local handle = m:FindFirstChild("Handle")
        if not handle then return end

        for _, desc in ipairs(m:GetDescendants()) do
            if desc:IsA("JointInstance") or desc:IsA("Weld") or desc:IsA("WeldConstraint") or desc:IsA("Snap") or desc:IsA("Motor") or desc:IsA("Motor6D") then
                pcall(function() desc:Destroy() end)
            end
        end

        if m:FindFirstChild("ThumbnailConfiguration") then
            pcall(function() m.ThumbnailConfiguration:Destroy() end)
        end

        MakeAccessoryNonCollidable(m)
        m.Parent = character

        local welded = false
        for _, f in ipairs(handle:GetChildren()) do
            if f:IsA("Attachment") then
                for _, c in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
                    if c:IsA("Attachment") and c.Name == f.Name and c.Parent and c.Parent:IsA("BasePart") then
                        local w = Instance.new("Weld")
                        w.Name = "AccessoryWeld"
                        w.Part0 = handle
                        w.Part1 = c.Parent
                        w.C0 = f.CFrame
                        w.C1 = c.CFrame
                        w.Parent = handle
                        welded = true
                        break
                    end
                end
                if welded then break end
            end
        end

        if not welded then
            local head = character:FindFirstChild("Head") or character:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if head then
                local w = Instance.new("Weld")
                w.Name = "AccessoryWeld"
                w.Part0 = handle
                w.Part1 = head
                w.C0 = CFrame.new(0, 0, 0)
                w.C1 = CFrame.new(0, 0, 0)
                w.Parent = handle
            end
        end

        MakeAccessoryNonCollidable(m)
    end

    local function applyAvatarFromSource(srcChar)
        local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
        if not myChar or not srcChar then return end

        saveMyOriginalAvatar()

        if FeatureStates["AvatarDeleteAccessories"] then
            for _, obj in ipairs(myChar:GetChildren()) do
                if obj:IsA("Accessory") then
                    pcall(function() obj:Destroy() end)
                end
            end
        end

        for _, obj in ipairs(srcChar:GetChildren()) do
            if obj:IsA("Accessory") then
                pcall(function()
                    obj.Archivable = true
                    local clone = obj:Clone()
                    if clone then
                        attachAccessoryDirect(clone, myChar)
                    end
                end)
            end
        end

        local srcShirt = srcChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Shirt")
        local myShirt = myChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Shirt")
        if srcShirt then
            if not myShirt then
                myShirt = Instance.new("Shirt", myChar)
            end
            myShirt.ShirtTemplate = srcShirt.ShirtTemplate
        end

        local srcPants = srcChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Pants")
        local myPants = myChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Pants")
        if srcPants then
            if not myPants then
                myPants = Instance.new("Pants", myChar)
            end
            myPants.PantsTemplate = srcPants.PantsTemplate
        end

        local srcColors = srcChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("BodyColors")
        local myColors = myChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("BodyColors")
        if srcColors and myColors then
            myColors.HeadColor = srcColors.HeadColor
            myColors.TorsoColor = srcColors.TorsoColor
            myColors.LeftArmColor = srcColors.LeftArmColor
            myColors.RightArmColor = srcColors.RightArmColor
            myColors.LeftLegColor = srcColors.LeftLegColor
            myColors.RightLegColor = srcColors.RightLegColor
        end

        local srcHead = srcChar:FindFirstChild("Head")
        local myHead = myChar:FindFirstChild("Head")
        if srcHead and myHead then
            local srcFace = srcHead:FindFirstChild("face")
            local myFace = myHead:FindFirstChild("face")
            if srcFace then
                if not myFace then
                    myFace = Instance.new("Decal", myHead)
                    myFace.Name = "face"
                end
                myFace.Texture = srcFace.Texture
            end
        end
    end

    local function restoreMyOriginalSkin()
        local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
        if not myChar then return false end

        local appliedDesc = false
        pcall(function()
            local hum = myChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if hum and Players.GetHumanoidDescriptionFromUserId then
                local desc = Players:GetHumanoidDescriptionFromUserId(LocalPlayer.UserId)
                if desc then
                    hum:ApplyDescription(desc)
                    appliedDesc = true
                end
            end
        end)
        if appliedDesc then return true end

        if not originalAvatarData.saved then return false end

        for _, obj in ipairs(myChar:GetChildren()) do
            if obj:IsA("Accessory") then
                pcall(function() obj:Destroy() end)
            end
        end

        if originalAvatarData.accessories then
            for _, acc in ipairs(originalAvatarData.accessories) do
                pcall(function()
                    acc.Archivable = true
                    local clone = acc:Clone()
                    if clone then
                        attachAccessoryDirect(clone, myChar)
                    end
                end)
            end
        end

        local myShirt = myChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Shirt")
        if originalAvatarData.shirt then
            if not myShirt then myShirt = Instance.new("Shirt", myChar) end
            myShirt.ShirtTemplate = originalAvatarData.shirt
        elseif myShirt then
            myShirt.ShirtTemplate = ""
        end

        local myPants = myChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Pants")
        if originalAvatarData.pants then
            if not myPants then myPants = Instance.new("Pants", myChar) end
            myPants.PantsTemplate = originalAvatarData.pants
        elseif myPants then
            myPants.PantsTemplate = ""
        end

        local myColors = myChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("BodyColors")
        if myColors and originalAvatarData.colors then
            for k, v in pairs(originalAvatarData.colors) do
                myColors[k] = v
            end
        end

        local myHead = myChar:FindFirstChild("Head")
        local myFace = myHead and myHead:FindFirstChild("face")
        if myFace and originalAvatarData.face then
            myFace.Texture = originalAvatarData.face
        end

        return true
    end

    local function cloneOutfitByUserIdOrName(query)
        query = string.gsub(tostring(query or ""), "%s+", "")
        if #query == 0 then return false, "Please enter a Name or User ID" end
        local uid = tonumber(query)
        for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if string.lower(p.Name) == string.lower(query) or string.lower(p.DisplayName) == string.lower(query) or (uid and p.UserId == uid) then
                if p.Character then
                    applyAvatarFromSource(p.Character)
                    return true, "Cloned outfit from " .. p.DisplayName
                end
            end
        end
        local targetId = uid
        if not targetId and Players.GetUserIdFromNameAsync then
            local ok, res = pcall(function() return Players:GetUserIdFromNameAsync(query) end)
            if ok and res then targetId = res end
        end
        if targetId then
            local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
            local hum = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if hum and Players.GetHumanoidDescriptionFromUserId then
                local ok, desc = pcall(function() return Players:GetHumanoidDescriptionFromUserId(targetId) end)
                if ok and desc then
                    saveMyOriginalAvatar()
                    pcall(function() hum:ApplyDescription(desc) end)
                    return true, "Applied outfit from User ID " .. tostring(targetId)
                end
            end
        end
        return false, "Could not find player or fetch avatar"
    end

    createActionButton(cAvatar, "Clone Nearest Player", "Clonar Mas Cercano", UDim2.new(0.48, -4, 0, 26), UDim2.new(0, 6, 0, 102), function()
        pcall(function()
            local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
            local myHrp = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if not myHrp then return end

            local closestP = nil
            local closestDist = math.huge
            for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                if p ~= LocalPlayer and p.Character then
                    local hrp = p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                    if hrp then
                        local d = (hrp.Position - myHrp.Position).Magnitude
                        if d < closestDist then
                            closestDist = d
                            closestP = p
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            if not closestP then
                for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                    if p ~= LocalPlayer then closestP = p; break end
                end
            end

            if closestP and closestP.Character then
                applyAvatarFromSource(closestP.Character)
                notifyToggle("Cloned outfit: " .. closestP.DisplayName .. " (" .. math.floor(closestDist == math.huge and 0 or closestDist) .. " studs)", true)
            else
                notifyToggle("No other players found in server", false)
            end
        end)
    end)

                notifyToggle("Outfit restored to original", true)
