    local teamButtons = {}

    local function updateTeamVisuals()
        local curAccent = _G.CurrentAccentColor or Color3.fromRGB(65, 145, 255)
        for team, btn in pairs(teamButtons) do
            local isSel = (team == currentAutoTeam)
            btn.BackgroundColor3 = isSel and Color3.fromRGB(30, 42, 68) or Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 26)
            local st = btn:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
            if st then
                st.Color = isSel and curAccent or Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 58)
                st.Thickness = isSel and 1.5 or 1
            end
            local lbl = btn:FindFirstChildOfClass("TextLabel")
            if lbl then
                lbl.TextColor3 = isSel and Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255) or Color3.fromRGB(180, 180, 195)
            end
        end
        if statusLbl then
            local selDescEN, selDescES
            if currentAutoTeam == "Pirates" then
                selDescEN = "Pirates (Active)"
                selDescES = "Piratas (Activo)"
            elseif currentAutoTeam == "Marines" then
                selDescEN = "Marines (Active)"
                selDescES = "Marinos (Activo)"
            else
                selDescEN = "None (Disabled)"
                selDescES = "Ninguno (Desactivado)"
            end
            statusLbl.Text = (CurrentLang == "ES") and ("Auto-Unirse: " .. selDescES) or ("Auto-Join: " .. selDescEN)
        end
    end
    _G.SpookyUpdateTeamVisuals = updateTeamVisuals

    local function switchAndSaveTeam(teamName)
        currentAutoTeam = teamName
        pcall(function()
            if writefile then
                writefile("Spooky_AutoTeam.txt", teamName)
            end
        end)
        if teamName == "Marines" or teamName == "Pirates" then
            task.spawn(function()
                pcall(function()
                    local rem = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("Remotes")
                    local comm = rem and rem:FindFirstChild("CommF_")
                    if comm then
                        comm:InvokeServer("SetTeam", teamName)
                    end
                end)
            end)
            local msg = (CurrentLang == "ES") and ("Auto-Unirse configurado: " .. (teamName == "Marines" and "Marinos" or "Piratas")) or ("Auto-Join set: " .. teamName)
            notifyToggle(msg, true)
        else
            local msg = (CurrentLang == "ES") and "Auto-Unirse desactivado" or "Auto-Join disabled"
            notifyToggle(msg, false)
        end
        updateTeamVisuals()
    end

    end

    local bountyV4Conn = nil
    FeatureCallbacks["AutoV4Bounty"] = function(v)
        getgenv().AutoV4Bounty = v
        if v then
            if bountyV4Conn then task.cancel(bountyV4Conn) end
            bountyV4Conn = task.spawn(function()
                while FeatureStates["AutoV4Bounty"] do
                    task.wait(0.5)
                    pcall(function()
                        local char = LocalPlayer.Character
                        if char then
                            local energy = char:FindFirstChild("RaceEnergy")
                            local transformed = char:FindFirstChild("RaceTransformed")
                            local stun = char:FindFirstChild("Stun")
                            local busy = char:FindFirstChild("Busy")

                            local hasEnergy = energy and tonumber(energy.Value) and tonumber(energy.Value) >= 1
                            local notTransformed = not transformed or (transformed.Value ~= true)
                            local notStunned = not stun or (tonumber(stun.Value) or 0) <= 0
                            local notBusy = not busy or (busy.Value ~= true)

                            if hasEnergy and notTransformed and notStunned and notBusy then
                                pcall(function()
                                    local remotes = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("Remotes")
                                    local commE = remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("CommE")
                                    if commE then commE:FireServer("ActivateAwakening", true) end
                                end)
                                pcall(function()
                                    local vim = game:GetService("VirtualInputManager")
                                    if vim then
                                        vim:SendKeyEvent(true, Enum.KeyCode.Y, false, game)
                                        task.wait(0.05)
                                        vim:SendKeyEvent(false, Enum.KeyCode.Y, false, game)
                                    end
                                end)
                                pcall(function()
                                    local bp = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack") or LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("Backpack")
                                    local awk = bp and bp:FindFirstChild("Awakening")
                                    if awk then
                                        local rf = awk:FindFirstChild("RemoteFunction")
                                        if rf and rf:IsA("RemoteFunction") then pcall(function() rf:InvokeServer(true) end) end
                                        local re = awk:FindFirstChild("RemoteEvent")
                                        if re and re:IsA("RemoteEvent") then pcall(function() re:FireServer(true) end) end
                                    end
                                end)
                                task.wait(2.0)
                            end
                        end
                    end)
                end
            end)
        else
            if bountyV4Conn then task.cancel(bountyV4Conn); bountyV4Conn = nil end
        end
    end
    setFeatureState("AutoV4Bounty", true)
end

    local function loadFunctionsConfig(quiet)
        local loaded = false
        pcall(function()
            if isfile and isfile("ProjectSpooky_FunctionsConfig.json") and readfile and HttpService then
                local raw = readfile("ProjectSpooky_FunctionsConfig.json")
                if raw and #raw > 2 then
                    local data = HttpService:JSONDecode(raw)
                    if data and type(data) == "table" and data.functions and type(data.functions) == "table" then
                        Spooky.CustomFunctions = data.functions
                        loaded = true
                        if not quiet then
                            notifyToggle("Function Config: Cargado", true)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end)
        if rebuildFunctionButtonsList then rebuildFunctionButtonsList() end
        return loaded
    end

    local function answerAnyQuestionLocally(query)
        local q = string.lower(query or "")
        local ans = ""
        local code = ""

        local n1, op, n2 = string.match(q, "(%d+%.?%d*)%s*([%+%-%*%/%^])%s*(%d+%.?%d*)")
        if n1 and op and n2 then
            local num1 = tonumber(n1)
            local num2 = tonumber(n2)
            if num1 and num2 then
                local res = 0
                if op == "+" then res = num1 + num2
                elseif op == "-" then res = num1 - num2
                elseif op == "*" then res = num1 * num2
                elseif op == "/" then res = (num2 ~= 0) and (num1 / num2) or 0
                elseif op == "^" then res = num1 ^ num2
                end
                ans = (CurrentLang == "ES") and string.format("Calculo: %s %s %s = %s", n1, op, n2, tostring(res)) or string.format("Calculation: %s %s %s = %s", n1, op, n2, tostring(res))
                return ans, code
            end
        end

        local sqrtNum = string.match(q, "raiz%s+cuadrada%s+de%s+(%d+%.?%d*)") or string.match(q, "sqrt%s*%(?(%d+%.?%d*)%)?") or string.match(q, "square%s+root%s+of%s+(%d+%.?%d*)")
        if sqrtNum and tonumber(sqrtNum) then
            local val = math.sqrt(tonumber(sqrtNum))
            ans = (CurrentLang == "ES") and string.format("La raiz cuadrada de %s es %s", sqrtNum, tostring(val)) or string.format("The square root of %s is %s", sqrtNum, tostring(val))
            return ans, code
        end

        local pct, total = string.match(q, "(%d+%.?%d*)%%%s+de%s+(%d+%.?%d*)") or string.match(q, "(%d+%.?%d*)%%%s+of%s+(%d+%.?%d*)")
        if pct and total and tonumber(pct) and tonumber(total) then
            local val = (tonumber(pct) / 100) * tonumber(total)
            ans = (CurrentLang == "ES") and string.format("El %s%% de %s es %s", pct, total, tostring(val)) or string.format("%s%% of %s is %s", pct, total, tostring(val))
            return ans, code
        end

        if string.find(q, "fly") or string.find(q, "volar") or string.find(q, "vuelo") then
            code = [===[local lp = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer

        if uis:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then dir = dir + cam.CFrame.RightVector end
        if uis:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then dir = dir - cam.CFrame.RightVector end

    end
end)]===]

        end

        if string.find(q, "hola") or string.find(q, "hello") or string.find(q, "hi") or string.find(q, "hey") or string.find(q, "buenas") then
            ans = (CurrentLang == "ES") and "Hola! Soy Spooky AI, tu copiloto inteligente en Spooky Hub. ¿En que puedo ayudarte hoy? Puedo programar scripts en Luau, darte los mejores combos de Blox Fruits, guias de razas o resolver cualquier consulta general." or "Hello! I am Spooky AI, your intelligent assistant inside Spooky Hub. How can I help you today? I can write Luau scripts, give you the best Blox Fruits combos and guides, or answer any question."
            return ans, code
        end

        if string.find(q, "quien eres") or string.find(q, "who are you") or string.find(q, "marin") then
            ans = (CurrentLang == "ES") and "Soy Spooky AI, la inteligencia artificial oficial integrada en Spooky Hub. Diseñada con la esencia y estetica de Gothic Spooky intelligence, estoy optimizada para ayudarte en programacion Luau para Roblox, combate y bounty hunting en Blox Fruits y cualquier duda que tengas!" or "I am Spooky AI, the official artificial intelligence built into Spooky Hub. Inspired by Gothic Spooky intelligence, I am optimized to assist you with Roblox Luau scripting, Blox Fruits PvP & mechanics, and general inquiries!"
            return ans, code
        end

        ans = (CurrentLang == "ES") and ("Entendido! Sobre tu consulta ('" .. query .. "'): Spooky AI esta procesando la informacion mas actualizada para brindarte la mejor solucion y soporte en Blox Fruits y scripting en Luau.") or ("Understood! Regarding your query ('" .. query .. "'): Spooky AI is synthesizing the best assistance for you in Blox Fruits, Luau scripting, and general knowledge.")
        return ans, code
    end

    local function displayAIOutput(query, rawResponse, codeChunk)
        lastGeneratedFullText = rawResponse or ""
        lastGeneratedCode = codeChunk or ""
        if not codeChunk or #codeChunk == 0 then
            local extracted = string.match(rawResponse, "```lua%s*(.-)%s*```") or string.match(rawResponse, "```%s*(.-)%s*```")
            if extracted and #extracted > 0 then
                lastGeneratedCode = extracted
            end
        end
        if speechStatusLbl then
            speechStatusLbl.Text = (CurrentLang == "ES") and "Estado: Listo" or "Status: Ready"
        end
        if terminalLogBox then
            terminalLogBox.Text = string.format(">> [USER]: %s\n\n>> [SPOOKY AI]:\n%s\n\n========================================", query, rawResponse)
        end
    end

    local function sendAIQuery(query)
        if not query or #string.gsub(query, "%s+", "") == 0 then
            notifyToggle((CurrentLang == "ES") and "Por favor escribe una pregunta" or "Please enter a question", false)
            return
        end
        if speechStatusLbl then
            speechStatusLbl.Text = (CurrentLang == "ES") and "Estado: Pensando..." or "Status: Thinking..."
        end
        if terminalLogBox then
            terminalLogBox.Text = (CurrentLang == "ES") and ">> [Spooky AI]: Procesando consulta..." or ">> [Spooky AI]: Processing query..."
        end
        task.spawn(function()
            local reqFunc = (syn and syn.request) or (http and http.request) or http_request or request
            local onlineResponse = nil

            if reqFunc then
                pcall(function()
                    local apiKey = "AQ.Ab8RN6K0sq8RwAh0lMUhL3GZSzDxAJ6xGQASk5jFr-Z51h1lrw"
                    local geminiUrl = "https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/gemini-2.5-flash:generateContent?key=" .. apiKey
                    local payload = HttpService:JSONEncode({
                        contents = {
                            {
                                role = "user",
                                parts = { { text = query } }
                            }
                        },
                        systemInstruction = {
                            parts = {
                                { text = "You are Spooky AI, the official hyper-intelligent AI assistant in Spooky Hub, inspired by Marin Kitagawa. You are an expert Roblox Luau developer and Blox Fruits master. Answer smartly, clearly, warmly, and directly in the user language. If the user asks for a script, provide clean, complete, working Roblox Luau code wrapped in ```lua ... ``` blocks without any comments." }
                            }
                        }
                    })
                    local res = reqFunc({
                        Url = geminiUrl,
                        Method = "POST",
                        Headers = {
                            ["Content-Type"] = "application/json"
                        },
                        Body = payload
                    })
                    if res and res.Body then
                        local data = HttpService:JSONDecode(res.Body)
                        if data and data.candidates and data.candidates[1] and data.candidates[1].content and data.candidates[1].content.parts and data.candidates[1].content.parts[1] and data.candidates[1].content.parts[1].text then
                            onlineResponse = data.candidates[1].content.parts[1].text
                        end
                    end
                end)

                if not onlineResponse or #onlineResponse == 0 then
                    pcall(function()
                        local apiKey = "AQ.Ab8RN6K0sq8RwAh0lMUhL3GZSzDxAJ6xGQASk5jFr-Z51h1lrw"
                        local geminiUrl2 = "https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/gemini-flash-latest:generateContent?key=" .. apiKey
                        local payload2 = HttpService:JSONEncode({
                            contents = {
                                {
                                    role = "user",
                                    parts = { { text = query } }
                                }
                            }
                        })
                        local res2 = reqFunc({
                            Url = geminiUrl2,
                            Method = "POST",
                            Headers = {
                                ["Content-Type"] = "application/json"
                            },
                            Body = payload2
                        })
                        if res2 and res2.Body then
                            local data2 = HttpService:JSONDecode(res2.Body)
                            if data2 and data2.candidates and data2.candidates[1] and data2.candidates[1].content and data2.candidates[1].content.parts and data2.candidates[1].content.parts[1] and data2.candidates[1].content.parts[1].text then
                                onlineResponse = data2.candidates[1].content.parts[1].text
                            end
                        end
                    end)
                end
            end

            if onlineResponse and #onlineResponse > 0 then
                displayAIOutput(query, onlineResponse, nil)
                notifyToggle("AI Response Received", true)
                return
            end

            local localAns, localCode = answerAnyQuestionLocally(query)
            displayAIOutput(query, localAns, localCode)
            notifyToggle("AI Response Ready", true)
        end)
    end

    local function doSendPrompt()
        local rawText = promptInput.Text
        if not rawText or #string.gsub(rawText, "%s+", "") == 0 then
            notifyToggle((CurrentLang == "ES") and "Por favor escribe una pregunta" or "Please enter a question", false)
            return
        end
        promptInput.Text = ""
        sendAIQuery(rawText)
    end

    table.insert(TranslatableUI, { btn = sendBtn, en = "Send", es = "Enviar" })

    promptInput.FocusLost:Connect(function(enterPressed)
        if enterPressed then
            doSendPrompt()
        end
    end)

    end)
    table.insert(TranslatableUI, { btn = clearBtn, en = "Clear", es = "Limpiar" })
end

        "health", "energy", "stamina", "level", "beli", "fragment", "stat",

        "characteravatar", "profile", "avatar", "crew", "leaderboard"

    local function isAllowedHUDButton(btn)
        if not btn or not btn:IsA("GuiObject") then return false end
        local n = string.lower(btn.Name)
        for _, ign in ipairs(ignoredHUDNames) do
            if string.find(n, ign) then return false end
        end
        return true
    end

    local function getBloxFruitsControlButtons()
        local btns = {}
        local seen = {}
        local pGui = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
        if not pGui then return btns end

        local function addBtn(b, customName)
            if not b or not b:IsA("GuiObject") then return end
            local key = customName or b.Name
            if seen[key] or seen[b] then return end
            seen[key] = true
            seen[b] = true
            table.insert(btns, b)
        end

        local main = pGui:FindFirstChild("Main")
        if main then
            local skills = main:FindFirstChild("Skills")
            if skills then
                addBtn(skills, "PC_SkillsBar")
                for _, sChild in ipairs(skills:GetChildren()) do
                    if sChild:IsA("GuiObject") and (sChild.Name == "Z" or sChild.Name == "X" or sChild.Name == "C" or sChild.Name == "V" or sChild.Name == "F") then
                        addBtn(sChild, "Skill_" .. sChild.Name)
                    end
                end
            end
            local hotbar = main:FindFirstChild("Hotbar")
            if hotbar then addBtn(hotbar, "PC_Hotbar") end
            local hp = main:FindFirstChild("Health")
            if hp then addBtn(hp, "PC_Health") end
            local ep = main:FindFirstChild("Energy")
            if ep then addBtn(ep, "PC_Energy") end
            local compass = main:FindFirstChild("Compass")
            if compass then addBtn(compass, "PC_Compass") end
            local bounty = main:FindFirstChild("Bounty")
            if bounty then addBtn(bounty, "PC_Bounty") end
        end

        local backpackGui = pGui:FindFirstChild("Backpack")
        if backpackGui then
            local hb = backpackGui:FindFirstChild("Hotbar") or backpackGui:FindFirstChild("Container")
            if hb and hb:IsA("GuiObject") then addBtn(hb, "Backpack_Hotbar") end
        end

        local touchGui = pGui:FindFirstChild("TouchGui")
        if touchGui then
            local tcFrame = touchGui:FindFirstChild("TouchControlFrame")
            if tcFrame then
                local jBtn = tcFrame:FindFirstChild("JumpButton")
                if jBtn and isAllowedHUDButton(jBtn) then addBtn(jBtn, "Jump") end
            end
        end

        local cag = pGui:FindFirstChild("ContextActionGui")
        if cag then
            local cbf = cag:FindFirstChild("ContextButtonFrame")
            if cbf then
                for _, ch in ipairs(cbf:GetChildren()) do
                    if ch:IsA("GuiObject") and isAllowedHUDButton(ch) then
                        addBtn(ch)
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        local mcb = pGui:FindFirstChild("MobileContextButtons")
        if mcb then
            local cbf = mcb:FindFirstChild("ContextButtonFrame") or mcb
            for _, ch in ipairs(cbf:GetChildren()) do
                if ch:IsA("GuiObject") and isAllowedHUDButton(ch) then
                    addBtn(ch)
                end
            end
        end

        if main then
            for _, ch in ipairs(main:GetChildren()) do
                local nm = string.lower(ch.Name)
                if (nm:find("dash") or nm:find("jump") or nm:find("skill") or nm:find("mobilebutton") or nm:find("combatbutton")) and ch:IsA("GuiObject") then
                    if isAllowedHUDButton(ch) then addBtn(ch) end
                end
            end
        end

        return btns
    end    local function cleanupHudOverlays()
    _G.cleanupHudOverlays = cleanupHudOverlays

    end

    local function saveControlsLayoutToFile()
        pcall(function()
            if writefile then
                local json = HttpService:JSONEncode(_G.Spooky_ControlsLayout)
                writefile("Spooky_ControlsLayout.json", json)
            end
        end)
    end

    local function loadControlsLayoutFromFile()
        pcall(function()
            local json = nil
            if isfile and isfile("Spooky_ControlsLayout.json") and readfile then
                json = readfile("Spooky_ControlsLayout.json")
            end
            if json and json ~= "" then
                local ok, data = pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONDecode(json) end)
                if ok and type(data) == "table" then
                    _G.Spooky_ControlsLayout = data
                    for _, btn in ipairs(getBloxFruitsControlButtons()) do
                        local saved = _G.Spooky_ControlsLayout[btn.Name]
                        if saved then
                            if saved.scaleX and saved.scaleY then
                                btn.Position = UDim2.new(saved.scaleX, saved.offsetX or 0, saved.scaleY, saved.offsetY or 0)
                            end
                            if saved.scale then
                                local s = btn:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale") or Instance.new("UIScale", btn)
                                s.Scale = saved.scale
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end)
    end

        for name, pos in pairs(originalControlsLayout) do
            for _, b in ipairs(getBloxFruitsControlButtons()) do
                if b.Name == name then b.Position = pos end
            end
        end
        notifyToggle((CurrentLang == "ES") and "Edición HUD cancelada (Sin guardar)" or "HUD Edit Cancelled (Changes Discarded)", false)
    end

                if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                    dragging = true
                    local mPos = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
                    dragStart = Vector3.new(mPos.X, mPos.Y, 0)
                    startBtnPos = btn.Position

                end

            local c2 = UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
                if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then

                    dragging = false
                    _G.Spooky_ControlsLayout[btn.Name] = _G.Spooky_ControlsLayout[btn.Name] or {}
                    _G.Spooky_ControlsLayout[btn.Name].scaleX = btn.Position.X.Scale
                    _G.Spooky_ControlsLayout[btn.Name].offsetX = btn.Position.X.Offset
                    _G.Spooky_ControlsLayout[btn.Name].scaleY = btn.Position.Y.Scale
                    _G.Spooky_ControlsLayout[btn.Name].offsetY = btn.Position.Y.Offset
                end
            end)
            table.insert(activeDragConns, c1)
            table.insert(activeDragConns, c2)

    local function crewIdentity(value)
        if value == nil or value == false then return nil end
        local text=tostring(value):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$"):lower()
        if text=="" or text=="0" or text=="none" or text=="nil" or text=="n/a" or text=="no crew" or text=="sin crew" then return nil end
        return text
    end
    local function isBloxFruitsAlly(player)
        if not player or player == LocalPlayer then return false end
        local ok, isAlly = pcall(function()

            local pg = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
            local main = pg and pg:FindFirstChild("Main")
            local allies = main and main:FindFirstChild("Allies")
            local container = allies and allies:FindFirstChild("Container")
            local frame = container and container:FindFirstChild("Allies") and container.Allies:FindFirstChild("ScrollingFrame") and container.Allies.ScrollingFrame:FindFirstChild("Frame")
            if frame and frame:FindFirstChild(player.Name) then return true end
            local list=container and container:FindFirstChild("Allies")
            local scroll=list and list:FindFirstChild("ScrollingFrame")
            if scroll and scroll:FindFirstChild(player.Name,true) then return true end

            local myCrew = LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("Crew") or (LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:GetAttribute("Crew"))
            local targetCrew = player:GetAttribute("Crew") or (player.Character and player.Character:GetAttribute("Crew"))
            if crewIdentity(myCrew) and crewIdentity(myCrew) == crewIdentity(targetCrew) then return true end

            local myHead = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("Head")
            local targetHead = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("Head")
            local myCrewGui = myHead and (myHead:FindFirstChild("CrewGui") or myHead:FindFirstChild("Header"))
            local targetCrewGui = targetHead and (targetHead:FindFirstChild("CrewGui") or targetHead:FindFirstChild("Header"))
            if myCrewGui and targetCrewGui then
                local myCrewName = myCrewGui:FindFirstChild("CrewName", true)
                local targetCrewName = targetCrewGui:FindFirstChild("CrewName", true)
                if myCrewName and targetCrewName and crewIdentity(myCrewName.Text) and crewIdentity(myCrewName.Text) == crewIdentity(targetCrewName.Text) then
                    return true
                end
            end
            return false
        end)
        return ok and isAlly == true
    end

    local function isEnemy(player)
        if not player or player == LocalPlayer then return false end
        if isBloxFruitsAlly(player) then return false end
        local myTeam, targetTeam = LocalPlayer.Team, player.Team
        if myTeam and targetTeam and myTeam.Name == "Marines" and targetTeam.Name == "Marines" then
            return false
        end
        return true
    end

    local function AX_ReadPvPState(target)
        if not target then return false end
        local ok, pvpOn = pcall(function()
            local isPlr = typeof(target) == "Instance" and target:IsA("Player")
            local plr = isPlr and target or Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(target)
            local char = (isPlr and target.Character) or target
            if plr and plr:GetAttribute("PvpDisabled") == true then
                return false
            end
            if char and char:GetAttribute("PvpDisabled") == true then
                return false
            end
            return true
        end)
        return ok and pvpOn == true
    end

    local function AX_InSafeZone(target)
        if not target then return false end
        local ok, inZone = pcall(function()
            local isPlr = typeof(target) == "Instance" and target:IsA("Player")
            local plr = isPlr and target or Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(target)
            local char = (isPlr and target.Character) or target
            if not char then return false end

            for _,name in ipairs({"SafeZoneShield","SafeZone"}) do
                local flag=char:FindFirstChild(name)
                if flag and (not flag:IsA("BoolValue") or flag.Value==true) then return true end
            end
            if char:FindFirstChildOfClass("ForceField") then return true end
            if char:GetAttribute("SafeZone") == true or char:GetAttribute("InSafeZone") == true then return true end
            if plr and (plr:GetAttribute("SafeZone") == true or plr:GetAttribute("InSafeZone") == true) then return true end

            local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if not hrp then return false end

            local function checkFolder(folder)
                if not folder then return false end
                for _, zone in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
                    if zone:IsA("BasePart") then
                        local localPos = zone.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(hrp.Position)
                        local halfSize = zone.Size / 2
                        if math.abs(localPos.X) <= halfSize.X and math.abs(localPos.Y) <= halfSize.Y + 25 and math.abs(localPos.Z) <= halfSize.Z then
                            return true
                        end
                    end
                end
                return false
            end

            local wo = workspace:FindFirstChild("_WorldOrigin")
            if wo and checkFolder(wo:FindFirstChild("SafeZones")) then return true end
            if checkFolder(workspace:FindFirstChild("SafeZones")) then return true end
            local map = workspace:FindFirstChild("Map")
            if map and checkFolder(map:FindFirstChild("SafeZones")) then return true end

            return false
        end)
        return ok and inZone == true
    end

    _G.isPlayerBlacklisted = function(p)
        if not p then return false end
        local bl = _G.PlayerBlacklist or (Spooky and Spooky.Blacklist)
        if not bl then return false end
        if bl[p] == true then return true end
        if p.UserId and (bl[p.UserId] == true or bl[tostring(p.UserId)] == true or bl[tonumber(p.UserId)] == true) then return true end
        if p.Name and (bl[p.Name] == true or bl[string.lower(p.Name)] == true) then return true end
        if p.DisplayName and (bl[p.DisplayName] == true or bl[string.lower(p.DisplayName)] == true) then return true end
        return false
    end

    local PlayerLevelCache = {}
    _G.getPlayerLevel = function(p)
        if not p then return 0 end
        local uId = p.UserId or p.Name
        local cached = PlayerLevelCache[uId]
        local now = tick()
        if cached and (now - cached.time < 12) and cached.lvl > 0 then
            return cached.lvl
        end

        local lvl = 0
        local d = p:FindFirstChild("Data")
        if d and d:FindFirstChild("Level") then
            lvl = tonumber(d.Level.Value) or 0
        end
        if lvl <= 0 then
            local pd = p:FindFirstChild("PlayerData")
            if pd and pd:FindFirstChild("Level") then
                lvl = tonumber(pd.Level.Value) or 0
            end
        end
        if lvl <= 0 then
            local ls = p:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
            if ls then
                local lStat = ls:FindFirstChild("Level") or ls:FindFirstChild("Lvl")
                if lStat then lvl = tonumber(lStat.Value) or 0 end
            end
        end
        if lvl <= 0 then
            local c = p.Character
            if c then
                local aLvl = c:GetAttribute("Level") or p:GetAttribute("Level")
                if aLvl and tonumber(aLvl) and tonumber(aLvl) > 0 then
                    lvl = tonumber(aLvl)
                else
                    local head = c:FindFirstChild("Head")
                    if head then
                        for _, b in ipairs(head:GetChildren()) do
                            if b:IsA("BillboardGui") then
                                for _, desc in ipairs(b:GetDescendants()) do
                                    if desc:IsA("TextLabel") and desc.Text then
                                        local num = string.match(desc.Text, "Lv%.?%s*(%d+)") or string.match(desc.Text, "Level%s*(%d+)")
                                        if num and tonumber(num) and tonumber(num) > 0 then
                                            lvl = tonumber(num)
                                            break
                                        end
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                            if lvl > 0 then break end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        if lvl > 0 then
            PlayerLevelCache[uId] = { lvl = lvl, time = now }
        end
        return lvl
    end

    local function isTargetPlayerCombatValid(p, maxDist)
        if not p or p == LocalPlayer or not p.Character then return false, "invalid target" end
        if _G.isPlayerBlacklisted(p) then return false, "player blacklist" end
        if FeatureStates["IgnoreLowLevel"] == true or Settings.ignoreLowLevel == true then
            local minLvl = tonumber(Settings.ignoreLowLevelThreshold) or 2000
            local lvl = _G.getPlayerLevel(p)
            if lvl > 0 and lvl < minLvl then return false, "below minimum level" end
        end
        local pChar = p.Character
        if not pChar:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then return false, "character unavailable" end
        local hum = pChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local hrp = pChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or pChar.PrimaryPart
        if not hum or hum.Health <= 0 or not hrp or hrp.Position.Y <= -500 then return false, "dead / unavailable root" end

        if (FeatureStates["SafeZoneCheck"] == true or Settings.safeZoneCheck == true) then
            if AX_InSafeZone(p) or not AX_ReadPvPState(p) then return false, "safe zone / PvP disabled" end
        end

        local needTeamCheck = (FeatureStates["TeamCheck"] == true or Settings.teamCheck == true)
        if needTeamCheck and not isEnemy(p) then return false, "team / ally" end

        local char = LocalPlayer.Character
        local myHrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not myHrp then return false, "local character unavailable" end

        local dist = (hrp.Position - myHrp.Position).Magnitude
        if dist > (maxDist or 800) then return false, "out of range" end
        return true, dist, pChar
    end
    _G.SpookyIsEnemy = isEnemy
    _G.SpookyInSafeZone = AX_InSafeZone
    _G.SpookyPvPAllowed = AX_ReadPvPState

    _G.StickyCombat = _G.StickyCombat or { player = nil, playerObj = nil, any = nil, npc = nil }

    function Spooky.AimCenter()
        local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
        if not cam then return Vector2.zero end
        if Settings.aimFovOrigin == "Mouse" and not UserInputService.TouchEnabled then
            local p = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
            if p.X > 0 and p.Y > 0 then return p end
        end
        return cam.ViewportSize / 2
    end
    function Spooky.AimScore(part, distance)
        local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
        local mode = Settings.aimMode or "360"
        if mode == "360" then return distance end
        if not cam or not part then return nil end
        local delta = part.Position - cam.CFrame.Position
        if mode == "180" then
            if delta:Dot(cam.CFrame.LookVector) < 0 then return nil end
            return distance
        end
        local point, visible = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
        if not visible or point.Z <= 0 then return nil end
        local radius = math.clamp(tonumber(Settings.aimFovRadius) or 150, 20, 800)
        local pixels = (Vector2.new(point.X, point.Y) - Spooky.AimCenter()).Magnitude
        return pixels <= radius and pixels or nil
    end
    function Spooky.SelectAimPlayer(maxDist, exclude)
        local best, bestScore, bestModel = nil, math.huge, nil
        local reasons = {}
        for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if p ~= LocalPlayer and p ~= exclude then
                local ok, valid, distance, model = pcall(isTargetPlayerCombatValid, p, maxDist or 1200)
                if not ok then Spooky.ReportIssue("Target filter", valid); valid = false; distance = "filter error" end
                if Settings.aimTargetPolicy == "Selected" and tostring(p.UserId) ~= tostring(Settings.aimTargetUserId) then
                    valid = false; distance = "not selected"
                end
                if valid then
                    local part = model:FindFirstChild(Settings.camLockTargetPart or "HumanoidRootPart") or model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                    local score = Spooky.AimScore(part, distance)
                    if score and score < bestScore then best, bestScore, bestModel = p, score, model end
                    if not score then distance = "outside aim area"; valid = false end
                end
                if not valid then reasons[distance or "unknown"] = (reasons[distance or "unknown"] or 0) + 1 end
            end
        end
        if best then Spooky.Diagnostics.statuses.Target = best.Name
        else
            local rows = {}
            for reason, count in pairs(reasons) do table.insert(rows, reason .. "=" .. count) end
            table.sort(rows)
            Spooky.Diagnostics.statuses.Target = "No target: " .. table.concat(rows, ", ")
        end
        return best, bestModel
    end
    local function getClosestPlayer(maxDist)
        local player, model = Spooky.SelectAimPlayer(maxDist)
        _G.StickyCombat.playerObj, _G.StickyCombat.player = player, model
        return model
    end

    local function getClosestNPC(maxDist)
        local char = LocalPlayer.Character
        local myHrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not myHrp then return nil end
        local maxD = maxDist or 800

        local closest, closestDist = nil, maxD
        local myPos = myHrp.Position
        local function scanFolder(f)
            if not f then return end
            for _, npc in ipairs(f:GetChildren()) do
                if npc:IsDescendantOf(workspace) and not Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(npc) then
                    local name = string.lower(npc.Name)
                    local isIgnored = name:find("quest") or name:find("dealer") or name:find("shop") or name:find("citizen") or name:find("trainer") or name:find("agent") or name:find("scientist") or name:find("manager") or name:find("set home") or name:find("pirate starter")
                    if not isIgnored then
                        local hum = npc:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                        local hrp = npc:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or npc.PrimaryPart or npc:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or npc:FindFirstChild("Torso") or npc:FindFirstChild("Head")
                        if hum and hum.Health > 0 and hrp and hrp.Position.Y > -500 then
                            local dist = (hrp.Position - myPos).Magnitude
                            if dist < closestDist then
                                closest = npc
                                closestDist = dist
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        scanFolder(workspace:FindFirstChild("Enemies"))
        scanFolder(workspace:FindFirstChild("Characters"))

        if _G.StickyCombat then
            _G.StickyCombat.npc = closest
        end
        return closest
    end

    local function updateEquippedTool(char)
        if not char then return end
        currentHeldTool = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
        currentHeldCategory = getToolCategory(currentHeldTool)
    end
    local function setupCharToolTracking(char)
        if not char then return end
        updateEquippedTool(char)
        char.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
            if child:IsA("Tool") then
                currentHeldTool = child
                currentHeldCategory = getToolCategory(child)
                currentSkillKey = nil
            end
        end)
        char.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(child)

                    updateEquippedTool(LocalPlayer.Character)
                end)
            end
        end)
    end

    local function isOverrideTool(tool)
        if not tool then return false end
        local name = string.lower(tool.Name)
        if name == "godhuman" or string.find(name, "sanguine") then return true end
        if currentHeldCategory == "Sword" then return true end
        if string.find(name, "yama") then return true end
        return false
    end
    local function isKeyCurrentlyBlacklisted(key)
        if FeatureStates["BlacklistAimbot"] == false then return false end
        local char = LocalPlayer.Character
        if char and (not currentHeldTool or not currentHeldTool.Parent or currentHeldTool.Parent ~= char) then
            currentHeldTool = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
            currentHeldCategory = getToolCategory(currentHeldTool)
        end
        local cat = currentHeldCategory or "Melee"
        local prefix="BL_" .. cat
        if FeatureStates[prefix] ~= nil then BlacklistedKeys[cat].all=FeatureStates[prefix] end
        for _,k in ipairs({"Z","X","C","V","F","M1","TAP"}) do
            local id=prefix .. ((cat=="Gun" and k=="M1") and "TAP" or (cat=="Fruit" and k=="TAP") and "M1" or k)
            if FeatureStates[id]~=nil then BlacklistedKeys[cat][k]=FeatureStates[id] end
        end
        if BlacklistedKeys[cat] then
            if BlacklistedKeys[cat].all then return true end
            local checkKey = key or currentSkillKey
            if checkKey then
                if BlacklistedKeys[cat][checkKey] == true then return true end
                if (checkKey == "TAP" or checkKey == "M1") and (BlacklistedKeys[cat].M1 or BlacklistedKeys[cat].TAP) then return true end
            end
        end
        return false
    end
    _G.SpookySkillBlocked = isKeyCurrentlyBlacklisted
    local function faceTarget(targetPos)
        if not targetPos then return end
        if FeatureStates["BlacklistAimbot"] ~= false then
            if isKeyCurrentlyBlacklisted(currentSkillKey) then return end
        end
        local char = LocalPlayer.Character
        local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if hrp and typeof(targetPos) == "Vector3" then
            local currentPos = hrp.Position
            local lookVector = Vector3.new(targetPos.X - currentPos.X, 0, targetPos.Z - currentPos.Z)
            if lookVector.Magnitude > 0.1 then
                pcall(function()
                    hrp.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(currentPos, currentPos + lookVector.Unit, Vector3.new(0, 1, 0))
                end)
            end
        end
    end
    CombatCache.heldSkillKeys = CombatCache.heldSkillKeys or {}
    local function setCurrentSkillKey(key)
        if currentSkillKey == key and os.clock() - lastSkillTime < 0.2 then return end
        currentSkillKey = key
        lastSkillTime = os.clock()
        if (FeatureStates["AimbotPlayer1"] or FeatureStates["AimbotNpc1"]) then
            local targetPos = aimbot1TargetPos
            if targetPos and not isKeyCurrentlyBlacklisted(key) then
                task.spawn(function() faceTarget(targetPos) end)
            end
        end
        task.spawn(function()
            local myTime = lastSkillTime
            task.wait(1.5)
            if lastSkillTime == myTime and currentSkillKey == key and not (CombatCache.heldSkillKeys and CombatCache.heldSkillKeys[key]) then
                currentSkillKey = nil
            end
        end)
    end
    _G.SpookySetSkillKey=setCurrentSkillKey

    local function hookMobileButton(btn)
        if not btn or btn:GetAttribute("SpookySkillSession") == SCRIPT_SESSION then return end
        btn:SetAttribute("SpookySkillSession", SCRIPT_SESSION)
        local k = btn.Name
        if table.find(SKILL_KEYS, k) then
            registerConnection(btn.Activated:Connect(function()
                if isCurrentSession() then setCurrentSkillKey(k) end
            end))
        end
    end

        while isCurrentSession() do
            pcall(function()
                local pg = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
                local main = pg and pg:FindFirstChild("Main")
                local skills = main and main:FindFirstChild("Skills")
                if skills then
                    for _, wf in ipairs(skills:GetChildren()) do
                        if wf:IsA("Frame") or wf:IsA("GuiObject") then
                            for _, btn in ipairs(wf:GetChildren()) do
                                if btn:IsA("GuiButton") then
                                    hookMobileButton(btn)
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end)
            task.wait(1.5)
        end
    end)
    registerConnection(UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gp)
        if gp then return end
        local map = { [Enum.KeyCode.Z] = "Z", [Enum.KeyCode.X] = "X", [Enum.KeyCode.C] = "C", [Enum.KeyCode.V] = "V", [Enum.KeyCode.F] = "F" }
        local k = map[input.KeyCode]
        if k then
            if CombatCache.heldSkillKeys then CombatCache.heldSkillKeys[k] = true end
            setCurrentSkillKey(k)
        elseif input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            setCurrentSkillKey("TAP")
        end
    end))
    registerConnection(UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input, gp)
        local map = { [Enum.KeyCode.Z] = "Z", [Enum.KeyCode.X] = "X", [Enum.KeyCode.C] = "C", [Enum.KeyCode.V] = "V", [Enum.KeyCode.F] = "F" }
        local k = map[input.KeyCode]
        if k then
            if CombatCache.heldSkillKeys then CombatCache.heldSkillKeys[k] = nil end
            task.delay(0.25, function()
                local anyHeld = false
                if CombatCache.heldSkillKeys then
                    for _, held in pairs(CombatCache.heldSkillKeys) do
                        if held then anyHeld = true break end
                    end
                end
                if not anyHeld and currentSkillKey == k then
                    currentSkillKey = nil
                end
            end)
        end
    end))

    local tracerGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")

    local tracerFrames = {}
    local tracerCandidates, nextTracerScan = {}, 0
    local colors = {
        Red=Color3.fromRGB(255,70,85), Orange=Color3.fromRGB(255,150,70),
        Purple=Color3.fromRGB(175,115,255), Cyan=Color3.fromRGB(65,220,245),

    function Spooky.GetMyTracerOrigin(camera)
        local char = LocalPlayer.Character
        if not char or not camera then return nil end
        local torso = char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or char:FindFirstChild("Torso") or char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if torso then
            local chestWorld = torso.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0.6, 0)
            local pOrigin, onScreen = camera:WorldToViewportPoint(chestWorld)
            if onScreen and pOrigin.Z > 0 then
                return Vector2.new(pOrigin.X, pOrigin.Y)
            end
        end
        local vp = camera.ViewportSize
        return Vector2.new(vp.X * 0.5, vp.Y * 0.5)
    end
    function Spooky.ProjectTracer(camera, position)
        if not camera or not position then return nil end
        local p, visible = camera:WorldToViewportPoint(position)
        local vp = camera.ViewportSize
        if not visible or p.Z <= 0 or vp.X < 1 or vp.Y < 1 then return nil end
        if p.X ~= p.X or p.Y ~= p.Y or p.X < 0 or p.X > vp.X or p.Y < 0 or p.Y > vp.Y then return nil end
        local from = Spooky.GetMyTracerOrigin(camera) or Vector2.new(vp.X * 0.5, vp.Y * 0.5)
        local to = Vector2.new(p.X, p.Y)
        local delta = to - from
        if delta.Magnitude < 1 then return nil end
        return (from + to) / 2, delta.Magnitude, math.deg(math.atan2(delta.Y, delta.X))
    end
    local function hideTracers()
        for _, line in pairs(tracerFrames) do line.Visible = false end
    end
    Spooky.HideTracers = hideTracers
    local function drawTracer(model, camera, color)
        local root = model and (model:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or model:FindFirstChild("Torso") or model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"))
        local hum = model and model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not root or not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then return end
        local targetPos = root.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0.4, 0)
        local midpoint, length, angle = Spooky.ProjectTracer(camera, targetPos)
        if not midpoint then return end
        local line = tracerFrames[model]
        if not line then
            line = Instance.new("Frame", tracerGui)
            line.Name = "TargetLine"
            line.AnchorPoint, line.BorderSizePixel = Vector2.new(0.5,0.5), 0
            line.Active, line.BackgroundTransparency = false, 0.1
            tracerFrames[model] = line
        end
        line.Position, line.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(midpoint.X,midpoint.Y), UDim2.fromOffset(length,1.5)
        line.Rotation, line.BackgroundColor3, line.Visible = angle, color, true
    end
    registerConnection(RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        if not isCurrentSession() then return end
        hideTracers()
        for model, line in pairs(tracerFrames) do
            local p = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model)
            if not model.Parent or (p and p.Character ~= model) then line:Destroy(); tracerFrames[model] = nil end
        end
        local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
        local char = LocalPlayer.Character
        if not cam or not char or not char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then return end
        local aimOn = FeatureStates["Tracers1"] or FeatureStates["Tracers2"] or FeatureStates["Tracers3"]
        local allOn = FeatureStates["TracersAll"] or _G.G_ESP_Tracers == true
        if not aimOn and not allOn then return end
        local aim = aimOn and Spooky.TracerAimModel or nil
        local color = colors[Settings.tracerColorName] or colors.Red
        if aim then
            local p = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(aim)
            if not p or isTargetPlayerCombatValid(p,1200) then drawTracer(aim,cam,color) end
        end
        if allOn then
            if os.clock() >= nextTracerScan then
                nextTracerScan = os.clock() + 0.15
                table.clear(tracerCandidates)
                for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                    if isTargetPlayerCombatValid(p,1200) then table.insert(tracerCandidates,p) end
                end
            end
            for _, p in ipairs(tracerCandidates) do
                if p.Character ~= aim and isTargetPlayerCombatValid(p,1200) then
                    drawTracer(p.Character,cam,_G.G_ESP_Color or color)
                end
            end
        end
    end))
    for _, id in ipairs({"Tracers1","Tracers2","Tracers3","TracersAll"}) do
        FeatureCallbacks[id] = function() hideTracers(); nextTracerScan = 0 end
    end
    local fovCircle = Instance.new("Frame",tracerGui)

        fovStroke.Color = _G.CurrentAccentColor or colors.Purple
    end))
    Spooky.CleanupCombatVisuals = function()
        Spooky.TracerAimModel = nil
        tracerGui:Destroy()
        table.clear(tracerFrames)
    end

    local function getSkillKeyFromArgs(args)
        for _, arg in ipairs(args) do
            if type(arg) == "string" and table.find(SKILL_KEYS, arg) then
                return arg
            end
        end
        return nil
    end
    local function hookMobileSkillButtons()
        pcall(function()
            local pg = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
            local main = pg and pg:FindFirstChild("Main")

            if skills then

                    if btn:IsA("GuiButton") and btn:GetAttribute("SpookySkillSession") ~= SCRIPT_SESSION then
                        btn:SetAttribute("SpookySkillSession", SCRIPT_SESSION)
                        local key = btn.Name
                        if table.find(SKILL_KEYS, key) then
                            btn.Activated:Connect(function()
                                setCurrentSkillKey(key)
                            end)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end)
    end
