    FeatureCallbacks["BigSkinBug"] = function(v)
        bigSkinBugEnabled = v
        if v then
            if LocalPlayer.Character then
                saveBigSkinOriginal(LocalPlayer.Character)
                applyBigSkin(LocalPlayer.Character)
            end
            if bigSkinBugConnections.CharAdded then bigSkinBugConnections.CharAdded:Disconnect() end
            bigSkinBugConnections.CharAdded = LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(onCharAddedBigSkin)
        else
            if bigSkinBugConnections.CharAdded then
                bigSkinBugConnections.CharAdded:Disconnect()
                bigSkinBugConnections.CharAdded = nil
            end
            if LocalPlayer.Character then
                restoreBigSkin(LocalPlayer.Character)
            end
        end
    end
    local fflag1OriginalShadows = Lighting.GlobalShadows
    local fflag1OriginalFog = Lighting.FogEnd
    local SPOOKY_FFLAGS = {
        { "DFIntTaskSchedulerTargetFps", "240" },
        { "FFlagDisablePostFx", "True" },
        { "FIntFRMMaxGrassDistance", "0" },
        { "FIntFRMMinGrassDistance", "0" },
        { "DebugFRMQualityLevelOverride", "1" },
        { "TextureQualityOverride", "0" },
    }

    local function applyFastFlagsList(flagList, onProgress, shouldContinue)
        local setter = setfflag or set_fflag
        if type(flagList) ~= "table" then return 0, 0 end
        if type(setter) ~= "function" then return 0, #flagList end
        local accepted, failed = 0, 0
        for i, pair in ipairs(flagList) do
            if shouldContinue and not shouldContinue() then break end
            local ok, result = pcall(setter, pair[1], tostring(pair[2]))
            if ok and result ~= false then accepted += 1 else failed += 1 end
            if onProgress then pcall(onProgress, i, #flagList) end
            if i % 4 == 0 then task.wait() end
        end
        return accepted, failed
    end
    _G.SpookyApplyFastFlagsList = applyFastFlagsList
    _G.SpookyFFlags = SPOOKY_FFLAGS
    _G.SpookyFullFlags = SPOOKY_FFLAGS

    local flagPreset = {generation=0, originals={}}
    FeatureCallbacks["FFlag1"] = function(enabled)
        flagPreset.generation += 1
        local generation = flagPreset.generation
        if enabled then
            if flagPreset.active then return end
            flagPreset.active = true
            fflag1OriginalShadows, fflag1OriginalFog = Lighting.GlobalShadows, Lighting.FogEnd
            pcall(function() flagPreset.quality = settings().Rendering.QualityLevel end)
            if type(getfpscap) == "function" then
                local ok, fps = pcall(getfpscap)
                if ok then flagPreset.fps = fps end
            end
            local getter = getfflag or get_fflag
            flagPreset.unrestorable = type(getter) ~= "function"
            flagPreset.originals = {}
            for _, pair in ipairs(SPOOKY_FFLAGS) do
                if type(getter) == "function" then
                    local ok, value = pcall(getter, pair[1])
                    if ok and value ~= nil then flagPreset.originals[pair[1]] = value
                    else flagPreset.unrestorable = true end
                end
            end
            Lighting.GlobalShadows, Lighting.FogEnd = false, 9e9
            pcall(function() settings().Rendering.QualityLevel = Enum.QualityLevel.Level01 end)
            if type(setfpscap) == "function" then pcall(setfpscap, 240) end
            task.spawn(function()
                local accepted, failed = applyFastFlagsList(SPOOKY_FFLAGS, nil, function()
                    return isCurrentSession() and flagPreset.active and flagPreset.generation == generation
                end)
                if flagPreset.generation == generation and flagPreset.active then
                    notifyToggle("FFlags accepted: " .. accepted .. " | Failed: " .. failed, accepted > 0)
                end
            end)
        elseif flagPreset.active then
            flagPreset.active = false
            Lighting.GlobalShadows, Lighting.FogEnd = fflag1OriginalShadows, fflag1OriginalFog
            pcall(function() if flagPreset.quality ~= nil then settings().Rendering.QualityLevel = flagPreset.quality end end)
            if flagPreset.fps ~= nil and type(setfpscap) == "function" then pcall(setfpscap, flagPreset.fps) end
            local setter = setfflag or set_fflag
            if type(setter) == "function" then
                for name, value in pairs(flagPreset.originals) do
                    local ok, result = pcall(setter, name, tostring(value))
                    if not ok or result == false then flagPreset.unrestorable = true end
                end
            end
            notifyToggle(flagPreset.unrestorable and "Visuals restored; restart Roblox to reset unreadable FFlags" or "FPS preset restored", false)
        end
    end

    local noGfxActive = false
    local noGfxQuality = nil
    local noGfxConnections = {}
    local noGfxModifiedObjects = {}
    local originalTerrainProps = nil
    local originalLightingProps = nil

    local function restoreNoGfx()
        noGfxActive = false
        if noGfxQuality ~= nil then
            pcall(function() settings().Rendering.QualityLevel = noGfxQuality end)
            noGfxQuality = nil
        end
        for obj, data in pairs(noGfxModifiedObjects) do
            pcall(function()
                if not obj or not obj.Parent then return end
                if data.Enabled ~= nil then obj.Enabled = data.Enabled end
                if data.Texture ~= nil then obj.Texture = data.Texture end
                if data.Rate ~= nil then obj.Rate = data.Rate end
                if data.Material ~= nil then obj.Material = data.Material end
                if data.Transparency ~= nil then obj.Transparency = data.Transparency end
            end)
        end
        noGfxModifiedObjects = {}

        if originalTerrainProps then
            pcall(function()
                local t = workspace.Terrain
                t.WaterWaveSize = originalTerrainProps.WaterWaveSize
                t.WaterWaveSpeed = originalTerrainProps.WaterWaveSpeed
                t.WaterReflectance = originalTerrainProps.WaterReflectance
                t.WaterTransparency = originalTerrainProps.WaterTransparency
                t.Decoration = originalTerrainProps.Decoration
            end)
            originalTerrainProps = nil
        end

        if originalLightingProps then
            pcall(function()
                Lighting.GlobalShadows = originalLightingProps.GlobalShadows
                Lighting.FogEnd = originalLightingProps.FogEnd
            end)
            originalLightingProps = nil
        end

        for k, conn in pairs(noGfxConnections) do
            pcall(function() conn:Disconnect() end)
        end
        noGfxConnections = {}
    end

    local function processNoGfxObject(inst)
        if not noGfxActive or not isCurrentSession() or not inst then return end
        local cName = inst.ClassName
        if cName == "ParticleEmitter" then
            if not noGfxModifiedObjects[inst] then
                noGfxModifiedObjects[inst] = { Enabled = inst.Enabled, Rate = inst.Rate }
            end
            inst.Enabled = false
            inst.Rate = 0
        elseif cName == "Beam" or cName == "Trail" or cName == "Fire" or cName == "Smoke" or cName == "Sparkles" then
            if not noGfxModifiedObjects[inst] then
                noGfxModifiedObjects[inst] = { Enabled = inst.Enabled }
            end
            inst.Enabled = false
        elseif cName == "PointLight" or cName == "SpotLight" or cName == "SurfaceLight" then
            if not noGfxModifiedObjects[inst] then
                noGfxModifiedObjects[inst] = { Enabled = inst.Enabled }
            end
            inst.Enabled = false
        elseif cName == "Highlight" and inst.Name ~= "CentuDox_TargetHighlight" and not string.find(inst.Name, "ESP") and not string.find(inst.Name, "Spooky") then
            if not noGfxModifiedObjects[inst] then
                noGfxModifiedObjects[inst] = { Enabled = inst.Enabled }
            end
            inst.Enabled = false
        elseif (cName == "Decal" or cName == "Texture") and inst.Parent and not inst.Parent:IsDescendantOf(LocalPlayer.Character) then
            if not noGfxModifiedObjects[inst] then
                noGfxModifiedObjects[inst] = { Texture = inst.Texture }
            end
            inst.Texture = ""
        elseif cName == "WrapLayer" then
            if not noGfxModifiedObjects[inst] then noGfxModifiedObjects[inst] = {Enabled=inst.Enabled} end
            inst.Enabled = false
        end

    end

    local function processWorldOriginChild(child)
        if not child then return end
        pcall(function()
            for _, desc in ipairs(child:GetDescendants()) do
                processNoGfxObject(desc)
            end
            table.insert(noGfxConnections, child.DescendantAdded:Connect(processNoGfxObject))
        end)
    end

    local function stripV4Auras(char)
        if not noGfxActive or not isCurrentSession() or not char then return end
        for _, item in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
            pcall(processNoGfxObject, item)
            local name = string.lower(item.Name)
            if item:IsA("BasePart") and (name == "aura" or name == "raceaura" or name == "auravisuals" or name == "terroraura") then
                if not noGfxModifiedObjects[item] then noGfxModifiedObjects[item] = {Transparency=item.Transparency} end
                item.Transparency = 1
            end
        end
    end

    local function startNoGfxV2()
        restoreNoGfx()
        noGfxActive = true

        pcall(function()
            local t = workspace.Terrain
            originalTerrainProps = {
                WaterWaveSize = t.WaterWaveSize,
                WaterWaveSpeed = t.WaterWaveSpeed,
                WaterReflectance = t.WaterReflectance,
                WaterTransparency = t.WaterTransparency,
                Decoration = t.Decoration
            }
            t.WaterWaveSize = 0
            t.WaterWaveSpeed = 0
            t.WaterReflectance = 0
            t.WaterTransparency = 0
            t.Decoration = false
        end)

        pcall(function()
            originalLightingProps = {
                GlobalShadows = Lighting.GlobalShadows,
                FogEnd = Lighting.FogEnd
            }
            Lighting.GlobalShadows = false
            Lighting.FogEnd = 9e9
            for _, v in ipairs(Lighting:GetChildren()) do
                if v:IsA("PostProcessEffect") or v:IsA("Atmosphere") or v:IsA("Clouds") or v:IsA("BloomEffect") or v:IsA("SunRaysEffect") or v:IsA("DepthOfFieldEffect") then
                    pcall(function()
                        if not noGfxModifiedObjects[v] then noGfxModifiedObjects[v] = {Enabled=v.Enabled} end
                        v.Enabled = false
                    end)
                end
            end
        end)

        pcall(function()
            noGfxQuality = settings().Rendering.QualityLevel
            settings().Rendering.QualityLevel = Enum.QualityLevel.Level01
        end)

        pcall(function()
            local wo = workspace:FindFirstChild("_WorldOrigin")
            if wo then
                for _, ch in ipairs(wo:GetChildren()) do
                    processWorldOriginChild(ch)
                end
                noGfxConnections.WorldOriginChildAdded = wo.ChildAdded:Connect(processWorldOriginChild)
            end
        end)

        pcall(function()
            for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                if plr.Character then stripV4Auras(plr.Character) end
                table.insert(noGfxConnections, plr.CharacterAdded:Connect(stripV4Auras))
            end
            noGfxConnections.PlayerCharAdded = Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(plr)
                table.insert(noGfxConnections, plr.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(ch)
                    task.wait(0.5)
                    stripV4Auras(ch)
                end))
            end)
        end)

    end

    FeatureCallbacks["FFlag2"] = function(v)
        if v then startNoGfxV2() else restoreNoGfx() end
        notifyToggle("Ultra Potato: " .. (v and "ENABLED" or "DISABLED"), v)
    end
end
do
    local MATCHA_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(155, 225, 80)
    local FRUIT_COLOR  = Color3.fromRGB(210, 45, 45)
    local GOLD_COLOR   = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 40)
    local bespokeESPStore = {}
    local matchaESPStore  = {}
    local npcESPStore     = {}
    local fruitESPStore   = {}
    local activeESPTags   = {}
    local playerCache     = {}
    local function getMyRoot()
        local c = LocalPlayer.Character
        return c and (c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or c:FindFirstChild("Head") or c.PrimaryPart)
    end
    local function removeDrawingObj(obj)
        if not obj then return end
        pcall(function() obj.Visible = false end)
        pcall(function()
            if obj.Remove then
                obj:Remove()
            elseif obj.Destroy then
                obj:Destroy()
            end
        end)
    end
    local function createDrawingLine()
        if not Drawing or not Drawing.new then return nil end
        local ok, line = pcall(function()
            local l = Drawing.new("Line")
            l.Visible = false
            l.Color = MATCHA_COLOR
            l.Thickness = 3.5
            l.Transparency = 1
            return l
        end)
        return ok and line or nil
    end
    local function createDrawingSquare()
        if not Drawing or not Drawing.new then return nil end
        local ok, sq = pcall(function()
            local s = Drawing.new("Square")
            s.Visible = false
            s.Color = MATCHA_COLOR
            s.Thickness = 2.8
            s.Filled = false
            s.Transparency = 1
            return s
        end)
        return ok and sq or nil
    end
    local function getTeamInfo(targetP)
        if not targetP or not targetP.Team then
            return "Neutral", Color3.fromRGB(220, 220, 220)
        end
        if targetP.Team.Name == "Marines" then
            return "Marines", Color3.fromRGB(0, 170, 255)
        else
            return "Pirates", Color3.fromRGB(255, 70, 70)
        end
    end
    local function getPlayerData(targetP)
        if not playerCache[targetP] then
            playerCache[targetP] = {
                level = "?",
                fruit = "None",
                bounty = 0,
                team = "Neutral",
                color = Color3.fromRGB(220, 220, 220),
                lastUpdate = 0
            }
        end
        local data = playerCache[targetP]
        local now = os.clock()
        if now - data.lastUpdate > 3 or data.level == "?" or data.fruit == "None" then
            pcall(function()
                local tName, tCol = getTeamInfo(targetP)
                data.team = tName
                data.color = tCol
                local d = targetP:FindFirstChild("Data")
                if d then
                    local lvl = d:FindFirstChild("Level")
                    if lvl and lvl.Value then data.level = tostring(lvl.Value) end
                    local fr = d:FindFirstChild("DevilFruit")
                    if fr and fr.Value then data.fruit = tostring(fr.Value) end
                end
                local ls = targetP:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
                if ls then
                    local b = ls:FindFirstChild("Bounty/Honor") or ls:FindFirstChild("Bounty") or ls:FindFirstChild("Honor")
                    if b and b.Value then data.bounty = b.Value end
                    if data.level == "?" then
                        local l = ls:FindFirstChild("Level") or ls:FindFirstChild("Lvl")
                        if l and l.Value then data.level = tostring(l.Value) end
                    end
                end
                data.lastUpdate = now
            end)
        end
        return data
    end
    local function cleanPlayerBespokeESP(p)
        if p and bespokeESPStore[p] then
            local data = bespokeESPStore[p]
            if data.bb then pcall(function() data.bb:Destroy() end) end
            if data.hl then pcall(function() data.hl:Destroy() end) end
            bespokeESPStore[p] = nil
        end
    end
    local function cleanMatchaESP(p)
        if p and matchaESPStore[p] then
            local data = matchaESPStore[p]
            if data.square then removeDrawingObj(data.square) end
            if data.lines then
                for _, l in ipairs(data.lines) do
                    removeDrawingObj(l)
                end
            end
            if data.sBox then pcall(function() data.sBox:Destroy() end) end
            if data.hl then pcall(function() data.hl:Destroy() end) end
            matchaESPStore[p] = nil
        end
    end
    local function cleanNPCESP(npc)
        if npc and npcESPStore[npc] then
            local data = npcESPStore[npc]
            if data.bb then
                activeESPTags[data.bb] = nil
                pcall(function() data.bb:Destroy() end)
            end
            if data.hl then
                activeESPTags[data.hl] = nil
                pcall(function() data.hl:Destroy() end)
            end
            npcESPStore[npc] = nil
        end
    end
    local function cleanFruitESP(fruit)
        if fruit and fruitESPStore[fruit] then
            local data = fruitESPStore[fruit]
            if data.bb then
                activeESPTags[data.bb] = nil
                pcall(function() data.bb:Destroy() end)
            end
            if data.hl then
                activeESPTags[data.hl] = nil
                pcall(function() data.hl:Destroy() end)
            end
            fruitESPStore[fruit] = nil
        end
    end
    local function cleanAllESPs()
    _G.cleanAllESPs = cleanAllESPs
        _G.Spooky_CleanAllESPs = cleanAllESPs
        for p, _ in pairs(bespokeESPStore) do cleanPlayerBespokeESP(p) end
        bespokeESPStore = {}
        for p, _ in pairs(matchaESPStore) do cleanMatchaESP(p) end
        matchaESPStore = {}
        for npc, _ in pairs(npcESPStore) do cleanNPCESP(npc) end
        npcESPStore = {}
        for fr, _ in pairs(fruitESPStore) do cleanFruitESP(fr) end
        fruitESPStore = {}
        pcall(function()
            for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                if p.Character then
                    local o1 = p.Character:FindFirstChild("SacredESP_Billboard", true)
                    if o1 then o1:Destroy() end
                    local o2 = p.Character:FindFirstChild("SacredESP_Highlight", true)
                    if o2 then o2:Destroy() end
                    local o3 = p.Character:FindFirstChild("PlayerESP", true)
                    if o3 then o3:Destroy() end
                    local o4 = p.Character:FindFirstChild("PlayerESP_Highlight", true)
                    if o4 then o4:Destroy() end
                    local o5 = p.Character:FindFirstChild("Matcha_3DBox", true)
                    if o5 then o5:Destroy() end
                    local o6 = p.Character:FindFirstChild("Matcha_3DSelectionBox", true)
                    if o6 then o6:Destroy() end
                end
            end
            for tag, _ in pairs(activeESPTags) do
                pcall(function()
                    if tag and tag.Parent then
                        tag:Destroy()
                    end
                end)
                activeESPTags[tag] = nil
            end
        end)
    end
    local function applyAvatarThumb(bb, player)
        if not bb or not player then return end
        local thumb = bb:FindFirstChild("AvatarThumb")
        local isSimple = (_G.G_ESP_SimpleMode == true or (FeatureStates and FeatureStates["SimpleEsp"] == true))
        if isSimple then
            if thumb then thumb.Visible = false end
            return
        end
        if _G.G_ESP_AvatarPhoto ~= false then
            if not thumb then
                thumb = Instance.new("ImageLabel", bb)
                thumb.Name = "AvatarThumb"
                thumb.Size = UDim2.new(0, 32, 0, 32)
                thumb.Position = UDim2.new(0, -36, 0, 2)
                thumb.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 25)
                thumb.BackgroundTransparency = 0.2
                Instance.new("UICorner", thumb).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
                local tStk = Instance.new("UIStroke", thumb)
                tStk.Color = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 255)
                tStk.Thickness = 1.2
                task.spawn(function()
                    pcall(function()
                        local content = Players:GetUserThumbnailAsync(player.UserId, Enum.ThumbnailType.HeadShot, Enum.ThumbnailSize.Size48x48)
                        if content and thumb and thumb.Parent then
                            thumb.Image = content
                        end
                    end)
                end)
            end
            thumb.Visible = true
        elseif thumb then
            thumb.Visible = false
        end
    end

    local function buildESPText(player, hum, hrp, pData, myPos)
        local isSimple = (_G.G_ESP_SimpleMode == true or (FeatureStates and FeatureStates["SimpleEsp"] == true))
        if isSimple then
            local maxH = math.max(hum.MaxHealth, 1)
            local curH = math.clamp(hum.Health, 0, maxH)
            local hpPct = math.floor((curH / maxH) * 100)
            local nameStr = player.DisplayName or player.Name
            local hpStr = "HP: " .. tostring(math.floor(curH)) .. "/" .. tostring(math.floor(maxH)) .. " (" .. tostring(hpPct) .. "%)"
            return "[" .. nameStr .. "]\n" .. hpStr
        end
        local dist = math.floor((myPos - hrp.Position).Magnitude)
        local hpPct = math.floor((hum.Health / math.max(hum.MaxHealth, 1)) * 100)
        local bM = type(pData.bounty) == "number" and math.floor(pData.bounty / 1000000) or 0
        local isPvpDisabled = (player:GetAttribute("PvpDisabled") == true)
        local parts = {}
        if _G.G_ESP_Name ~= false then
            local warnTag = (type(pData.bounty) == "number" and pData.bounty > 10000000) and "[!] " or ""
            parts[#parts+1] = warnTag .. "[" .. pData.team .. "] <font color=\"rgb(255,255,0)\">" .. (player.DisplayName or player.Name) .. "</font>"
        end
        if _G.G_ESP_Level ~= false then
            parts[#parts+1] = " [Lv." .. tostring(pData.level) .. "]"
        end
        if _G.G_ESP_PvP ~= false or _G.G_ESP_Bounty ~= false then
            parts[#parts+1] = "\n"
            if _G.G_ESP_PvP ~= false then
                if isPvpDisabled then
                    parts[#parts+1] = "<font color=\"rgb(0,255,0)\">[SAFE] PvP Off</font>"
                else
                    parts[#parts+1] = "[PVP] PvP On"
                end
            end
            if _G.G_ESP_Bounty ~= false then
                if _G.G_ESP_PvP ~= false then parts[#parts+1] = " | " end
                parts[#parts+1] = "Bounty: " .. tostring(bM) .. "M"
            end
        end
        if _G.G_ESP_Fruit ~= false then
            parts[#parts+1] = "\nFruit: " .. tostring(pData.fruit)
        end
        local hpStr = ""
        local fmt = _G.G_ESP_HP_Format or "Numbers"
        if _G.G_ESP_HP ~= false then
            if fmt == "Numbers" then
                hpStr = "HP: " .. math.floor(hum.Health) .. " / " .. math.floor(hum.MaxHealth)
            elseif fmt == "Percentage" then
                hpStr = "HP: " .. tostring(hpPct) .. "%"
            else
                hpStr = "HP: " .. math.floor(hum.Health) .. "/" .. math.floor(hum.MaxHealth) .. " (" .. tostring(hpPct) .. "%)"
            end
        end
        local distStr = ""
        if _G.G_ESP_Distance ~= false then
            if _G.G_ESP_DistanceUnit == "Studs" then
                distStr = tostring(dist) .. " studs"
            else
                distStr = tostring(dist) .. "m"
            end
        end
        if distStr ~= "" or hpStr ~= "" then
            parts[#parts+1] = "\n" .. distStr .. ((distStr ~= "" and hpStr ~= "") and " | " or "") .. hpStr
        end
        return table.concat(parts)
    end

    local function setupGeneralESP(player)
        if player == LocalPlayer or not FeatureStates["GeneralEsp"] then return end
        local char = player.Character
        if not char then return end
        local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or char:FindFirstChild("Head") or char.PrimaryPart
        local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not hrp or not hum then return end
        if bespokeESPStore[player] and bespokeESPStore[player].style == "General" and bespokeESPStore[player].bb and bespokeESPStore[player].bb.Parent then
            return
        end
        cleanPlayerBespokeESP(player)
        local pData = getPlayerData(player)
        local teamCol = _G.G_ESP_Color or pData.color
        local bb = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
        bb.Name = "SacredESP_Billboard"
        bb.Adornee = hrp
        local isSimple = (_G.G_ESP_SimpleMode or (FeatureStates and FeatureStates["SimpleEsp"])) == true
        bb.Size = isSimple and UDim2.new(0, 140, 0, 32) or UDim2.new(0, 220, 0, 75)
        local offX = _G.G_ESP_TagOffsetX or 0
        local offY = _G.G_ESP_TagOffsetY or 0
        bb.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(offX, 3.2 + offY, 0)
        bb.AlwaysOnTop = true
        bb.MaxDistance = 100000
        bb.Parent = hrp
        local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel", bb)
        lbl.Name = "TextLabel"
        lbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
        lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        lbl.Font = _G.G_ESP_Font or Enum.Font.GothamBold
        lbl.TextSize = _G.G_ESP_TextSize or 11.5
        lbl.RichText = true
        lbl.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
        lbl.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
        lbl.TextColor3 = teamCol
        lbl.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
        local myRoot = getMyRoot()
        local myPos = myRoot and myRoot.Position or Vector3.zero
        lbl.Text = buildESPText(player, hum, hrp, pData, myPos)
        applyAvatarThumb(bb, player)
        local hl = nil
        if _G.G_ESP_Chams ~= false then
            pcall(function()
                hl = Instance.new("Highlight")
                hl.Name = "SacredESP_Highlight"
                hl.Adornee = char
                hl.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
                hl.FillColor = teamCol
                hl.FillTransparency = 0.5
                hl.OutlineColor = teamCol
                hl.OutlineTransparency = 0
                local dist = math.floor((myPos - hrp.Position).Magnitude)
                hl.Enabled = (dist <= 150)
                hl.Parent = char
            end)
        end
        bespokeESPStore[player] = {
            bb = bb,
            lbl = lbl,
            hl = hl,
            player = player,
            char = char,
            style = "General"
        }
    end
    local function setupPlayerESP(player)
        if player == LocalPlayer or not (FeatureStates["PlayerEsp"] or FeatureStates["RainbowEsp"] or FeatureStates["SimpleEsp"] or _G.G_ESP_SimpleMode) then return end
        local char = player.Character
        if not char then return end
        local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or char:FindFirstChild("Head") or char.PrimaryPart
        local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not hrp or not hum then return end
        if bespokeESPStore[player] and bespokeESPStore[player].style == "Player" and bespokeESPStore[player].bb and bespokeESPStore[player].bb.Parent then
            return
        end
        cleanPlayerBespokeESP(player)
        local pData = getPlayerData(player)
        local teamCol = (player.Team == LocalPlayer.Team) and Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0) or (_G.G_ESP_Color or pData.color)
        local bb = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
        bb.Name = "PlayerESP"
        bb.Adornee = hrp
        local isSimple = (_G.G_ESP_SimpleMode == true or (FeatureStates and FeatureStates["SimpleEsp"] == true))
        bb.Size = isSimple and UDim2.new(0, 140, 0, 32) or UDim2.new(0, 180, 0, 36)
        local offX = _G.G_ESP_TagOffsetX or 0
        local offY = _G.G_ESP_TagOffsetY or 0
        bb.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(offX, 2.8 + offY, 0)
        bb.AlwaysOnTop = true
        bb.MaxDistance = 100000
        bb.Parent = hrp
        local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel", bb)
        lbl.Name = "TextLabel"
        lbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
        lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        lbl.Font = _G.G_ESP_Font or Enum.Font.GothamBold

        lbl.RichText = true
        lbl.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
        lbl.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
        lbl.TextColor3 = teamCol
        local myRoot = getMyRoot()
        local myPos = myRoot and myRoot.Position or Vector3.zero
        lbl.Text = buildESPText(player, hum, hrp, pData, myPos)
        applyAvatarThumb(bb, player)
        local hl = nil
        if _G.G_ESP_Chams ~= false then
            pcall(function()
                hl = Instance.new("Highlight")
                hl.Name = "PlayerESP_Highlight"
                hl.Adornee = char
                hl.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
                hl.FillColor = teamCol
                hl.FillTransparency = 0.65
                hl.OutlineColor = teamCol
                hl.OutlineTransparency = 0.2
                local dist = math.floor((myPos - hrp.Position).Magnitude)
                hl.Enabled = (dist <= 150)
                hl.Parent = char
            end)
        end
        bespokeESPStore[player] = {
            bb = bb,
            lbl = lbl,
            hl = hl,
            player = player,
            char = char,
            style = "Player"
        }
    end
    local function setupNpcESP(npcModel)
        if not FeatureStates["NpcEsp"] then return end
        if not npcModel or not npcModel.Parent then return end
        local hrp = npcModel:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or npcModel:FindFirstChild("Head") or npcModel.PrimaryPart
        local hum = npcModel:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not hrp or not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then return end
        if npcESPStore[npcModel] and npcESPStore[npcModel].bb and npcESPStore[npcModel].bb.Parent then
            return
        end
        cleanNPCESP(npcModel)
        local bb = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
        bb.Name = "NPCESP_Tag"
        bb.Adornee = hrp
        bb.Size = UDim2.new(0, 160, 0, 28)
        bb.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
        bb.AlwaysOnTop = true
        bb.MaxDistance = 100000
        bb.Parent = hrp
        activeESPTags[bb] = true
        local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel", bb)
        lbl.Name = "TextLabel"
        lbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
        lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        lbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        lbl.TextSize = 11.5
        lbl.TextColor3 = GOLD_COLOR
        lbl.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.2
        lbl.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
        local myRoot = getMyRoot()
        local myPos = myRoot and myRoot.Position or Vector3.zero
        local dist = math.floor((myPos - hrp.Position).Magnitude)
        local hpPct = math.floor((hum.Health / math.max(hum.MaxHealth, 1)) * 100)
        lbl.Text = string.format("NPC: %s [%dm] %d%%", npcModel.Name, dist, hpPct)
        local hl = nil
        pcall(function()
            hl = Instance.new("Highlight")
            hl.Name = "NPCESP_Highlight"
            hl.Adornee = npcModel
            hl.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
            hl.FillColor = GOLD_COLOR
            hl.FillTransparency = 0.75
            hl.OutlineColor = GOLD_COLOR
            hl.OutlineTransparency = 0.2
            hl.Enabled = (dist <= 150)
            hl.Parent = npcModel
            activeESPTags[hl] = true
        end)
        npcESPStore[npcModel] = {
            bb = bb,
            lbl = lbl,
            hl = hl,
            char = npcModel
        }
    end
    local function scanAndSetupAllNPCs()
        if not FeatureStates["NpcEsp"] then return end
        pcall(function()
            local enemies = workspace:FindFirstChild("Enemies")
            if enemies then
                for _, npc in ipairs(enemies:GetChildren()) do
                    if npc:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or npc:FindFirstChild("Head") or npc.PrimaryPart then
                        setupNpcESP(npc)
                    end
                end
            end
            local npcs = workspace:FindFirstChild("NPCs")
            if npcs then
                for _, npc in ipairs(npcs:GetChildren()) do
                    if npc:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or npc:FindFirstChild("Head") or npc.PrimaryPart then
                        setupNpcESP(npc)
                    end
                end
            end
            local chars = workspace:FindFirstChild("Characters")
            if chars then
                for _, npc in ipairs(chars:GetChildren()) do
                    if npc ~= LocalPlayer.Character and not Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(npc) then
                        setupNpcESP(npc)
                    end
                end
            end
            for _, obj in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
                if obj:IsA("Model") and obj ~= LocalPlayer.Character and not Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(obj) then
                    local hum = obj:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                    if hum and hum.Health > 0 and (obj:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or obj:FindFirstChild("Head") or obj.PrimaryPart) then
                        setupNpcESP(obj)
                    end
                end
            end
        end)
    end
    local function updateFruitESP()
        if not FeatureStates["FruitEsp"] then
            for fr, _ in pairs(fruitESPStore) do cleanFruitESP(fr) end
            fruitESPStore = {}
            return
        end
        local myPos = getMyRoot() and getMyRoot().Position or Vector3.zero
        for _, obj in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
            pcall(function()
                if (obj:IsA("Tool") or obj:IsA("Model")) and string.find(obj.Name, "Fruit") and (not LocalPlayer.Character or obj.Parent ~= LocalPlayer.Character) then
                    local basePart = obj:FindFirstChild("Handle") or obj.PrimaryPart or obj:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
                    if basePart and not fruitESPStore[obj] then
                        local old = obj:FindFirstChild("FruitESP", true)
                        if old then
                            activeESPTags[old] = nil
                            old:Destroy()
                        end
                        local bb = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
                        bb.Name = "FruitESP"
                        bb.Adornee = basePart
                        bb.Size = UDim2.new(0, 220, 0, 32)
                        bb.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0)
                        bb.AlwaysOnTop = true
                        bb.MaxDistance = 100000
                        bb.Parent = basePart
                        activeESPTags[bb] = true
                        local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel", bb)
                        lbl.Name = "Label"
                        lbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
                        lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                        lbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
                        lbl.TextSize = 12
                        lbl.TextColor3 = FRUIT_COLOR
                        lbl.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.2
                        lbl.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
                        local dist = math.floor((myPos - basePart.Position).Magnitude)
                        lbl.Text = string.format("Fruit | %s | < %d >", obj.Name, dist)
                        local hl = nil
                        pcall(function()
                            hl = Instance.new("Highlight")
                            hl.Name = "FruitESP_Highlight"
                            hl.Adornee = obj
                            hl.FillColor = FRUIT_COLOR
                            hl.FillTransparency = 0.6
                            hl.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
                            hl.OutlineTransparency = 0.2
                            hl.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
                            hl.Parent = obj
                            activeESPTags[hl] = true
                        end)
                        fruitESPStore[obj] = { bb = bb, lbl = lbl, hl = hl, part = basePart, model = obj }
                    end
                end
            end)
        end
    end
    local function setupMatchaESP(player)
        if player == LocalPlayer or not FeatureStates["EspMatcha"] then return end
        local char = player.Character
        if not char then return end
        local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or char:FindFirstChild("Head") or char.PrimaryPart
        local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not hrp or not hum then return end
        if matchaESPStore[player] then return end
        local sq = createDrawingSquare()
        local lines = {}
        if Drawing and Drawing.new then
            for _ = 1, 14 do
                local l = createDrawingLine()
                if l then table.insert(lines, l) end
            end
        end
        local sBox = nil
        pcall(function()
            sBox = Instance.new("SelectionBox")
            sBox.Name = "Matcha_3DSelectionBox"
            sBox.Adornee = char
            sBox.Color3 = MATCHA_COLOR
            sBox.LineThickness = 0.05
            sBox.SurfaceColor3 = MATCHA_COLOR
            sBox.SurfaceTransparency = 0.88
            sBox.Parent = char
        end)
        local hl = nil
        pcall(function()
            hl = Instance.new("Highlight")
            hl.Name = "Matcha_3DBox"
            hl.Adornee = char
            hl.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
            hl.FillColor = MATCHA_COLOR
            hl.FillTransparency = 0.85
            hl.OutlineColor = MATCHA_COLOR
            hl.OutlineTransparency = 0
            hl.Parent = char
        end)
        matchaESPStore[player] = {
            square = sq,
            lines = lines,
            sBox = sBox,
            hl = hl,
            player = player,
            char = char,
            hum = hum,
            hrp = hrp
        }
    end
    local function drawBone(line, partA, partB, cam, col)
        if not line then return end
        if not partA or not partB or not partA.Parent or not partB.Parent then
            if line.Visible then line.Visible = false end
            return
        end
        local pA, onA = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(partA.Position)
        local pB, onB = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(partB.Position)
        if (onA or onB) and pA.Z > 0 and pB.Z > 0 then
            line.From = Vector2.new(pA.X, pA.Y)
            line.To = Vector2.new(pB.X, pB.Y)
            line.Color = col
            line.Thickness = 3.5
            if not line.Visible then line.Visible = true end
        else
            if line.Visible then line.Visible = false end
        end
    end
    local function drawBox(square, char, cam, col)
        if not square or not char or not char.Parent then
            if square and square.Visible then square.Visible = false end
            return
        end
        local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or char:FindFirstChild("Head") or char.PrimaryPart
        if not hrp then
            if square.Visible then square.Visible = false end
            return
        end
        local cf = hrp.CFrame
        local sz = Vector3.new(4, 5.5, 2.5)
        local camPos = cam.CFrame.Position
        local dir = (cf.Position - camPos)
        if cam.CFrame.LookVector:Dot(dir) <= 0 then
            if square.Visible then square.Visible = false end
            return
        end
        local topWorld = cf.Position + Vector3.new(0, sz.Y * 0.58, 0)
        local btmWorld = cf.Position - Vector3.new(0, sz.Y * 0.58, 0)
        local pTop, onTop = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(topWorld)
        local pBtm, onBtm = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(btmWorld)
        if (onTop or onBtm) and pTop.Z > 0 and pBtm.Z > 0 then
            local boxH = math.abs(pBtm.Y - pTop.Y)
            local boxW = boxH * 0.68
            if boxH > 4 and boxW > 3 then
                local midX = (pTop.X + pBtm.X) * 0.5
                local minY = math.min(pTop.Y, pBtm.Y)
                square.Size = Vector2.new(boxW, boxH)
                square.Position = Vector2.new(midX - boxW * 0.5, minY)
                square.Color = col
                square.Thickness = 2.8
                if not square.Visible then square.Visible = true end
                return
            end
        end
        if square.Visible then square.Visible = false end
    end
    local function rebuildESPs()
        local isGen     = FeatureStates["GeneralEsp"]
        local isPlayer  = FeatureStates["PlayerEsp"]
        local isMatcha  = FeatureStates["EspMatcha"]
        local isNpc     = FeatureStates["NpcEsp"]
        local isFruit   = FeatureStates["FruitEsp"]
        local isRainbow = FeatureStates["RainbowEsp"]
        local isSimple  = (_G.G_ESP_SimpleMode == true or (FeatureStates and FeatureStates["SimpleEsp"] == true))
        for p, _ in pairs(bespokeESPStore) do
            cleanPlayerBespokeESP(p)
        end
        bespokeESPStore = {}
        if isGen or isPlayer or isRainbow or isSimple then
            for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                if p ~= LocalPlayer and p.Character then
                    if isGen then
                        setupGeneralESP(p)
                    else
                        setupPlayerESP(p)
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        if isMatcha then
            for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                if p ~= LocalPlayer and p.Character then
                    setupMatchaESP(p)
                end
            end
        else
            for p, _ in pairs(matchaESPStore) do
                cleanMatchaESP(p)
            end
            matchaESPStore = {}
        end
        if isNpc then
            scanAndSetupAllNPCs()
        else
            for npc, _ in pairs(npcESPStore) do
                cleanNPCESP(npc)
            end
            npcESPStore = {}
        end
        if isFruit then
            updateFruitESP()
        else
            for fr, _ in pairs(fruitESPStore) do
                cleanFruitESP(fr)
            end
            fruitESPStore = {}
        end
    end
    _G.RebuildSpookyESPs = rebuildESPs
    local lastEspTextUpdate = 0
    local rainbowHue = 0
    RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
        local anyActive = FeatureStates["GeneralEsp"] or FeatureStates["PlayerEsp"] or FeatureStates["NpcEsp"]
            or FeatureStates["FruitEsp"] or FeatureStates["RainbowEsp"] or FeatureStates["EspMatcha"]
            or FeatureStates["SimpleEsp"] or _G.G_ESP_SimpleMode
        if not anyActive then return end
        rainbowHue = (rainbowHue + dt * 0.4) % 1
        local curRainbow = Color3.fromHSV(rainbowHue, 1, 1)
        local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
        local myRoot = getMyRoot()
        local myPos = myRoot and myRoot.Position or Vector3.zero
        local now = tick()
        local doTextUpdate = false
        if now - lastEspTextUpdate >= 0.1 then
            doTextUpdate = true
            lastEspTextUpdate = now
        end
        if doTextUpdate then
            for p, data in pairs(bespokeESPStore) do
                pcall(function()
                    if p.Parent and data.char and data.char.Parent and data.lbl and data.bb and data.bb.Parent then
                        local hrp = data.char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or data.char:FindFirstChild("Head")
                        local hum = data.char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                        if hrp and hum and hum.Health > 0 then
                            local pData = getPlayerData(p)
                            local col = FeatureStates["RainbowEsp"] and curRainbow or pData.color
                            local finalCol = _G.G_ESP_Color or col
                            local isSimple = (_G.G_ESP_SimpleMode == true or (FeatureStates and FeatureStates["SimpleEsp"] == true))
                            data.lbl.Text = buildESPText(p, hum, hrp, pData, myPos)
                            data.lbl.TextColor3 = finalCol
                            data.lbl.Font = _G.G_ESP_Font or data.lbl.Font
                            data.lbl.TextSize = isSimple and 10.5 or (_G.G_ESP_TextSize or data.lbl.TextSize)
                            local targetSize = isSimple and UDim2.new(0, 140, 0, 32) or (data.style == "Player" and UDim2.new(0, 180, 0, 36) or UDim2.new(0, 220, 0, 75))
                            if data.bb.Size ~= targetSize then
                                data.bb.Size = targetSize
                            end
                            local offX = _G.G_ESP_TagOffsetX or 0
                            local offY = _G.G_ESP_TagOffsetY or 0
                            data.bb.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(offX, (data.style == "Player" and 2.8 or 3.2) + offY, 0)
                            applyAvatarThumb(data.bb, p)
                            if data.hl then
                                data.hl.FillColor = finalCol
                                data.hl.OutlineColor = finalCol
                                local dist = math.floor((myPos - hrp.Position).Magnitude)
                                data.hl.Enabled = (_G.G_ESP_Chams ~= false) and (dist <= 150)
                            end
                        else
                            cleanPlayerBespokeESP(p)
                        end
                    else
                        cleanPlayerBespokeESP(p)
                    end
                end)
            end
        end
        if FeatureStates["EspMatcha"] and cam then
            local vp = cam.ViewportSize
            local vpMargin = 80
            for p, data in pairs(matchaESPStore) do
                pcall(function()
                    if p.Parent and data.char and data.char.Parent and data.hum and data.hum.Parent and data.hum.Health > 0 then
                        local char = data.char
                        local hum = data.hum
                        local hrp = data.hrp
                        if not hrp or not hrp.Parent then
                            hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or char:FindFirstChild("Head") or char.PrimaryPart
                            data.hrp = hrp
                        end

                        if not hrp then
                            if data.square and data.square.Visible then data.square.Visible = false end
                            if data.lines then
                                for _, l in ipairs(data.lines) do
                                    if l and l.Visible then l.Visible = false end
                                end
                            end
                            return
                        end

                        local rootPos = hrp.Position
                        local dist = (myPos - rootPos).Magnitude

                        if dist > 350 then
                            if data.square and data.square.Visible then data.square.Visible = false end
                            if data.lines then
                                for _, l in ipairs(data.lines) do
                                    if l and l.Visible then l.Visible = false end
                                end
                            end
                            return
                        end

                        local rootScreen, onScreen = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(rootPos)
                        local isVisible = onScreen or (rootScreen.Z > 0
                            and rootScreen.X >= -vpMargin and rootScreen.X <= vp.X + vpMargin
                            and rootScreen.Y >= -vpMargin and rootScreen.Y <= vp.Y + vpMargin)

                        if not isVisible then
                            if data.square and data.square.Visible then data.square.Visible = false end
                            if data.lines then
                                for _, l in ipairs(data.lines) do
                                    if l and l.Visible then l.Visible = false end
                                end
                            end
                            return
                        end

                        if data.square then
                            drawBox(data.square, char, cam, MATCHA_COLOR)
                        end
                        if data.lines and #data.lines > 0 then
                            local lines = data.lines
                            local parts = data.bodyParts
                            if not parts or parts.char ~= char or not parts.head or not parts.head.Parent then
                                parts = { char = char, isR15 = (hum.RigType == Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15) }
                                if parts.isR15 then
                                    parts.head = char:FindFirstChild("Head")
                                    parts.uTorso = char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
                                    parts.lTorso = char:FindFirstChild("LowerTorso")
                                    parts.lArm = char:FindFirstChild("LeftUpperArm")
                                    parts.lElbow = char:FindFirstChild("LeftLowerArm")
                                    parts.lHand = char:FindFirstChild("LeftHand")
                                    parts.rArm = char:FindFirstChild("RightUpperArm")
                                    parts.rElbow = char:FindFirstChild("RightLowerArm")
                                    parts.rHand = char:FindFirstChild("RightHand")
                                    parts.lLeg = char:FindFirstChild("LeftUpperLeg")
                                    parts.lKnee = char:FindFirstChild("LeftLowerLeg")
                                    parts.lFoot = char:FindFirstChild("LeftFoot")
                                    parts.rLeg = char:FindFirstChild("RightUpperLeg")
                                    parts.rKnee = char:FindFirstChild("RightLowerLeg")
                                    parts.rFoot = char:FindFirstChild("RightFoot")
                                else
                                    parts.head = char:FindFirstChild("Head")
                                    parts.torso = char:FindFirstChild("Torso")
                                    parts.lArm = char:FindFirstChild("Left Arm")
                                    parts.rArm = char:FindFirstChild("Right Arm")
                                    parts.lLeg = char:FindFirstChild("Left Leg")
                                    parts.rLeg = char:FindFirstChild("Right Leg")
                                end
                                data.bodyParts = parts
                            end

                            if parts.head then
                                if parts.isR15 then
                                    drawBone(lines[1], parts.head, parts.uTorso, cam, MATCHA_COLOR)
                                    drawBone(lines[2], parts.uTorso, parts.lTorso, cam, MATCHA_COLOR)
                                    drawBone(lines[3], parts.uTorso, parts.lArm, cam, MATCHA_COLOR)
                                    drawBone(lines[4], parts.lArm, parts.lElbow, cam, MATCHA_COLOR)
                                    drawBone(lines[5], parts.lElbow, parts.lHand, cam, MATCHA_COLOR)
                                    drawBone(lines[6], parts.uTorso, parts.rArm, cam, MATCHA_COLOR)
                                    drawBone(lines[7], parts.rArm, parts.rElbow, cam, MATCHA_COLOR)
                                    drawBone(lines[8], parts.rElbow, parts.rHand, cam, MATCHA_COLOR)
                                    drawBone(lines[9], parts.lTorso, parts.lLeg, cam, MATCHA_COLOR)
                                    drawBone(lines[10], parts.lLeg, parts.lKnee, cam, MATCHA_COLOR)
                                    drawBone(lines[11], parts.lKnee, parts.lFoot, cam, MATCHA_COLOR)
                                    drawBone(lines[12], parts.lTorso, parts.rLeg, cam, MATCHA_COLOR)
                                    drawBone(lines[13], parts.rLeg, parts.rKnee, cam, MATCHA_COLOR)
                                    drawBone(lines[14], parts.rKnee, parts.rFoot, cam, MATCHA_COLOR)
                                else
                                    drawBone(lines[1], parts.head, parts.torso, cam, MATCHA_COLOR)
                                    drawBone(lines[2], parts.torso, parts.lArm, cam, MATCHA_COLOR)
                                    drawBone(lines[3], parts.torso, parts.rArm, cam, MATCHA_COLOR)
                                    drawBone(lines[4], parts.torso, parts.lLeg, cam, MATCHA_COLOR)
                                    drawBone(lines[5], parts.torso, parts.rLeg, cam, MATCHA_COLOR)
                                    for i = 6, 14 do
                                        if lines[i] and lines[i].Visible then lines[i].Visible = false end
                                    end
                                end
                            else
                                for _, l in ipairs(lines) do
                                    if l and l.Visible then l.Visible = false end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    else
                        cleanMatchaESP(p)
                    end
                end)
            end
        end
        if FeatureStates["NpcEsp"] and doTextUpdate then
            for npc, data in pairs(npcESPStore) do
                pcall(function()
                    if npc.Parent and data.char and data.char.Parent and data.lbl and data.bb and data.bb.Parent then
                        local hrp = data.char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or data.char:FindFirstChild("Head") or data.char.PrimaryPart
                        local hum = data.char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                        if hrp and hum and hum.Health > 0 then
                            local dist = math.floor((myPos - hrp.Position).Magnitude)
                            local hpPct = math.floor((hum.Health / math.max(hum.MaxHealth, 1)) * 100)
                            data.lbl.Text = string.format("NPC: %s [%dm] %d%%", data.char.Name, dist, hpPct)
                            if data.hl then
                                data.hl.Enabled = (dist <= 150)
                            end
                        else
                            cleanNPCESP(npc)
                        end
                    else
                        cleanNPCESP(npc)
                    end
                end)
            end
        end
        if FeatureStates["FruitEsp"] and doTextUpdate then
            for fr, data in pairs(fruitESPStore) do
                pcall(function()
                    if fr.Parent and data.lbl and data.part and data.part.Parent then
                        local dist = math.floor((myPos - data.part.Position).Magnitude)
                        data.lbl.Text = string.format("Fruit | %s | < %d >", fr.Name, dist)
                    else
                        cleanFruitESP(fr)
                    end
                end)
            end
        end
    end)
    local function setupPlayerListeners(p)
        if p == LocalPlayer then return end
        pcall(function()
            if p.CharacterAdded and p.CharacterAdded.Connect then
                p.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
                    task.wait(0.3)
                    if not char.Parent then return end
                    local isGen     = FeatureStates["GeneralEsp"]
                    local isPlayer  = FeatureStates["PlayerEsp"]
                    local isRainbow = FeatureStates["RainbowEsp"]
                    local isMatcha  = FeatureStates["EspMatcha"]
                    local isSimple  = (_G.G_ESP_SimpleMode == true or (FeatureStates and FeatureStates["SimpleEsp"] == true))
                    if isGen then
                        setupGeneralESP(p)
                    elseif isPlayer or isRainbow or isSimple then
                        setupPlayerESP(p)
                    end
                    if isMatcha then
                        setupMatchaESP(p)
                    end
                end)
            end
        end)
    end
    for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        setupPlayerListeners(p)
    end
    pcall(function()
        if Players.PlayerAdded and Players.PlayerAdded.Connect then
            Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(setupPlayerListeners)
        end
        if Players.PlayerRemoving and Players.PlayerRemoving.Connect then
            Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(p)
                cleanPlayerBespokeESP(p)
                cleanMatchaESP(p)
            end)
        end
    end)
    local function hookNpcFolder(folder)
        if not folder then return end
        pcall(function()
            folder.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
                if FeatureStates["NpcEsp"] then
                    task.wait(0.05)
                    if child:IsA("Model") and (child:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or child:FindFirstChild("Head") or child.PrimaryPart) then
                        setupNpcESP(child)
                    end
                end
            end)
        end)
    end
    local enemiesFolder = workspace:FindFirstChild("Enemies")
    if enemiesFolder then hookNpcFolder(enemiesFolder) end
    local npcsFolder = workspace:FindFirstChild("NPCs")
    if npcsFolder then hookNpcFolder(npcsFolder) end
    workspace.ChildAdded:Connect(function(item)
        if item.Name == "Enemies" or item.Name == "NPCs" then
            hookNpcFolder(item)
            return
        end
        if FeatureStates["FruitEsp"] and (item:IsA("Tool") or item:IsA("Model")) and string.find(item.Name, "Fruit") then
            task.spawn(function()
                task.wait(0.1)
                if FeatureStates["FruitEsp"] then updateFruitESP() end
            end)
        end
        if FeatureStates["NpcEsp"] and item:IsA("Model") and not Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(item) then
            task.spawn(function()
                task.wait(0.05)
                if FeatureStates["NpcEsp"] and item:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
                    setupNpcESP(item)
                end
            end)
        end
    end)
    task.spawn(function()
        while isCurrentSession() do
            task.wait(2.5)
            local anyActive = FeatureStates["GeneralEsp"] or FeatureStates["PlayerEsp"] or FeatureStates["NpcEsp"]
                or FeatureStates["FruitEsp"] or FeatureStates["RainbowEsp"] or FeatureStates["EspMatcha"]
                or FeatureStates["SimpleEsp"] or _G.G_ESP_SimpleMode
            if anyActive then
                rebuildESPs()
            end
        end
    end)
    for _, espN in ipairs({"GeneralEsp", "PlayerEsp", "NpcEsp", "FruitEsp", "RainbowEsp", "EspMatcha", "SimpleEsp"}) do
        FeatureCallbacks[espN] = rebuildESPs
    end
    FeatureCallbacks["SimpleEsp"] = function(v)
        FeatureStates["SimpleEsp"] = v
        _G.G_ESP_SimpleMode = v
        rebuildESPs()
        notifyToggle((CurrentLang == "ES") and ("ESP Simple: " .. (v and "ON" or "OFF")) or ("Simple ESP: " .. (v and "ON" or "OFF")), v)
    end

do
    FeatureCallbacks["Headless"] = function(v)
        local char = LocalPlayer.Character
        if not char then return end
        local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head")
        if head then
            head.Transparency = v and 1 or 0
            local face = head:FindFirstChild("face")
            if face then face.Transparency = v and 1 or 0 end
        end
        for _, item in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
            if item:IsA("Accessory") then
                local handle = item:FindFirstChild("Handle")
                if handle then
                    local att = handle:FindFirstChildOfClass("Attachment")
                    local attName = att and att.Name or ""
                    local isHeadItem = attName:find("Hat") or attName:find("Hair") or attName:find("Face") or attName:find("Head") or item.AccessoryType == Enum.AccessoryType.Hair or item.AccessoryType == Enum.AccessoryType.Hat or item.AccessoryType == Enum.AccessoryType.Face
                    if isHeadItem then
                        handle.Transparency = v and 1 or 0
                        for _, d in ipairs(handle:GetDescendants()) do
                            if d:IsA("BasePart") or d:IsA("Decal") then d.Transparency = v and 1 or 0 end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    local korbloxMeshes = {}
    FeatureCallbacks["Korblox"] = function(v)
        local char = LocalPlayer.Character
        if not char then return end
        local rl  = char:FindFirstChild("RightUpperLeg")
        local rl2 = char:FindFirstChild("RightLowerLeg")
        local rf  = char:FindFirstChild("RightFoot")
        if v then
            if rl then
                rl.Transparency = 1
                for _, c in pairs(rl:GetChildren()) do if c:IsA("SpecialMesh") then c:Destroy() end end
                local mesh = Instance.new("SpecialMesh", rl)
                mesh.MeshId = "rbxassetid://139607718"
                mesh.TextureId = "rbxassetid://139607673"
                mesh.Scale = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)
                table.insert(korbloxMeshes, mesh)
            end
            if rl2 then rl2.Transparency = 1 end
            if rf then rf.Transparency = 1 end
        else
            for _, m in pairs(korbloxMeshes) do pcall(function() m:Destroy() end) end
            korbloxMeshes = {}
            if rl then rl.Transparency = 0 end
            if rl2 then rl2.Transparency = 0 end
            if rf then rf.Transparency = 0 end
        end
    end
    local giantNoclipConn = nil
    local function applyGiantSkinAndBody(targetScale)
        local char = LocalPlayer.Character
        local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not char or not hum then return end
        pcall(function()
            hum:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Seated, false)
            hum.Sit = false
            if char:IsA("Model") then
                if not char:GetAttribute("OrigCharScale") then
                    char:SetAttribute("OrigCharScale", char:GetScale() or 1)
                end
                char:ScaleTo((char:GetAttribute("OrigCharScale") or 1) * targetScale)
            end
            hum.HipHeight = 2 * targetScale
        end)
        if not giantNoclipConn then
            giantNoclipConn = RunService.Stepped:Connect(function()
                local c = LocalPlayer.Character
                if c and FeatureStates["GiantMode"] then
                    local h = c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                    if h then
                        h:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Seated, false)
                        if h.Sit then h.Sit = false end
                    end
                    for _, p in ipairs(c:GetDescendants()) do
                        if p:IsA("BasePart") and p.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then
                            p.CanCollide = false
                        end
                    end
                end
            end)
        end
    end
    local function restoreGiantSkinAndBody()
        if giantNoclipConn then
            giantNoclipConn:Disconnect()
            giantNoclipConn = nil
        end
        local char = LocalPlayer.Character
        local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not char or not hum then return end
        pcall(function()
            hum:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Seated, true)
            hum.Sit = false
            if char:IsA("Model") and char:GetAttribute("OrigCharScale") then
                char:ScaleTo(char:GetAttribute("OrigCharScale") or 1)
            else
                char:ScaleTo(1)
            end

    local function formatCommas(n)
        local s = tostring(math.floor(n or 0))
        local k
        while true do
            s, k = string.gsub(s, "^(-?%d+)(%d%d%d)", "%1,%2")
            if k == 0 then break end
        end
        return s
    end

    local function applyVisualStats()
    _G.applyVisualStats = applyVisualStats
        pcall(function()
            local data = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("Data")
            local ls = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
            if data then
                local l = data:FindFirstChild("Level")
                if l then l.Value = Settings.spoofLevel end
                local b = data:FindFirstChild("Beli")
                if b then b.Value = Settings.spoofBeli end
                local f = data:FindFirstChild("Fragments")
                if f then f.Value = Settings.spoofFragments end
            end
            if ls then
                local b = ls:FindFirstChild("Bounty/Honor") or ls:FindFirstChild("Bounty") or ls:FindFirstChild("Honor")
                if b then b.Value = Settings.spoofBounty end
            end
            for _, lbl in ipairs(PlayerGui:GetDescendants()) do
                if lbl:IsA("TextLabel") and not lbl:IsDescendantOf(ScreenGui) then
                    local txt = lbl.Text or ""
                    if string.find(txt, "Lv") or lbl.Name == "Level" then
                        lbl.Text = "Lv. " .. tostring(Settings.spoofLevel)
                    elseif string.find(txt, "Bounty") or string.find(txt, "Honor") or lbl.Name == "Bounty" then
                        lbl.Text = "Bounty: " .. formatCommas(Settings.spoofBounty)
                    elseif string.find(txt, "%$") or lbl.Name == "Beli" or lbl.Name == "Money" then
                        lbl.Text = "$ " .. formatCommas(Settings.spoofBeli)
                    elseif string.find(txt, "ƒ") or lbl.Name == "Fragments" then
                        lbl.Text = "ƒ " .. formatCommas(Settings.spoofFragments)
                    end
                end
            end
        end)
    end

    local activeSky = nil
    local rainbowSkyThread = nil
    local origLightingProps = nil
    local origAtmosphereProps = nil
    local activeRainbowSky = nil
    local activeRainbowAtmosphere = nil

    local function enforceSkybox()
        if not FeatureStates["Skybox"] then return end
        if FeatureStates["RainbowSkybox"] then return end
        local sb = SKYBOXES[Settings.skyIdx]
        if sb and sb.bk then
            if not activeSky or activeSky.Parent ~= Lighting then
                if activeSky then activeSky:Destroy() end
                activeSky = Instance.new("Sky", Lighting)
                activeSky.Name = "Spooky_Skybox"
                activeSky.SkyboxBk = sb.bk
                activeSky.SkyboxDn = sb.dn
                activeSky.SkyboxFt = sb.ft
                activeSky.SkyboxLf = sb.lf
                activeSky.SkyboxRt = sb.rt
                activeSky.SkyboxUp = sb.up
            end
        end
    end

    local function stopRainbowSky()
        if rainbowSkyThread then
            pcall(function() task.cancel(rainbowSkyThread) end)
            rainbowSkyThread = nil
        end
        if activeRainbowSky then
            pcall(function() activeRainbowSky:Destroy() end)
            activeRainbowSky = nil
        end
        if activeRainbowAtmosphere then
            pcall(function() activeRainbowAtmosphere:Destroy() end)
            activeRainbowAtmosphere = nil
        end
        if origLightingProps then
            pcall(function()
                Lighting.Ambient = origLightingProps.Ambient
                Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = origLightingProps.OutdoorAmbient
                Lighting.ColorShift_Top = origLightingProps.ColorShift_Top
                Lighting.ColorShift_Bottom = origLightingProps.ColorShift_Bottom
            end)
            origLightingProps = nil
        end
        local atmo = Lighting:FindFirstChildOfClass("Atmosphere")
        if atmo and origAtmosphereProps then
            pcall(function()
                atmo.Color = origAtmosphereProps.Color
                atmo.Decay = origAtmosphereProps.Decay
            end)
            origAtmosphereProps = nil
        end
        if FeatureStates["Skybox"] then
            enforceSkybox()
        end
    end

    local function startRainbowSky()
        stopRainbowSky()
        origLightingProps = {
            Ambient = Lighting.Ambient,
            OutdoorAmbient = Lighting.OutdoorAmbient,
            ColorShift_Top = Lighting.ColorShift_Top,
            ColorShift_Bottom = Lighting.ColorShift_Bottom
        }
        local existingAtmo = Lighting:FindFirstChildOfClass("Atmosphere")
        if existingAtmo then
            origAtmosphereProps = {
                Color = existingAtmo.Color,
                Decay = existingAtmo.Decay
            }
        end

        if activeSky then
            pcall(function() activeSky:Destroy() end)
            activeSky = nil
        end

        activeRainbowSky = Instance.new("Sky")
        activeRainbowSky.Name = "Spooky_RainbowSky"
        activeRainbowSky.CelestialBodiesShown = true
        activeRainbowSky.SkyboxBk = "rbxassetid://16876541778"
        activeRainbowSky.SkyboxDn = "rbxassetid://16876543880"
        activeRainbowSky.SkyboxFt = "rbxassetid://16876546384"
        activeRainbowSky.SkyboxLf = "rbxassetid://16876548320"
        activeRainbowSky.SkyboxRt = "rbxassetid://16876550345"
        activeRainbowSky.SkyboxUp = "rbxassetid://16876552681"
        activeRainbowSky.Parent = Lighting

        local atmo = existingAtmo
        if not atmo then
            atmo = Instance.new("Atmosphere", Lighting)
            atmo.Name = "Spooky_RainbowAtmosphere"
            activeRainbowAtmosphere = atmo
        end

        rainbowSkyThread = task.spawn(function()
            local hue = 0
            while FeatureStates["RainbowSkybox"] and isCurrentSession() do
                hue = (hue + 0.006) % 1
                local rainbowColor = Color3.fromHSV(hue, 0.75, 1)
                local ambientColor = Color3.fromHSV(hue, 0.45, 0.9)
                local decayColor = Color3.fromHSV(hue, 0.85, 0.5)

                pcall(function()
                    Lighting.Ambient = ambientColor
                    Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = rainbowColor
                    Lighting.ColorShift_Top = rainbowColor
                    if atmo and atmo.Parent then
                        atmo.Color = rainbowColor
                        atmo.Decay = decayColor
                    end
                end)
                task.wait(0.06)
            end
        end)
    end
